npc.cobra.say_1: Partez ! Hissssss ! Vous ne portez pas la marque du cobra !
npc.coltrayne.greet_msg_1: Salut. Besoin d'une armure ou d'une arme ? Alors demandez-moi un {trade}.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_1: Faites équipe avec d'autres pour vaincre des monstres !
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_10: Bon en potions. Aime expérimenter. Peut vous équiper d'équipement magique pour une chasse.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_11: Donne aux nouveaux arrivants des indications sur la façon dont nous faisons les choses ici à Tibia. Vous ne savez pas comment utiliser quelque chose ? Demandez à Inigo.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_12: Je n'ai pas grand chose à dire sur lui. Je le connais à peine. Cela semble être un bon professeur de sorts pour les mages.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_2: Procurez-vous votre équipement et aidez-nous à défendre Dawnport contre les monstres !
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_3: De meilleures armes équivalent à plus de dégâts – procurez-vous du matériel ici !
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_4: Ceignez-vous ! Cotte de mailles, arcs, lances, épées : nous avons tout !
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_5: La compétence vient avec la pratique : sortez et tuez des bêtes !
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_6: Coltrayne Daggard. Demandez-moi simplement un échange pour découvrir les dernières nouveautés en matière de cotte de mailles et d'armes.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_7: Je suis forgeron de métier. Je veux garder nos garçons et nos filles en sécurité et équipés d'une lame tranchante, moi.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_8: Vous voulez dire que je suis un tuteur inexpérimenté ? Sortez d'ici.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_9: Oui. Vous souhaitez échanger, je suppose. Au moins, tu as l'air d'avoir besoin d'un bon équipement, gamin.

npc.coltrayne.voice_2: Procurez-vous votre équipement et aidez-nous à défendre Dawnport contre les monstres !

npc.commander_stone.multi_1: Prends ce petit cochon ici. Il deviendra un jour un grand chasseur de champignons, c'est certain. Pour l'instant, cela dépend de vous et des autres cochons. ...
npc.commander_stone.multi_2: Eh bien, les autres cochons comme lui en sont un, je veux dire. Je ne te comparais bien sûr pas à un cochon ! Allez dans la zone des truffes et suivez les cochons truffiers. S'ils déterrent des truffes, laissez le petit cochon manger les champignons. ...
npc.commander_stone.multi_3: Vous devrez le nourrir trois fois. Alors rends-le-moi. ...
npc.commander_stone.multi_4: Gardez à l'esprit que le cochon doit être rendu à sa mère après un certain temps. Si vous ne le faites pas, les gnomes le rappelleront via des cristaux de téléportation.

npc.commander_stone.say_3: Vous devrez réparer certains cristaux endommagés. Entrez dans les sols cristallins et réparez-les à l'aide de ce cristal harmonique. Réparez-en cinq et revenez-moi.

npc.commander_stone.say_32: [FR] You will have to repair some damaged crystals. Go into the Crystal grounds and repair them, using this harmonic crystal. Repair five of them and return to me.

npc.commander_stone.say_51: [FR] Take this little piggy here. It will one day become a great mushroom hunter for sure. For now it is depended on you and other pigs. ...
npc.commander_stone.say_52: [FR] Well, other pigs like it is one, I mean. I was of course not comparing you with a pig! Go to the truffles area and follow the truffle pigs there. If they dig up some truffles, let the little pig eat the mushrooms. ...
npc.commander_stone.say_53: [FR] You'll have to feed it three times. Then return it to me. ...
npc.commander_stone.say_54: [FR] Keep in mind that the pig has to be returned to his mother after a while. If you don't do this, the gnomes will call it back via teleport crystals.

npc.cornelia.greet_msg_1: Bienvenue dans la meilleure boutique {armor} du pays, |PLAYERNAME| !
npc.cornelia.say_2: Ah, tu dois être le héros dont Trisha a parlé. Je vais vous préparer les pointes d'épaule. S'il vous plaît, donnez-moi un peu de temps pour terminer.
npc.cornelia.say_3: Je n'ai pas encore fini. Soyez aussi patient que courageux.
npc.cornelia.say_4: Fini! Puisque tu es un homme, je pensais que tu en voulais probablement deux. Les hommes veulent toujours ce petit symbole de statut supplémentaire. <rires>
npc.cornelia.say_5: Je vends des armures en cuir, des armures en chaînes et des armures en laiton. Demandez-moi un {trade} si vous souhaitez y jeter un œil.
npc.cornell.farewell_msg_1: Au revoir. Recommandez-nous si vous êtes satisfait de notre service.
npc.cornell.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today, to {Grimvale} or {Edron}?
npc.cornell.stdmod_3: Nous aimerions vous servir un peu de temps.
npc.corym_butler.greet_msg_1: Nous devons extraire des ressources précieuses, mais nous n’avons pas assez à manger. La situation est terrible.
npc.corym_butler.greet_msg_2: Chaque homme est l'architecte de sa propre fortune. L’époque de {repression} est enfin révolue.
npc.corym_butler.multi_1: Nous devons extraire des ressources précieuses, mais nous n’avons pas assez à manger. La situation est terrible.
npc.corym_footman.greet_msg_1: Ce que nous mangeons est vraiment ridicule.
npc.corym_footman.greet_msg_2: Chaque homme est l'architecte de sa propre fortune. Nous avons failli mourir de {hunger}.
npc.corym_footman.multi_1: Ce que nous mangeons est vraiment ridicule. D’autant plus que nous devrions extraire une quantité insensée de minerais.
npc.corym_ratter.greet_msg_1: Nous extrayons tout ce que la Terre mère nous offre, des ressources naturelles précieuses.
npc.corym_ratter.greet_msg_2: Bienvenue étranger ! Vous pourriez être surpris que je ne vous attaque pas immédiatement. Le fait est que je pense que vous pourriez m'être utile. Ce que vous voyez devant vous, c'est une grande mine de corym ! ...
npc.corym_ratter.greet_msg_3: Nous extrayons tout ce que la Terre mère nous offre, des ressources naturelles précieuses. Mais le rendement empire et ici j'ai besoin de votre {help}.
npc.corym_ratter.say_1: Récemment, la quantité de minerais livrés a diminué. Pourriez-vous découvrir la raison pour laquelle la situation a empiré ?
npc.corym_ratter.say_2: Bon! J'ai ouvert la mine pour toi. Mais prends soin de toi ! Les monstres des profondeurs ne vous épargneront pas.
npc.corym_ratter.say_3: [FR] Recently the amount of delivered ores is decreasing. Could you find out the reason, why the situation has become worse?
npc.corym_ratter.say_4: [FR] Nice! I have opened the mine for you. But take care of you! The monsters of depth won't spare you.
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_1: [EN] Every man is the architect of his own fortune. The times of repression are finally over.
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_2: [EN] We work as hard we can, my master! Wait, I haven't seen you here before. You were sent by the Corym Ratter, I see. He misses the courage to visit us and find the reason for {decreasing resources}? He's the coward I have expected.
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_3: [EN] Well, I see you have already collected enough rare earth! Would you give it to me?
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_4: [EN] You have to liberate all the Corym I told you. Unlock the three affected areas.
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_5: [EN] Well done! The riot progesses! No fight without weapons. In the mine the temperature is quite high, higher as expected in this depth. Therefore we need heat-resistent weapons and armors. ...
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_6: [EN] This effect can be reached by adding rare earth to the common materials. But this can only be found in the stomaches of stonerefiners. 20 of these should be enough. Well, I see you have already collected enough of them! Would you give it to me?
npc.corym_servant.multi_1: [EN] Thank you very much! Our smiths are now able to craft heat-resistent weapons and armor. A little reward for you is this. ...
npc.corym_servant.multi_2: [EN] There is one last thing I would like to say to you, there are rumours that this dungeon can only be entered alive. This could mean that there's an unknown dungeon keeper guarding this place, so take care of you!
npc.corym_servant.multi_3: [EN] I see you are interested to change our sitation. The first thing I like you to do is to liberate the jailed coryms. There are three areas with locked doors. You have to find a way to get access. ...
npc.corym_servant.multi_4: [EN] For this reason I will give you access to the second floor. It was closed because it wasn't possible to continue working at these enourmous high temperatures. Furthermore we were instantly attacked by stonerefiners. So take care of you!
npc.corym_servant.multi_5: [EN] You have to know, that our work is very hard and the conditions we have are terrible. The wanted amount is abolutely unrealistic. Beyond that the food we get is never enough. ...
npc.corym_servant.multi_6: [EN] Our workers should give their best while starving. This is not possible. That's the point to {defy} the authority.
npc.corym_servant.say_1: [EN] You don't have enough, return when could you bring 20 of rare earth to me.
npc.corym_servant.say_2: [FR] You have to know, that our work is very hard and the conditions we have are terrible. The wanted amount is abolutely unrealistic. Beyond that the food we get is never enough. ...
npc.corym_servant.say_3: [FR] Our workers should give their best while starving. This is not possible. That's the point to {defy} the authority.
npc.corym_servant.say_4: [FR] I see you are interested to change our sitation. The first thing I like you to do is to liberate the jailed coryms. There are three areas with locked doors. You have to find a way to get access. ...
npc.corym_servant.say_5: [FR] For this reason I will give you access to the second floor. It was closed because it wasn't possible to continue working at these enourmous high temperatures. Furthermore we were instantly attacked by stonerefiners. So take care of you!
npc.corym_servant.say_6: [FR] Thank you very much! Our smiths are now able to craft heat-resistent weapons and armor. A little reward for you is this. ...
npc.corym_servant.say_7: [FR] There is one last thing I would like to say to you, there are rumours that this dungeon can only be entered alive. This could mean that there's an unknown dungeon keeper guarding this place, so take care of you!
npc.corym_servant.say_8: [FR] You don't have enough, return when could you bring 20 of rare earth to me.
npc.corym_slave.greet_msg_1: [EN] The repression has taken too long. With our new weapons the respective people will get their just punishment.
npc.corym_slave.greet_msg_2: [EN] Every man is the architect of his own fortune. There will be the day of {pay back}.
npc.corym_slave.multi_1: [EN] The repression has taken too long. With our new weapons the respective people will get their just punishment.
npc.corym_worker_01.greet_msg_1: [EN] My hero! A friend of mine sent you to liberate me? A true friend!
npc.corym_worker_01.greet_msg_2: [EN] My hero! A friend of mine sent you to liberate me? A true friend! I am poor but nevertheless I give you this as little reward.
npc.corym_worker_02.greet_msg_1: [EN] We need weapons to overcome our situation.
npc.corym_worker_02.greet_msg_2: [EN] Every man is the architect of his own fortune. The times of {repression} are finally over.
npc.corym_worker_02.multi_1: [EN] We need weapons to overcome our situation.
npc.corym_worker_03.greet_msg_1: [EN] My hero! A friend of mine sent you to liberate me? A true friend!
npc.corym_worker_03.greet_msg_2: [EN] My hero! A friend of mine sent you to liberate me? A true friend! I am poor but nevertheless I give you this as little reward.
npc.corym_worker_04.greet_msg_1: [EN] Every man is the architect of his own fortune. I want to see the daylight again! Just smell fresh air.
npc.corym_worker_04.greet_msg_2: [EN] Every man is the architect of his own fortune. I want to see the daylight again! Just smell fresh air.
npc.corym_worker_05.greet_msg_1: [EN] My hero! A friend of mine sent you to liberate me? A true friend!
npc.corym_worker_05.greet_msg_2: [EN] My hero! A friend of mine sent you to liberate me? A true friend! I am poor but nevertheless I give you this as little reward.
npc.costello.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Feel free to tell me what has brought you here.
npc.costello.say_1: [EN] To be honest, I fear the omen in my dreams may be true. \z Perhaps Fugio is unable to see the danger down there. \z Perhaps ... you are willing to investigate this matter?
npc.costello.say_2: [EN] Who are you to demand holy water from the White Raven Monastery? Who sent you??
npc.costello.say_3: [EN] I already filled your vial with holy water.
npc.costello.say_4: [EN] Ahh, Amanda from Edron sent you! I hope she's doing well. So why did she send you here?
npc.costello.say_5: [EN] Thank you very much! From now on you may open the warded doors to the catacombs.
npc.costello.say_7: [EN] By the gods! This is brother Fugio's handwriting and what I read is horrible indeed! You have done our order a great favour by giving this diary to me! Take this blessed Ankh. May it protect you in even your darkest hours.
npc.costello.say_8: [EN] I never heard that name and you won't get holy water for some stranger.
npc.costello.say_9: [EN] Ohh, why didn't you tell me before? Sure you get some holy water if it's for Amanda! Here you are.
npc.costello.say_fugio: [EN] To be honest, I fear the omen in my dreams may be true. Perhaps Fugio is unable to see the danger down there. Perhaps ... you are willing to investigate this matter?
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.already: [EN] It seems you already have this addon, don't you try to mock me son!
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.newaddon: [EN] Here you are, enjoy your brand new addon!
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.no_items: [EN] You do not have all the required items.
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_1: [EN] I can offer you first & second addons of the following outfit: {Wayfarer}.
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_5: [EN] llected all the required pieces, say 'yes' and voila - you got yourself an addon!
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_6: [EN] To achieve the first storage addon you need to give me the Old Cape. Do you have them with you?
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_7: [EN] Alright then. Come back when you got all neccessary items.
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_8: [EN] To achieve the second storage addon you need to give me the Sedge Hat. Do you have them with you?
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_9: [EN] Alright then. Come back when you got all neccessary items.
npc.cruleo.voice_2: [EN] This will earn me some handsome amount of gold!
npc.curos.multi_1: [EN] First we will test your strength and endurance. You'll have to face one of the most experienced Mooh'Tah masters. As you don't stand a chance to beat such an opponent, your test will be simply to survive. ...
npc.curos.multi_10: [EN] So you still think you can be of any use for us? Words are cheap and easy. Admittedly, you've passed our first test but even some resilient beast might have accomplished that. ...
npc.curos.multi_11: [EN] Your actions will tell if you are only yelping for attention like a puppy or if you have the teeth of a wolf. ...
npc.curos.multi_12: [EN] A first tiny step was taken. You survived the test and ensured the survival of your allies for a while. Now it is time to make the next step. ...
npc.curos.multi_13: [EN] So listen human: Our rule over the orcs is not unchallenged. Of course now and then someone shows up who thinks he can defeat us. Usually these fights end fast and bloody in the ring. ...
npc.curos.multi_14: [EN] Right now, some coward from our midst, who is too afraid to face us in single combat, has gathered a group of followers, hoping more will follow and change sides. ...
npc.curos.multi_15: [EN] With your help, his defeat will not only be deadly but also humiliating and so discourage others to follow his example. ...
npc.curos.multi_16: [EN] You will seek out this rebel commander in his hideout and kill him. We will show them that not even a Mooh'Tah master is needed to get rid of such wannabe leaders but that a mere human can handle them. ...
npc.curos.multi_17: [EN] Find him in the mountain north-west of here and kill him. If you find any loot, you can keep it.
npc.curos.multi_18: [EN] We have seen that you can fight and survive. Yet, it will also need cleverness and courage to survive in these lands. We might see later if you've got what it takes. ...
npc.curos.multi_19: [EN] However, I stand to my word - our hordes will spare your insignificant piece of rock for now. Time will tell if you are worthy living next to us. ...
npc.curos.multi_2: [EN] Face him in a battle and survive for two minutes. If you do, we will be willing to assume that your are prepared for the life in these lands. Enter the ring of battle, close to my quarter. Return to me after you have passed this test.
npc.curos.multi_20: [EN] Still, it will take years until we might consider you as an ally, but this is a start at least.
npc.curos.multi_3: [EN] Finally, our enemy's vision is obscured. Now we can move in for some more daring raids until they replace their scrying device. You have proven yourself brave and useful so far. With that, you bought your allies some more days to live. ...
npc.curos.multi_4: [EN] Here is a reward. It's a strange tome that we've found in the lizard ruins. Maybe it is of some value for you or your allies.
npc.curos.multi_5: [EN] We are aware that the lizards use magic to spy on us. In the Dragonblaze Mountains north of here, there is a tower which can only be entered through one of their underground fortresses. ...
npc.curos.multi_6: [EN] In this tower, there must be some accessory used for magical scrying. Some pond, a crystal ball, or a mirror maybe - it has to be something shiny. ...
npc.curos.multi_7: [EN] Usually we would send one of our youngsters on such a mission, but we are few and there is little new blood in our ranks. ...
npc.curos.multi_8: [EN] We can't send a Mooh'Tah master on such a trivial assignment, neither can we use orcs for an infiltration mission. ...
npc.curos.multi_9: [EN] This is your chance to show us your potential. Infiltrate this tower and destroy their scrying device. Once you have blinded our enemy, we might respect you somewhat more.
npc.curos.say_1: [EN] You come here to ask us to spare your people? This land has no tolerance for the weak, we have it neither. If you want us to consider you as useful for us, you'll have to prove it in a {test} of strength and courage.
npc.curos.say_2: [EN] With the death of their leader, the rebels return to our camps one by one, deeply humiliated. It might be a wise decision to let a useful tool like you continue to exist.
npc.dalbrect.greet_msg_1: [EN] Be greeted, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Welcome to my {hut}.
npc.dalbrect.say_1: [EN] Can it be? I recognise my family's arms! You have found a treasure indeed! \z I am poor and all I can offer you is my friendship, but ... please ... give that brooch to me?
npc.dalbrect.say_2: [EN] Thank you! I shall consider you my friend from now on! \z Just let me know if you {need} something!
npc.dalbrect.say_3: [EN] What are you talking about? I am too poor to be interested in jewelry.
npc.dalbrect.say_4: [EN] I should have known better than to ask for an act of kindness in this cruel, selfish, world!
npc.dalbrect.say_5: [EN] Then stop being a fool. I am poor and I have to work the whole day through!
npc.dalbrect.say_6: [EN] I should have known better than to ask for an act of kindness in this cruel, selfish, world!
npc.dalbrect.say_7: [EN] Can it be? I recognise my family's arms! You have found a treasure indeed! I am poor and all I can offer you is my friendship, but ... please ... give that brooch to me?
npc.dalbrect.say_8: [EN] Thank you! I shall consider you my friend from now on! Just let me know if you {need} something!
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_1:
[EN] I have only sailed to the isle of the kings once or twice. \z
				I dare not anger the monks by bringing travelers there without their permission.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_10:
[EN] Our family fortune was lost when the colonization of those cursed lands failed. \z
				Now nothing is left of our fame or our fortune. \z
				If I only had something as a reminder of those better times. <sigh>
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_11:
[EN] Our family fortune was lost when the colonization of those cursed lands failed. \z
				Now nothing is left of our fame or our fortune. \z
				If I only had something as a reminder of those better times. <sigh>
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_12: [EN] To think my family used to belong to the local nobility! And now those arrogant women are in charge!
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_13:
[EN] There is little I can offer you but a trip with my boat. \z
				Are you looking for a {passage} to the isle of kings perhaps?
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_2: [EN] Do you seek a passage to the isle of the kings for 10 gold coins?
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_4: [EN] Well, I'll be here if you change your mind.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_5: [EN] My name is Dalbrect Windtrouser, of the once proud Windtrouser family.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_6: [EN] I am merely a humble fisher now that nothing is left of my noble {legacy}.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_7: [EN] Once my family was once noble and wealthy, but {fate} turned against us and threw us into poverty.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_8:
[EN] When Carlin tried to colonize the region now known as the ghostlands, \z
				my ancestors put their fortune in that {project}.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_9:
[EN] When Carlin tried to colonize the region now known as the ghostlands, \z
				my ancestors put their fortune in that {project}.
npc.dallheim.greet_1: [EN] Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.
npc.dallheim.greet_2: [EN] <nods> At your service, |PLAYERNAME|, protecting the {village} from {monsters}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_1: [EN] The most dangerous monsters of Rookgaard are on the other side of this bridge.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_11: [EN] I'm the guard of this bridge. I defend Rookgaard against the beasts of the {wilderness} and the {dungeons}, and even of the stinking {sewers}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_12: [EN] My duty is eternal. Time is of no importance.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_13: [EN] Before you fight monsters, deposit your money there. If you die, you won't lose it if it's save in the bank.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_15: [EN] I have to stay here, sorry. But I can heal you if you are wounded. I have also valuable information about {monsters}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_16: [EN] I'm an expert concerning the wildlife and {monsters} on this island.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_17: [EN] I'll protect all citizens alike. That is my {job} and duty.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_18: [EN] Did you know that rats are among the most dangerous animals in whole Tibia? Each day, they kill many people who are overestimating their powers. Don't be one of them!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_19: [EN] There are two types of spiders on this island: normal spiders and poison spiders. As their name says, the latter ones can poison you which will cause a constant loss of your health. Beware of them!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_2: [EN] Want to know what monsters are good for you at your level? Just ask me!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_20: [EN] Once you have upgraded your starter {equipment} a little - maybe leather stuff - and got a better weapon as well as a shield, you should be able to kill trolls.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_21: [EN] You need a stronger weapon than the starter club to kill wolves. Maybe a {sabre} or a short {sword} will do.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_22: [EN] Orcs are a constant menace. There are even stronger species of orcs on the main continent.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_23: [EN] Minotaurs are very strong. You will need a group of people or at least level 6 and good equipment to be able to kill them.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_24: [EN] They are a little tougher than they look like, but they're still good beginner monsters.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_25: [EN] The skeletons on this island are usually fairly hidden. They are often found near graves and always underground. Beware of their evil life drain.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_26: [EN] A bear can easily kill you if you don't pay attention.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_27: [EN] Wasps are the fastest monsters on this island and they poison you. If you ever run into one and are already low of health, fear for your life!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_28: [EN] Snakes can poison you, too, but their poison is usually not as dangerous as that of poison spiders. Just be careful and kill them fast.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_29: [EN] Premium warriors pay. They gain many advantages this way.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_3: [EN] I'll crush all monsters who dare to attack our base.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_31: [EN] All that theory won't help you without some real battle practice.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_32: [EN] A place of protection. Nothing can harm you there.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_33: [EN] I can mark you some dungeons on your map if you ask me about {monsters} suited for your level.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_34: [EN] The sewers are crowded with {rats}. They make fine targets for young heroes.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_35: [EN] There are {wolves}, {bears}, {snakes}, {deer}, and {spiders} in the wilderness past this bridge.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_37: [EN] The heavenly warrior! Hail to him!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_38: [EN] I'm not interested in such party tricks.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_39: [EN] A nice place for a hero, but nothing for whelps.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_4: [EN] Are you injured or poisoned? I can help you.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_40: [EN] It's my duty to protect this village and its {citizens}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_41: [EN] It looks like you have mastered the drill.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_42: [EN] Sorry, I don't trade. Ask the shop owners for a trade instead.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_43: [EN] I don't approve of her opening a bar. Those drunken adventurers stumbling over the bridge at nighttime are not especially helpful in improving the situation.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_44: [EN] Zerbrus tells me such strange stories about him. Well, he sees him all day from the west bridge.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_45: [EN] He dedicated his life to welcoming newcomers to this island.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_47: [EN] He has been on this island as long as me.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_49: [EN] He guards the temple and can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned, just like me.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_50: [EN] She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}. Her shop is south west of town, close to the temple.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_51: [EN] Strange fellow, hides somewhere in the mountains of the isle.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_52: [EN] Her shop is on the {premium} side of town. Best offers around.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_53: [EN] Sometimes I wish I had an easy job like her, selling {potions} all day.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_54: [EN] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above Seymour. Go there when you are level 8.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_6: [EN] Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_7: [EN] <nods> At your service, |PLAYERNAME|, protecting the {village} from {monsters}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_9: [EN] Hmm, |PLAYERNAME|. I really don't know if you should go into the wilderness without a shield. You should earn some money by hunting rats under the village first until you can afford at least a wooden shield.
npc.dallheim.voice_1: [EN] The most dangerous monsters of Rookgaard are on the other side of this bridge.
npc.dallheim.voice_2: [EN] Want to know what monsters are good for you at your level? Just ask me!
npc.dallheim.voice_3: [EN] I'll crush all monsters who dare to attack our base.
npc.dallheim.voice_4: [EN] Are you injured or poisoned? I can help you.
npc.dancing_fairy.farewell_msg_1: [EN] May your path always be even.
npc.dancing_fairy.multi_1: [EN] That's very kind of you, my friend! Listen: I know there is a spell to transform my fishtail into legs. It is a temporary effect, so I could return to the ocean as soon as the spell ends. Unfortunately I don't know how to cast this spell. ...
npc.dancing_fairy.multi_2: [EN] But there is a fairy who once told me about it. Perhaps she will share her knowledge. You can find her in a small fairy village in the southwest of Feyrist.
npc.dancing_fairy.multi_3: [EN] Each of those notes will grant her a walk on the beach with Taegen.
npc.dancing_fairy.multi_4: [EN] So, you are searching for a way to transform Aurita's fishtail into legs temporarily. As you might already have figured out you need some magic for this purpose. There is a place on Feyrist where you can find the arcane energies you need. ...
npc.dancing_fairy.multi_5: [EN] Northeast from here you'll discover a big lake with a small island. Take a swim there and you will find a magical fountain. If you play the panpipes while standing near this fountain, you will create some magical music notes. ...
npc.dancing_fairy.multi_6: [EN] Collect them and give them to Aurita. Each of those notes will grant her a walk on the beach with Taegen.
npc.dancing_fairy.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] May your path always be even.
npc.dane.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Please come back from time to time.
npc.dane.stdmod_1: [EN] I am the owner of this place of relaxation.
npc.dane.stdmod_5: [EN] I can offer you milk, water, and lemonade.
npc.dane.stdmod_6: [EN] Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
npc.dane.stdmod_7: [EN] Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
npc.dane.stdmod_8: [EN] Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_1: I'm impressed with your dedication and courage. I can't show you the exact location of cyclopolis on the map though. It is somewhere north of Edron city. ...
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_10: [EN] It's not only the trolls invading from the west coast. <sighs> Goblins also have a lair there where they constantly prepare for their next attack. ...
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_11: [EN] If you could kill 150 goblins for us, that'd be a good start. Would you be willing to help us in this matter?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_12: [EN] The trolls living west of our city have become quite a nuisance lately. Not that they are really dangerous to us, but still, we must show them that there's a line they shouldn't cross. ...
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_13: [EN] I want you to kill 100 of them. If you succeed, I'll provide you some pretty coins and experience. Are you willing to take on this task?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_2: [EN] Exit the city and go through a mountain passage leading to the west, then keep on heading north. The entrance is marked by large, obelisk-like stones arranged in a circle. ...
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_3: You can kill normal cyclopes as well as drones and smiths to reach your goal. Good hunting!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_4: [EN] Great! You can find rotworms south of the city, for example. Take a rope and shovel and look for loose stone piles to dig open. ...
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_5: [EN] You can kill normal rotworms as well as their larger brothers, the carrion worms, to fulfil your task. Be careful and good luck!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_6: [EN] Very well, maybe you know that the orcs here in Edron learnt to raise giant spiders. It is going to become a serious threat. ...
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_7: [EN] The mission is simple: go to the orcs and destroy all spider eggs that are hatched by the giant spider they have managed to catch. The orcs are located in the south of the western part of the island.
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_8: We've successfully driven the minotaurs off this island, but the underground city of the cyclopes - Cyclopolis - is still standing. ...
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_9: We're always looking for adventurers who'd help us decimate the number of cyclopes. Will you assist the city of Edron by killing 500 of them?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_1: [EN] Your current task is to kill 100 trolls. You have already killed {} of them. Keep going!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_10: [EN] I'm pleased with your eagerness. To reach your goal, you have to kill the brown trolls and troll champions. Good luck!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_11: [EN] Fine then! You can kill normal goblins as well as scavengers and assassins on the lower levels, but beware, they are a bit harder. Have a good hunt!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_12: [EN] I'm pleased with your eagerness. To help you find the trolls' den, I mark both the entrance to the passage and their lair on your map. To reach your goal, you have to kill the normal brown trolls, but troll champions count too. Good luck!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_13: [EN] Fine then! I'll show you the Goblin den on your map, here. Use the same passage you did when hunting for trolls. You can kill normal goblins as well as scavengers and assassins on the lower levels, but beware, they are a bit harder.
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_14: [EN] Another option if you want to do a task for Edron would be to killing 150 goblins. Would that suit your taste better?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_15: [EN] Another option if you want to do a task for Edron would be to repeat killing 100 trolls. Would that suit your taste better?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_16: Another option if you want to do a task for Edron would be to killing 500 cyclops. Would that suit your taste better?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_17: [EN] Another option if you want to do a task for Edron would be to killing 300 rotworms. Would that suit your taste better?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_18: [FR] Your current task is to kill 100 trolls. You have already killed {} of them. Keep going!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_19: [FR] Your current task is to kill 150 goblins. You have already killed {} of them. Keep going!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_2: [EN] Your current task is to kill 150 goblins. You have already killed {} of them. Keep going!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_20: [FR] Your current task is to kill 300 rotworms. You have already killed {} of them. Keep going!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_21: Your current task is to kill 500 cyclops. You have already killed {} of them. Keep going!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_3: [EN] Your current task is to kill 300 rotworms. You have already killed {} of them. Keep going!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_4: [EN] Your current task is to kill 500 cyclops. You have already killed {} of them. Keep going!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_5: [EN] Congratulations, you've fought well against the goblin plague. Thank you! Here is your reward!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_6: [EN] Well done! Thanks to you the city is a bit safer. Here's your reward!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_7: [EN] Very good job, |PLAYERNAME|. You've been a great help. Here's your reward!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_8: [EN] Currently there is no new task I could entrust you with. However, you can repeat killing {goblins} or {trolls}. Which would you prefer?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_9: [EN] Maybe you have noticed the numerous rotworms that burrowed under Edron. They're quite a pest. You look strong enough to be able to vanquish a few for us. Do you think you can kill 300 rotworms?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.stdmod_1: [EN] I am the governor of this isle, Edron, and grandmaster of the Knights of Banor's Blood.
npc.dario.greet_1: [EN] Ashari, |PLAYERNAME|. If you're a distance fighter, you might want to have a look at my wares and spells.
npc.dario.greet_msg_1: [EN] Ashari, |PLAYERNAME|. If you're a distance fighter, you might want to have a look at my wares and spells.
npc.dario.voice_1: [EN] Increase your knowledge of spells here, young paladin.
npc.dario.voice_2: [EN] Need ammunition, bows or crossbows? Have a look at my wares.
npc.dedoras.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings seekers of knowledge. You seem to be just the person I'm {looking} for.
npc.dedoras.multi_1: [EN] Marvellous! With this information combined we have all that's needed! ...
npc.dedoras.multi_10: [EN] There's a beautiful but very dangerous palace in the Tiquandan jungle. The young women who live there are actually demons and they are luring unsuspecting mortals in there. ...
npc.dedoras.multi_11: [EN] A lucky survivor told me about a portal at the very top of the palace that may lead to another asuri hideout.
npc.dedoras.multi_12: [EN] Our world has seen many noble knights and orders throughout the centuries. Most of them vanished a long time ago but only few under such mysterious circumstances as the Order of the Falcon. ...
npc.dedoras.multi_13: [EN] This noble alliance of honourable knights once resided in Edron to serve the king. Legend has it they vanished practically over night. Rumor has it their disappearance is connected to a forbidden book.
npc.dedoras.multi_14: [EN] Sightings of strange fishmen in Tiquanda are stirring up the region. You should be careful when investigating this. ...
npc.dedoras.multi_15: [EN] As far as I know a scholar in Edron already dealt with fish-like creatures before.
npc.dedoras.multi_17: [EN] An astonishing find to say the least! I'm certain it will help the efforts of accessing the library a lot!
npc.dedoras.multi_18: [EN] I gathered some lore on my own, but I desperately need more information that you might provide me. ...
npc.dedoras.multi_19: [EN] My leads are the {museum} in thais, something strange in the darashian {desert}, rumors about {fishmen}, an ancient {order}, the mysterious {asuri}, or a lost {isle}?
npc.dedoras.multi_3: [EN] Hmm, interesting. And we shouldn't forget about the chant! Yes, excellent! ...
npc.dedoras.multi_4: [EN] So listen: To enter the veiled library, travel to the white raven monastery on the Isle of Kings and enter its main altar room. ...
npc.dedoras.multi_5: [EN] There, use an ordinary scythe on the right of the two monuments, while concentrating on this glyph here and chant the words: Chamek Athra Thull Zathroth ...
npc.dedoras.multi_6: [EN] Oh, and one other thing. For your efforts I want to reward you with one of my old outfits, back from my adventuring days. May it suit you well! ...
npc.dedoras.multi_7: [EN] Hurry now my friend. Time is of essence!
npc.dedoras.multi_8: [EN] Or shall me {check} how much information we acquired?
npc.dedoras.multi_9: [EN] Or shall me {check} how much information we acquired?
npc.dedoras.say_1: [EN] I have heard that it was recently planned to expand the Museum of Tibian Arts. In the course of these activities unexpected difficulties occurred.
npc.dedoras.say_10: [EN] Are you interested in one or two addons to your battle mage outfit?
npc.dedoras.say_11: [EN] Very good! You gained the first addon to the battle mage outfit.
npc.dedoras.say_12: [EN] Very good! You gained the second addon to the battle mage outfit.
npc.dedoras.say_13: [EN] I provide two addons. For the first one I need you to bring me five sturdy books. For the second addon you need twenty epaulettes. Do you want one of these addons?
npc.dedoras.say_14: [EN] What do you have for me: the sturdy books or the epaulettes?
npc.dedoras.say_2: [EN] That's simply a scientific sensation. It will provide me with lots of much needed knowledge!
npc.dedoras.say_3: [EN] There are rumors of a mysterious statue in the desert next to Darashia. Nobody really knows the meaning of it.
npc.dedoras.say_4: [EN] You brought incredible news. This book proves an invaluable clue!
npc.dedoras.say_5: [EN] You brought incredible news. This book proves an invaluable clue!
npc.dedoras.say_6: [EN] This is incredible! Thank you so much for digging out that hint!
npc.dedoras.say_7: [EN] Thank you so much for your efforts to provide this valuable piece of the puzzle!
npc.dedoras.say_8: [EN] Talk to Captain Charles in Port Hope. He told me that he once ran ashore on a small island where he discovered a small ruin. The architecture was like nothing he had seen before.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_1: [EN] I need the help of some competent {adventurers} to handle a threat to all creation.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_10:
[EN] Hints about the shrouded hoard are numerous, though most are general mentions in texts that deal with Zathroth. But there are other sources. ... \z
	Like texts about ancient liturgies of Zathroth and historical documents that might give us clues. I already compiled everything of value from the sources that were openly available. ... \z
	To gather the more {obscure} parts of knowledge, however, I'll need your help.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_11:
[EN] Of course the first to ask would be the famous Avar Tar, but I heard he's already on a quest of his own and ... \z
	Well, let's say our last collaboration did not end too well. In fact, I'd be not even surprised if he pretended to not even know me. ... \z
	So I have to look elsewhere to handle this new {threat}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_12:
[EN] The parts alone do them no good. To assemble the parts, great skill, immense power and forbidden knowledge are necessary. ... \z
	The skill will be supplied by the fallen Yalahari and the power by Variphor itself. ... \z
	The only thing they are still lacking is the knowledge to assemble and operate the {godbreaker}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_13:
[EN] Of course the dangers of such knowledge were obvious. It was hidden in a sacred place devoted to Zathroth and dangerous knowledge. ... \z
	The hidden library, the forbidden hoard, the shrouded trove of knowledge or the veiled hoard of forbidden knowledge, the place has many names in many {myths}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_14:
[EN] Regardless of the dangers, the cult of Zathroth refused to destroy the knowledge of the godbreaker for good. ... \z
	They {value} dangerous knowledge that much, that they are unable to part from it, even when faced with the utter destruction of creation.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_15:
[EN] I know it's asked much but it's no longer a matter of choice. ... \z
	The enemy is moving and I have reports that suggest the minions of Variphor are actively searching for Zathroth's library. They must not be allowed to succeed. ... \z
	We must be the first to {reach} the hoard and make sure the enemy doesn't get the information he needs.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_16:
[EN] I'd recommend to follow the few leads me and my associates could gather so far. ... \z
	Old myths, some {rumors} about old texts and other pieces of knowledge that I could use to figure out where to locate the hidden library and how to enter it.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_2: [EN] This leaves us with no choice but to take action into our own {hands}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_3: [EN] I guess you know about the {background} and there is no need to tell you that the forces from beyond managed to acquire the parts of the godbreaker in a coup.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_4: [EN] The secret locations of the godbreaker {parts} were revealed and due to trickery, the minions of Variphor aquired all of them.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_5: [EN] Those pieces of knowledge come in several forms and shapes. For most I can give you more or less specific hints where to start your {search}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_6: [EN] You have to {find} the veiled hoard of Zathroth, breach it and destroy the knowledge how to use the godbreaker.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_7:
[EN] The goodbreaker was created in ancient times, when the war between the gods and their minions was on its height. Its creation took aeons and incredible sacrifices. ... \z
	Each part had to be crafted perfectly, to emulate the gods, so it would share 'the same place' with them. ... \z
	Mere mortals can not even perceive it in his whole but only recognize the part of it that is the physical representation in our world. ... \z
	If it was meant to be used as an actual weapon, as the ultimate threat, or if Zathroth was just tempted to use his knowledge in the ultimate way - to create something that could undo himself - we don't know. ... \z
	However in the end even Zathroth deemed it too much of a threat but instead of destroying the contraption once and for all, it was {disassembled} and hidden away.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_8:
[EN] The godbreaker is a complex artifact. Incantation woven into incantation. The powers bound into it are so immense that the slightest mishandling could prove disastrous. ... \z
	o figure out how it works, let alone how it can be operated safely, could require several centuries of tireless study. And even then this information would be only partial. ... \z
	Yet the creation and operation of the godbreaker is just the kind of forbidden {knowledge} Zathroth values most, so it was compiled and stored.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_9:
[EN] The myths agree that the place is well hidden, extremely guarded and contains some of the most powerful pieces of knowledge in this world and probably beyond. ... \z
	However the knowledge about the godbreaker now poses a threat to all existence. In the hands of Variphor it can cause disaster in previously unknown ways. The gods themselves are in {peril}.
npc.denominator.quiz1_q1: [EN] The sum of the first and second digit?
npc.denominator.quiz1_q2: [EN] The sum of the second and third digit?
npc.denominator.quiz1_q3: [EN] The sum of the first and third digit?
npc.denominator.quiz2_q2: [EN] Does the number belong to a twin prime?
npc.denominator.say_1: [EN] Your answer is {}, do you want to continue?
npc.denominator.say_11: [EN] Correct. The lower door is now open. The druid of Crunor lies.
npc.denominator.say_13: [FR] Your answer is {}, do you want to continue?
npc.denominator.say_14: [FR] Your answer is {}, do you want to continue?
npc.dermot.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. How can I help you?
npc.dermot.say_1: [EN] You have a present for me?? Realy?
npc.dermot.say_2: [EN] Do you want to buy the dungeon key for 2000 gold?
npc.dermot.stdmod_1: [EN] I am the magistrate of this isle.
npc.dermot.stdmod_3: [EN] I am Dermot, the magistrate of this isle.
npc.dermot.stdmod_4: [EN] Time is not important on Fibula.
npc.dermot.stdmod_5: [EN] You are at Fibula. This isle is not very dangerous. Just the wolves bother outside the village.
npc.dermot.stdmod_6: [EN] Oh, my god. In the dungeon of Fibula are a lot of monsters. That's why we have sealed it with a solid door.
npc.dermot.stdmod_7: [EN] Oh, my god. In the dungeon of Fibula are a lot of monsters. That's why we have sealed it with a solid door.
npc.dixi.greet_1: [EN] Good day, Ma'am. How may I help you, |PLAYERNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a trade!
npc.dixi.greet_2: [EN] Good day, Sir. How may I help you, |PLAYERNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a trade!
npc.dixi.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Here, take a look and choose something nice for you!
npc.dixi.stdmod_1: [EN] <clears throat> Get your armor and shields heeeeeeere! Upstairs!
npc.dixi.stdmod_11: [EN] <giggles> I love gossiping - err, I mean providing valuable information of course, just tell me a name! <winks>
npc.dixi.stdmod_12: [EN] I'm helping my grandfather {Obi} with this shop. If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a {trade}!
npc.dixi.stdmod_14: [EN] You can deposit your {money} there to keep it safe. However, you still need cash to buy something here.
npc.dixi.stdmod_15: [EN] The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
npc.dixi.stdmod_16: [EN] You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you reach the {Island of Destiny}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_17: [EN] As a premium adventurer you can visit different regions on this island, trade with {Lee'Delle} and much more.
npc.dixi.stdmod_18: [EN] As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_19: [EN] If you need a torch, go see {Al Dee}'s store.
npc.dixi.stdmod_2: [EN] Need some help? Just ask me, I can show you around!
npc.dixi.stdmod_20: [EN] Oh, I'm sorry, but my grandfather {Obi} doesn't like seeing me waving around with pointy things. He sells weapons himself, just go downstairs!
npc.dixi.stdmod_21: [EN] Are you hungry? Then you should visit {Willie} or {Billy} in the West of town. {Norma} also has yummy stuff! Oh, and you could pick {blueberries} or eat the food some {monsters} carry with them.
npc.dixi.stdmod_22: [EN] {Lily} sells effective health potions and antidote potions against poison.
npc.dixi.stdmod_23: [EN] The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}. {Seymore} is the teacher there.
npc.dixi.stdmod_24: [EN] King Tibianus is a wise and noble monarch. This island of {Rookgaard} belongs to his kingdom.
npc.dixi.stdmod_25: [EN] Our lovely village will provide shelter for you. Once you are level 8, you can travel to {mainland} and choose a {profession}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_26: [EN] If you want to fight monsters in {dungeons}, you definitely need some good {equipment} such as a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_27: [EN] Just ask me for a {trade} to check out my offers.
npc.dixi.stdmod_28: [EN] Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
npc.dixi.stdmod_29: [EN] To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_3: [EN] Don't forget to protect yourself with a shield!
npc.dixi.stdmod_30: [EN] There are many blueberry bushes in and around this village. Just use them to your liking!
npc.dixi.stdmod_31: [EN] You need to make sure you have some basic {equipment} before you head into dungeons such as the {sewers}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_32: [EN] There is a sewer grate which you can use to enter the sewers just left of this building. Eww, this smell!
npc.dixi.stdmod_34: [EN] How can I help you? I can give you general {hints}, information about {citizens} or talk about many other topics. Just ask me!
npc.dixi.stdmod_35: [EN] I'm sorry honey, but I can't lend you gold. Earn it yourself by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
npc.dixi.stdmod_36: [EN] You should never embark on an adventure without it. Ask {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle} for it!
npc.dixi.stdmod_37: [EN] Yes, I can sell that to you. Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
npc.dixi.stdmod_38: [EN] Me and my grandfather {Obi} sell {equipment} of all kinds. Just ask him or me for a {trade} if you like to see our offers.
npc.dixi.stdmod_39: [EN] Norma used to sell {equipment}, but she finally earned enough {money} to fulfil one of her dreams - her own bar!
npc.dixi.stdmod_4: [EN] Selling the finest armors on Rookgaard!
npc.dixi.stdmod_40: [EN] I never understand what he's talking about.
npc.dixi.stdmod_41: [EN] I'm glad that he's here. He does a great job!
npc.dixi.stdmod_42: [EN] Sometimes, I help Zirella collecting wood. Her old back aches all the time. It's a shame her son Tom doesn't help her.
npc.dixi.stdmod_43: [EN] In Al Dee's shop you will find important general equipment such as {ropes}, {shovels} and torches.
npc.dixi.stdmod_44: [EN] One day, I want to become a brave adventurer like her and leave this town!
npc.dixi.stdmod_45: [EN] Billy can be kind of scary. He swears a lot and doesn't talk to everybody.
npc.dixi.stdmod_46: [EN] Uncle Willie and {Billy} are farmers, which means they are a good place to sell and buy {food}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_47: [EN] He can heal you if you're injured or poisoned.
npc.dixi.stdmod_5: [EN] Don't let these mean monsters hurt you - get better equipment now!
npc.dixi.stdmod_6: [EN] Good day, Ma'am. How may I help you, |PLAYERNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a trade!
npc.dixi.stdmod_7: [EN] Good day, Sir. How may I help you, |PLAYERNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a trade!
npc.dixi.voice_1: [EN] <clears throat> Get your armor and shields heeeeeeere! Upstairs!
npc.dixi.voice_2: [EN] Need some help? Just ask me, I can show you around!
npc.dixi.voice_3: [EN] Don't forget to protect yourself with a shield!
npc.dixi.voice_4: [EN] Selling the finest armors on Rookgaard!
npc.dixi.voice_5: [EN] Don't let these mean monsters hurt you - get better equipment now!
npc.doctor_gnomedix.greet_msg_1: [EN] Stand still on the examination platform |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.dorian.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! Why do you disturb me?
npc.dorian.multi_1: [EN] Once again you've finished your job, and I'll keep my promise. From now on, you can trade with old Black Bert somewhere upstairs to get access to certain items that mightbe of value to someone like you. ...
npc.dorian.multi_10: [EN] Unfortunately, we are lacking some good fighters, which is quite a disadvantage against certain other organisations. However, I think you're a really good fighter ...
npc.dorian.multi_11: [EN] Travel to the Plains of Havoc and find the base of our competitors under the ruins of the dark cathedral ...
npc.dorian.multi_12: [EN] On the lowest level, you'll find a wall with two trophies. Place a message of our guild on the wall, right between the trophies. On your way, get rid of as many of our competitors as you can.
npc.dorian.multi_13: [EN] We'd like to ease our lives somewhat. Therefore, we would appreciate the cooperation with one of the Venore city guards. ...
npc.dorian.multi_14: [EN] Find some dirt about one of them. It's unimportant what it is. As soon as we have a foothold, we'll convince him to cooperate. Bring me whatever you may find.
npc.dorian.multi_15: [EN] Your next job will be kidnapping. You'll get us the only creature that this scrupulous trader Theodore Loveless in Liberty Bay holds dear. ...
npc.dorian.multi_16: [EN] His little goldfish! To get that fish, you'll have to get in his room somehow. ...
npc.dorian.multi_17: As you might know I sell lock picks, but I fear unless you're extremely lucky, you won't crack this expensive masterpiece of a lock. However, get us that fish, regardless how.
npc.dorian.multi_18: [EN] Your next mission will lead you to Tiquanda. There is a hidden smugglers cave, north of town. ...
npc.dorian.multi_19: [EN] These smugglers think they don't have to pay us respect and try to withhold our share of the profit. Recently, they got hold of a certain valuable goblet. ...
npc.dorian.multi_2: [EN] If you like, you can also enter the room to the left and pick one item of your choice.
npc.dorian.multi_20: [EN] Find them and get us this goblet as rightful payment. If you have to bash some noses during your mission, even better.
npc.dorian.multi_21: [EN] Your next mission is somewhat bigger and I'm sure much fun for you. Some new-rich merchant is being a bit more greedy than it's good for him. ...
npc.dorian.multi_22: [EN] The good thing is he's as stupid as greedy, so we have a little but cunning plan. We arranged the boring correspondence in advance, so you'll come in when the fun starts. ...
npc.dorian.multi_23: [EN] You'll disguise yourself as the dwarven ambassador and sell that fool the old dwarven bridge, south of Kazordoon. ...
npc.dorian.multi_24: [EN] Well, actually it is a bit more complicated than that. Firstly, you'll have to get forged documents. Ask around in the criminal camp to find a forger. ...
npc.dorian.multi_25: [EN] Secondly, you'll need a disguise. Percybald in Carlin is an eccentric actor that might help you with that. ...
npc.dorian.multi_26: [EN] As soon as you got both things, travel to Venore and find the merchant Nurik. Trade the false documents for the famous painting of Mina Losa and bring it to me.
npc.dorian.multi_27: [EN] Our beloved king will hold a great festivity at the end of the month. Unfortunately he forgot to invite one of our guild's representatives. ...
npc.dorian.multi_28: [EN] Of course it would be rude to point out this mistake to the king. It will be your job to get us an invitation to the ball. ...
npc.dorian.multi_29: [EN] Moreover, It will be a great chance to check the castle for, well, opportunities. I'm sure you understand. However, it's up to that pest Oswald to give out invitations, so he's the man you're looking for.
npc.dorian.multi_3: [EN] Excellent, that little letter will do the trick for sure ...
npc.dorian.multi_30: [EN] A client of our guild would like to get a certain vase. Unfortunately, it's not for sale. Well, by the original owner, that is. ...
npc.dorian.multi_31: [EN] We, on the other hand, would gladly sell him the vase. Therefore, it would come in handy if we get this vase in our hands. ...
npc.dorian.multi_32: [EN] Luckily, the walls of the owner's house are covered with vines, that will make a burglary quite easy. ...
npc.dorian.multi_33: [EN] You'll still need some lock picks to get the chest open in which the vase is stored. Must be your lucky day, as I'm selling lock picks for a fair price. ...
npc.dorian.multi_34: [EN] You might need some of them to get that chest open. The soon to be ex-owner of that vase is Sarina, the proprietor of Carlin's general store.
npc.dorian.multi_35: [EN] Your first job is quite easy. The Thaian officials are unwilling to share the wealth they've accumulated in their new town Port Hope. ...
npc.dorian.multi_36: [EN] They insist that most resources belong to the crown. This is quite sad, especially ivory is in high demand. Collect 10 elephant tusks and bring them to me.
npc.dorian.multi_4: [EN] I think you're really capable and if you finish another mission, I'll allow you full access to our black market of lost and found items. Just ask me to learn more about that mission.
npc.dorian.multi_5: [EN] Ah, the key to untold riches. Don't worry, we'll make sure that no one will connect you to the disappearance of certain royal possessions. ...
npc.dorian.multi_6: [EN] You're too valuable to us. Speaking about your value, I might have some other mission for you.
npc.dorian.multi_7: [EN] Excellent. You'll learn this trade from scratch. Our operations cover many fields of work. Some aren't even illegal. ...
npc.dorian.multi_8: [EN] Well, as long as you don't get caught at least. Ask me for a mission whenever you're ready.
npc.dorian.multi_9: [EN] Competition might be an interesting challenge but our guild isn't really keen on competition. ...
npc.dorian.say_10: [EN] What an ugly vase. But who am I to question the taste of our customers? Anyway, I might have another mission in store for you.
npc.dorian.say_11: [EN] Excellent, that serves this fool right. I fear in your next mission, you'll have to get your hands dirty. Just ask me to learn more about it.
npc.dorian.say_12: [EN] That goblet is hardly worth all this trouble but we had to insist on our payment. However, I assume you are eager for more missions, so just ask.
npc.dorian.say_13: [EN] This little goldfish will bring us a hefty ransom! Just ask me if you're ready for another mission.
npc.dorian.say_14: [EN] Hm. Well, we could use some fresh blood. Ahum. Do you want to join the thieves guild, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.dorian.say_15: [EN] Yes, I sell lock picks. Ask me for a trade.
npc.dorian.say_9: [EN] What a fine material. That will be worth a coin or two. So far, so good. Ask me for another mission if you're ready for it.
npc.doubleday.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello there, hmm just... just wait right there, I'll be with you in a second. Just getting this {experiment} done...
npc.doubleday.multi_1: [EN] To actually 'find' a suitable location to deploy the probing device for my measurements, you should use my mono detector. The device detects singular chemical structures of any material or fabric I feed it with and signals it! ...
npc.doubleday.multi_10: [EN] Yes, well I am working on something very time-consuming at the moment. You see, a lot of us don't have time to go out much, to converse even just to meet and talk about recent discoveries. ...
npc.doubleday.multi_11: [EN] So I thought about a device to help communication in this wonderful city. I already had a helper, he was easily... 'stressed' and quit. Didn't have time to find a new one. ...
npc.doubleday.multi_12: [EN] So, if you'd like to help - there is a lot to do for me to bring my plans to fruition - and if you help me, you will earn my {votes} for the {magistrate} in turn! Are you in?
npc.doubleday.multi_2: [EN] If you have lost your detector or your probing device, I can hand out another - it will take some time, however. Do you need a new one?
npc.doubleday.multi_3: [EN] Very good, these readings do tell me a lot - the coloured glooth may be instable but it has some... 'interesting' effects on its surroundings. Oh - no worries, you will be perfectly safe. I will also take back my detector now, thanks. ..
npc.doubleday.multi_4: [EN] Feel free to help me deploy more probes whenever you like.
npc.doubleday.multi_5: [EN] Could you please just go down there and check if this is caused by... my... version of the {glooth}? You know, just some experiments I did to alter the basic elemental structure of the {glooth}, nothing personal. ...
npc.doubleday.multi_6: [EN] If you'd just take this very tiny probing device I designed to analyse the {coloured glooth} and, you know, go down there and place it - oh, and I'll also give you this really tiny {detector}, modified to find a spot where to place the {probe} - so?
npc.doubleday.multi_7: [EN] If you'd just take this very tiny probing device I designed to analyse the {coloured glooth} and, you know, go down there and place it - oh, and I'll also give you this really tiny {detector}, modified to find a spot where to place the {probe} - so?
npc.doubleday.multi_8: [EN] Good! Quite good! You know, there are actually several things I want you to address. ...
npc.doubleday.multi_9: [EN] First, there is the problem with {communication}, second I need someone to {probe} part of the sewers and last - {combinatorics}!
npc.doubleday.say_1: [EN] Very nice, there you go! Just bring me the printout from the probe after deploying it! You can request a new probing {device} or a new {detector} if you lose it - but it takes some time for me to get a new one ready so be careful with that stuff.
npc.doubleday.say_2: [EN] Hey, let's try to be reasonable here, alright? That's a bit too much for what you did, isn't it? It may seem that way but the number of votes I can offer isn't limitless.
npc.doubleday.say_3: [EN] Good, you just gained 1 genuine votes in the magistrate!
npc.doubleday.say_4: [EN] Alright, there you go - please, try to be more careful with my equipment next time!
npc.doubleday.say_5: [EN] Well, let's see, you helped me 1 times before exchanging any votes - how many votes do you want me to give you in exchange?
npc.doubleday.say_6: [EN] Well, let's see, you helped me 1 times before exchanging any votes - how many votes do you want me to give you in {exchange}?
npc.doubleday.say_7: [EN] Alright then, that's 2 vote(s) you want - I won't take them back, are you sure?
npc.doubleday.say_8: [EN] Alright then, that's 1 vote(s) you want - I won't take them back, are you sure?
npc.doubleday.say_9: [EN] You must wait until the detector is ready again.
npc.dove.say_1: [EN] Oh no! I knew that day would come! I am slightly above the allowed weight and if you can't supply me with some grapes to slim down I will get fired. Do you happen to have some grapes with you?
npc.dove.say_2: [EN] Oh thank you! Thank you so much! So listen ... <whispers her measurements>
npc.dukosch.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you feel adventurous? Do you want a weekly {ticket} for the ore wagon system here? You can use it right here to get to the centre of Kazordoon!
npc.dukosch.say_1: [EN] Do you want to purchase a weekly ticket for the ore wagons? With it you can travel freely and swiftly through Kazordoon for one week. 250 gold only. Deal?
npc.dukosch.say_2: [EN] Your weekly ticket is still valid. Would be a waste of money to purchase a second one
npc.dukosch.say_3: [EN] Here is your stamp. It can't be transferred to another person and will last one week from now. You'll get notified upon using an ore wagon when it isn't valid anymore.
npc.duncan.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hi, come closer. Have a look at my wares.
npc.duncan.multi_1: [EN] I am glad to hear this. Please listen. The pirates on Nargor are breeding tortoises. They think eating tortoises makes a hard man even harder. ...
npc.duncan.multi_2: [EN] However I am quite fond of tortoises and can't stand the thought of them being eaten. So I convinced Captain Striker that I can train them to help us. As a substitute for rafts and such ...
npc.duncan.multi_3: [EN] All I need is one tortoise egg from Nargor. This is the opportunity to save a tortoise from a gruesome fate! ...
npc.duncan.multi_4: [EN] I will ask Sebastian to bring you there. Travel to Nargor, find their tortoise eggs and bring me at least one of them.
npc.duncan.multi_5: [EN] Listen, the task is not that hard. Simply prove that you are with us and not with the pirates from Nargor by bringingme some of their belongings. ...
npc.duncan.multi_6: [EN] Bring me 100 of their eye patches, 100 of their peg legs and 100 of their hooks, in that order. ...
npc.duncan.multi_7: [EN] Have you understood everything I told you and are willing to handle this task?
npc.duncan.say_1: [EN] You're talking about my sabre? Well, even though you earned our trust, you'd have to fulfill a task first before you are granted to wear such a sabre.
npc.duncan.say_10: [EN] Good! Come back to me once you have gathered 100 eye patches.
npc.duncan.say_11: [EN] Good job. Alright, now bring me 100 peg legs.
npc.duncan.say_13: [EN] Nice. Lastly, bring me 100 pirate hooks. That should be enough to earn your sabre.
npc.duncan.say_16: [EN] Indeed, what a fine work... the book I mean. Your work was acceptable all in all.
npc.duncan.say_18: [EN] A real tortoise egg ... I guess you are more accustomed to rescue some noblewoman in distress but you did something goodtoday.
npc.duncan.say_2: [EN] I need a new quality atlas for our captains. Only one of the best will do it. I heard the explorers society sells the best, but only to members of a certain rank. You will have to get this rank or ask a high ranking member to buy it for you.
npc.duncan.say_3: [EN] Did you get an atlas of the explorers society as I requested?
npc.duncan.say_4: [EN] You did some impressive things. I think people here start considering you as one of us. But these are dire times and everyone of us is expected to give his best and even exceed himself. Do you think you can handle that?
npc.duncan.say_5: [EN] Did you rescue one of those poor soon-to-be baby tortoises from Nargor?
npc.duncan.say_6: [EN] Are you up to the task which I'm going to give you and willing to prove you're worthy of wearing such a sabre?
npc.duncan.say_firebird: [EN] I see, I see. Well done. Go to Morgan and tell him this codeword: 'firebird'. He'll know what to do.
npc.duria.stdmod_1: [EN] In this category I have '{Wound Cleansing}' and '{Cure Poison}'.
npc.duria.stdmod_2: [EN] In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.duria.stdmod_3: [EN] I can teach you {healing spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.ebenizer.greet_msg_1: [EN] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.ebenizer.voice_1: [EN] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.eclesius.greet_msg_1: [EN] Who are you? What do you want? You seem too experienced to become my assistant. Please leave.
npc.eclesius.voice_1: [EN] I'm looking for a new assistant!
npc.eclesius.voice_2: [EN] Err, what was it again that I wanted...?
npc.eclesius.voice_3: [EN] Do come in! Mind the step of the magical door, though.
npc.eclesius.voice_4: [EN] I'm so sorry... I promise it won't happen again. Problem is, I can't remember where I made the error...
npc.eclesius.voice_5: [EN] Actually, I STILL prefer inexperienced assistants. They're easier to keep an eye on and don't tend to backstab you.
npc.eclesius.voice_6: [EN] So much to do, so much to do... uh... where should I start?
npc.edala.greet_msg_2: [EN] Ashari, |PLAYERNAME|. How... nice to see a human taking interest in a beautiful art such as music.
npc.edala.greet_msg_4: [EN] Ashari, |PLAYERNAME|. You've made some... progress playing the lyre, haven't you..? I want to believe you have.
npc.edala.greet_msg_5: [EN] |PLAYERNAME|. My regular visitor. I certainly... appreciate your efforts to entertain me, but let me assure you, I'm quite comfortable up here by myself. Alone. In silence.
npc.edala.greet_msg_6: [EN] Ashari, |PLAYERNAME|. I'm starting to feel a little sorry... for your lyre. Being forced to produce such noise must be a tragic fate.
npc.edala.greet_msg_7: [EN] |PLAYERNAME|! You're driving me insane! I beg you, take your lyre away from this sacred and peaceful place.
npc.edala.greet_msg_8: [EN] |PLAYERNAME|! My ears! I'd prefer listening to drunken dwarves rambling all day to the sound of your lyre! Please, at least get it tuned. Here, you can have this elvish diapason.
npc.edala.keyword_1: [EN] So receive the fire of the suns, pilgrim.
npc.edala.stdmod_1: [EN] Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.edala.stdmod_10: [EN] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.edala.stdmod_11: [EN] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.edala.stdmod_12: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.edala.stdmod_13: [EN] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.edala.stdmod_14: [EN] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.edala.stdmod_2: [EN] So receive the fire of the suns, pilgrim.
npc.edala.stdmod_3: [EN] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.edala.stdmod_4: [EN] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.edala.stdmod_5: [EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.edala.stdmod_6: [EN] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.edala.stdmod_7: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.edala.stdmod_8: [EN] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.edala.stdmod_9: [EN] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.eddy.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need some equipment for your house?
npc.eddy.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?
npc.eddy.stdmod_1: [EN] Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.eddy.voice_1: [EN] Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.edgar_ellen.greet_msg_1: [EN] This world is nothing without poetry, don't you think? It gives us hope, it envokes love. It's inciting and invigorating all the same.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_1: [EN] Orshabaal was out of his maze to make us suffer for many days. In Calmera, a knight with blue beard from his hideout appeared. He fought bravely supported by mages, the demon ran and is gone for ages.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_2: [EN] A knight from Guardia needed Chayenne's key. His friend dropped the item on the floor, hoping no one would see. But, at the same moment, a man crossed their way and all the knight's dreams faded away.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_3: [EN] A knight from Candia was dining at Frodo's hut, devouring plates full of meat and whatnot. Suddenly, he was called to fight. He wanted to put his armor on but it was too tight.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_4: [EN] The druid entered a Premian pyramid intent on the kill, 'Oh, that djinn will die, it will!' Down and up the stairs she hopped like a cat... When, Oops! She moved the wrong way, and died a drunk rat.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_5: [EN] Hoping to find a strange orc in his spawn, a Zaneran knight logged on before dawn. A sudden heart attack left him surprised as Sam's old backpack he had recognised.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_1: [EN] Orshabaal was out of his maze to make us suffer for many days. In Calmera, a knight with blue beard from his hideout appeared. He fought bravely supported by mages, the demon ran and is gone for ages.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_10: [EN] Do you think it's just a game? Don't you fear the dragon's flame? If you are as brave as bright, if you do not stray from fight, you may want to hear tonight, the tale of Guardia's lonely knight.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_11: [EN] For a knight from Yanara 10,000 gold were a lot. So he ventured with a team into the desert to win that pot. He solved all the riddles, strongly willed. But on his journey home he sadly was killed.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_12: [EN] A great mage from Celesta went dungeon down deep, he was very brave but his wand was cheap. Among white skeletons one of them was red. Last what he saw were the words: 'You are dead!'
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_13: [EN] A young sorcerer born and raised on Astera when dragons were scary, it was that kind of era. Walking all the way to the city of Venore, he stole from the dwarven bridge nothing less than an iron ore.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_14: [EN] A druid from Eternia just bought his first boots of haste, to finally have his leather boots replaced. Catching a backpack of fish was now his dream, but he ended up swinging his new boots upstream.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_15: [EN] A sorcerer from Efidia took his horse and got it saddled, and set out for battle. His horse lost control and threw him into a hole. Now his team lost all hope, because he forgot to bring a rope.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_16: [EN] A knight in Guardia was feeling bored. He wanted to show a dragon lord the taste of his new carlin sword. To its lair then he did go. But before he saw his foe, he met his end by a one hit K.O.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_17: [EN] On Secura a confident knight levelled to main, 840 rats he had slain. 'I am going to kill dragons,' he said while pounding his breastplate. The next thing he saw was: 'You have met a sad fate.'
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_18: [EN] One morning frosty fresh and nice, a knight was fishing on the ice. Catching some pikes for soup, but a dire penguin ate his loot. His angry wife said in the house: Now whole Beneva will laugh at us!
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_19: [EN] A paladin slaying dragons on Antica's soil, when a lord charges on to make the adventurer's blood boil. It puts up a strong fight, but to no avail. It gets slain and drops a dragon scale mail!
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_2: [EN] A knight from Guardia needed Chayenne's key. His friend dropped the item on the floor, hoping no one would see. But, at the same moment, a man crossed their way and all the knight's dreams faded away.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_20: Through Rookgaard's sewer there swarmed no fewer than a hundred screeching rats. Wading through mud, and covered in blood, two young men fought back-to-back. To Trimera's end; a knight, and a friend.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_3: [EN] A knight from Candia was dining at Frodo's hut, devouring plates full of meat and whatnot. Suddenly, he was called to fight. He wanted to put his armor on but it was too tight.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_4: [EN] The druid entered a Premian pyramid intent on the kill, 'Oh, that djinn will die, it will!' Down and up the stairs she hopped like a cat... When, Oops! She moved the wrong way, and died a drunk rat.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_5: [EN] Hoping to find a strange orc in his spawn, a Zaneran knight logged on before dawn. A sudden heart attack left him surprised as Sam's old backpack he had recognised.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_6: [EN] The world I shall save', an Olympian knight proclaimed! But from a visit to the bar he could not abstain! He woke up in pain, it all was in vain. From Venorian beer he will forever refrain.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_7: [EN] During the dark and scary night, when others sleep he goes to fight, banishing demons, that feels right, purging the evil on the sight, fearlessly waiting for daylight, Zeluna's bravest elite knight.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_8: [EN] A druid from Celesta once talked with a girl, he even bought her a necklace with a huge white pearl. Every time he went home, without money and fame, I guess this girl is cursed, Aruda is the name.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_9: [EN] A story of a knight untold, on Rowana the dice she rolled. She lured players from afar. Who could resist a shining star? She promised gold and many items, then stole their heart with cunning kindness.
npc.edowir.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.
npc.edowir.greet_msg_1: [EN] Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|! How nice of you to visit an old man like me.
npc.edowir.stdmod_1: [EN] I'm just an old man, but I know a lot about Tibia.
npc.edowir.voice_1: [EN] I'm just an old man, but I know a lot about Tibia.
npc.edowir.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.
npc.edvard.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?
npc.edvard.stdmod_1: [EN] Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.edvard.voice_1: [EN] Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.eighty.greet_msg_1: [EN] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.eighty.voice_1: [EN] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.elane.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to the paladins' guild, |PLAYERNAME|! How can I help you?
npc.elane.multi_1: [EN] Alright, I will give you a chance. Pay close attention to what I'm going to tell you now. ...
npc.elane.multi_2: [EN] Recently, one of our members moved to Liberty Bay out of nowhere, talking about some strange cult. That is not the problem, but he took my favourite crossbow with him. ...
npc.elane.multi_3: [EN] Please find my crossbow. It has my name engraved on it and is very special to me. ...
npc.elane.multi_4: [EN] Secondly, we need a lot of leather for new quivers. 100 pieces of lizard leather and 100 pieces of red dragon leather should suffice. ...
npc.elane.multi_5: [EN] Third, since we are giving out tiaras, we are always in need of enchanted chicken wings. Please bring me 5, that would help us tremendously. ...
npc.elane.multi_6: [EN] Lastly, for our arrow heads we need a lot of steel. Best would be one piece of royal steel, one piece of draconian steel and one piece of hell steel. ...
npc.elane.multi_7: [EN] Did you understand everything I told you and are willing to handle this task?
npc.elane.say_1: [EN] Oh, my winged tiara? Those are traditionally awarded after having completed a difficult {task} for our guild, only to female aspirants though. Male warriors will receive a hooded cloak.
npc.elane.say_10: [EN] Good work, |PLAYERNAME|! That is enough leather for a lot of sturdy quivers. Now, please bring me 5 enchanted chicken wings.
npc.elane.say_12: [EN] Great! Now we can create a few more Tiaras. If only they weren't that expensive... Well anyway, please obtain one piece of royal steel, draconian steel and hell steel each.
npc.elane.say_14: [EN] Wow, I'm impressed, |PLAYERNAME|. Your really are a valuable member of our paladin guild. I shall grant you your reward now. Wear it proudly!
npc.elane.say_2: [EN] So you are saying that you would like to prove that you deserve to wear such a hooded cloak?
npc.elane.say_3: [EN] I'm so excited! Have you really found my crossbow?
