npc.elane.say_4: [EN] Did you bring me 100 pieces of lizard leather and 100 pieces of red dragon leather?
npc.elane.say_5: [EN] Were you able to get hold of 5 enchanted chicken wings?
npc.elane.say_6: [EN] Ah, have you brought one piece of royal steel, draconian steel and hell steel each?
npc.elane.say_7: [EN] That's the spirit! I hope you will find my crossbow, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.elane.say_8: [EN] Yeah! I could kiss you right here and there! Besides, you're a handsome one. <giggles> Please bring me 100 pieces of lizard leather and 100 pieces of red dragon leather now!
npc.elane.stdmod_1: [EN] We are always looking for sniper gloves. They are supposed to raise accuracy. If you find a pair, bring them here. Maybe I can offer you a nice trade.
npc.elane.stdmod_10: [EN] We will help you to improve your skills. Besides I offer spells for paladins.
npc.elane.stdmod_11: [EN] Harkath Bloodblade is the royal general.
npc.elane.stdmod_12: [EN] Some paladins serve in the kings army.
npc.elane.stdmod_14: [EN] How spineless do you have to be to become a jester?
npc.elane.stdmod_16: [EN] He must have been skilled before he became the way he is now. Such a pity.
npc.elane.stdmod_17: [EN] I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
npc.elane.stdmod_18: [EN] The alcohol he sells shrouds the mind and the eye.
npc.elane.stdmod_19: [EN] One of the most important members of our guild. She makes all the bows and arrows we need.
npc.elane.stdmod_2: [EN] I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
npc.elane.stdmod_20: [EN] He sells a lot of useful equipment.
npc.elane.stdmod_21: [EN] He and his guildfellows lack the grace of a true warrior.
npc.elane.stdmod_22: [EN] A fine warrior and a skilled general.
npc.elane.stdmod_23: [EN] King Tibianus is a wise ruler.
npc.elane.stdmod_24: [EN] A follower of evil that will get what he deserves one day.
npc.elane.stdmod_25: [EN] Mhm, a little too nice for my taste. Still, it's amazing how she endures all those men stalking her, especially this creepy Oswald.
npc.elane.stdmod_26: [EN] A skilled healer, that's for sure.
npc.elane.stdmod_28: [EN] If there wouldn't be higher powers to protect him...
npc.elane.stdmod_29: [EN] A humble monk and a wise man.
npc.elane.stdmod_3: [EN] I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
npc.elane.stdmod_4: [EN] Paladins are great warriors and magicians. Besides that we are excellent missile fighters. Many people in Tibia want to join us.
npc.elane.stdmod_5: [EN] Of course, we aren't as strong as knights, but no druid or sorcerer will ever defeat a paladin with a sword.
npc.elane.stdmod_6: [EN] There are many magic spells and runes paladins can use.
npc.elane.stdmod_7: [EN] Paladins are the best missile fighters in Tibia!
npc.elane.stdmod_8: [EN] I am a paladin, not a storyteller.
npc.elane.stdmod_9: [EN] Every paladin profits from his vocation. It has many advantages to be a paladin.
npc.elathriel.greet_1: [EN] Be greeted |PLAYERNAME|. What is your {business} near the {hellgate}?
npc.elathriel.greet_msg_1: [EN] Be greeted |PLAYERNAME|. What is your {business} near the {hellgate}?
npc.elathriel.say_1: [EN] If you are that curious, do you want to buy a key for 5000 gold? \z Don't blame me if you get sucked in.
npc.elathriel.say_2: [EN] Come back when you have enough money.
npc.elathriel.say_3: [EN] Believe me, it's better for you that way.
npc.elathriel.say_key: [EN] If you are that curious, do you want to buy a key for 5000 gold? Don't blame me if you get sucked in.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_1:
[EN] I am the leader of the Kuridai and the Az'irel of Ab'Dendriel. \z
				Humans would call it {sheriff}, executioner, or avenger.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_10: [EN] It's hard for some of my people to grasp the true concept of a strong leader.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_13: [EN] A human weakling, not much more.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_14: [EN] A human weakling, not much more.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_15: [EN] Druidic magic is too peaceful for my taste.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_16: [EN] I have seen human sorcerers doing some impressive things ... before they died.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_17: [EN] We might use the shelter earth and hills provide us, but their obsession for metal is a waste of time.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_18:
[EN] Like all inferior races, they can be at least of use for something good. \z
				The other castes are just jealous of us making use of them.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_2:
[EN] Sometimes people get imprisoned for some time. \z
				True criminals will be cast out and for committing the worst crimes offenders are thrown into the hellgate.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_20: [EN] Even if he'd walk through the town above, the other castes would not see the necessity to follow OUR way.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_21:
[EN] My people are divided in castes in these times, until they comprehend \z
				that only the way of the Kuridai can save us all.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_22: [EN] Arrogant bastards, but they wield quite powerful magic.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_23: [EN] Dreamers are of no practical use. I don't mourn their demise.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_24: [EN] Confused cowards. For all their skill, they still tend to hide and run. What a waste.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_25: [EN] We are the heart of the elven society. We forge, we build, and we don't allow our people to be pushed around.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_26: [EN] We watch this city and the actions of its inhabitants closely.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_27:
[EN] The merchants of venore provide us with some useful goods. \z
				Still I an convinced that they get more out of our bargain then we do.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_28: [EN] The Thaian kingdom and we share some enemies, so it's only logical to cooperate in a few areas.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_29: [EN] I offer hardly anything except for knowledge of {spells}.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_3:
[EN] Sometimes people get imprisoned for some time. \z
				True criminals will be cast out and for committing the worst crimes offenders are thrown into the hellgate.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_30: [EN] I offer hardly anything except for knowledge of {spells}.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_31: [EN] I offer hardly anything except for knowledge of {spells}.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_4:
[EN] Sometimes people get imprisoned for some time. \z
				True criminals will be cast out and for committing the worst crimes offenders are thrown into the hellgate.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_5:
[EN] It was here among other structures, like the depot tower, before our people came here. \z
				It's secured by a sealed door.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_6: [EN] For safety we keep the door to the hellgate locked all times. I have the {keys} to open it when needed.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_7: [EN] For safety we keep the door to the hellgate locked all times. I have the {keys} to open it when needed.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_8: [EN] Not that I like to talk to you, but I am Elathriel Shadowslayer.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_9: [EN] It's one of the more useful concepts we can learn from the other races.
npc.eleonore.multi_1: [EN] I am glad to hear that. So please listen: Due to circumstances too complicated to explain now, I met Captain Ray Striker. He is ... a freedom fighter and would not find my father's acceptance, but we fell in love ...
npc.eleonore.multi_10: [EN] I guess that evil parrot hid the ring somewhere on a high tree or a rock so that you might need a rake to get it.
npc.eleonore.multi_2: [EN] Even though he had to hide for a while, we have stayed in contact for a long time now. And our love grew even further against all odds ...
npc.eleonore.multi_3: [EN] However, recently we lost contact. I don't know what has happened to him and fear the worst ...
npc.eleonore.multi_4: [EN] We always have been aware that something terrible might happen to him due to his lifestyle. But perhaps there is a harmless explanation for the absence of messages <holds her tears back>. I have arranged a passage for you to Ray's hiding place ...
npc.eleonore.multi_5: [EN] Contact Captain Waverider, the old fisherman, and tell him the secret word 'peg leg'. He will make sure that you arrive safely ...
npc.eleonore.multi_6: [EN] Please look for Ray and find out what happened to him and why he was not able to answer. Return to me as soon as you have found something out. I wish you a good journey.
npc.eleonore.multi_7: [EN] Ahh, now I understand... One of my suitors - a real chicken-heart - just brought back my ring. I was really surprised. Suddenly he shows brave attitude. But... It seems you lost it and he tries to take advantage. ...
npc.eleonore.multi_8: [EN] Thanks a lot anyways and take this gold as a reward. By the way, I would need some help in another matter. It is only a small errand. Are you interested?
npc.eleonore.multi_9: [EN] My ring was stolen by a parrot, directly from my dressing table near the window. It flew to the nearby mountains and I fear my ring will be lost forever. Whoever returns it to me will be rewarded generously. ...
npc.eleonore.say_1: [EN] Oh, my beloved ring! Have you found it and want to return it to me?
npc.eleonore.say_2: [EN] I would need some help in another matter. It is only a small errand. Are you interested?
npc.eleonore.say_3: [EN] Great, thank you! As promised, here are your 5 gold pieces. Is there ... anything left that you might want to discuss with me?
npc.eleonore.say_4: [EN] You have returned my ring and proven yourself as trustworthy. There is something I have to discuss with you. Are you willing to listen?
npc.eleonore.say_5: [EN] <blushes> Oh, he is so wonderful. A very special man with a special place in my heart.
npc.eleonore.say_6: [EN] I can't thank you enough for freeing my beloved Ray from that evil spell. I am still shocked that a mermaid could steal his love that easily.
npc.eleonore.say_7: [EN] Oh, thank you so much! Take this gold as a reward. ... which reminds me, I would need some help in another matter. It is only a small errand. Are you interested?
npc.eleonore.say_8: [EN] Thank you! It is not a difficult matter but a rather urgent one. I need to send some money to a person in town. Would you be willing to run this small errand for me?
npc.eleonore.say_9: [EN] I was hoping that you'd agree. Please deliver these 200 gold pieces to the herbalist Charlotta in the south-western part of the town. If you return from this errand, I will grant you 5 gold pieces as reward for your efforts.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_1: [EN] The elves of this city are the casts of the Cenath, the Kuridai, and the Deraisim.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_2: [EN] I am a guardian of this town. I have no time to chat!
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_3: [EN] The Cenath are magic users. Look for them on the upper levels of the town.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_4: [EN] The Deraisim are scouts and hunters. You may find them on the groundlevel of the city.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_6: [EN] If you are looking for that kind of equipment you should ask a Kuridai.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_7: [EN] Ask around in Ab'Dendriel. Many elves can teach you something about magic. The Cenath love magic most of all.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_8: [EN] The city of the humans lies somewhere far to the south beyond the mountains of the dwarfs.
npc.elgar.greet_msg_1: [EN] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.elgar.voice_1: [EN] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.eliyas.greet_msg_1: [EN] Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|. Which of my fine gems do you {need}?
npc.eliyas.stdmod_1: [EN] I am a jeweller. Maybe you want to have a look at my wonderful {offers}.
npc.eliyas.stdmod_2: [EN] Well, I sell gems and {goblets}. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.eliyas.stdmod_3: [EN] Ah, our newest import! We have golden goblets, silver goblets and bronze goblets. All of them have space for a hand-written dedication.
npc.elliott.multi_1: [EN] A sacrificial site? Damn, sounds like some freakish cult or something. Just great. And this ancient structure you talked about that's not part of the sewers? You'd better see the local historian about that, man. ...
npc.elliott.multi_2: [EN] He can make more sense of what you found there. His name is Barazbaz. He should be in the magistrate building.
npc.elliott.multi_3: [EN] Wow, you already did it, that's fast. I'm used to a more laid-back attitude from most people. It's a shame to risk losing you to some collapsing tunnels, but a deal is a deal. ...
npc.elliott.multi_4: [EN] I hereby grant you the permission to enter the abandoned part of the sewers. Take care, man! ...
npc.elliott.multi_5: [EN] If you find something interesting, come back to talk about the {abandoned sewers}.
npc.elliott.multi_6: [EN] You want to enter the abandoned sewers? That's rather dangerous and not a good idea, man. That part of the sewers was not sealed off for nothing, you know? ...
npc.elliott.multi_7: [EN] But hey, it's your life, bro. So here's the deal. I'll let you into the abandoned sewers if you help me with our {mission}.
npc.elliott.say_1: [EN] I'm glad to see you back alive and healthy. Did you find anything interesting that you want to {report}?
npc.elliott.say_2: [EN] The sewers need repair. You in?
npc.elliott.say_3: [EN] Elliott's keeps calling it that. It's just another job! You fixed some broken pipes and stuff? Let me check, {ok}?
npc.elliott.say_4: [EN] Good. Broken pipe and generator pieces, there's smoke evading. That's how you recognise them. See how you can fix them using your hands. Need about, oh, twenty of them at least repaired. Report to me or Jacob
npc.elliott.say_5: [EN] Good. Thanks, man. That's one vote you got for helping us with this. If you want to redo this task just say {abandoned sewers} to repeat it.
npc.elliott.say_6: [EN] You already reported this mission, go to the next.
npc.elvith.multi_1: [EN] The last issue I had was bought by Randor Swiftfinger. He was banished through the hellgate and probably took the book with him ...
npc.elvith.multi_2: [EN] I would not recommend seeking him or the book there, but of course it is possible.
npc.elvith.say_17: [EN] Do you want to buy a poem scroll for 200 gold?
npc.elvith.stdmod_1: [EN] I sell musical instruments of many kinds.
npc.elvith.stdmod_10: [EN] That is some god the humans worship. Our pople are not interested in this gods anymore.
npc.elvith.stdmod_11: [EN] They are too loud and don't even understand the concept of a melody.
npc.elvith.stdmod_12: [EN] The other deraisim are too much concerned with mastering the nature so they don't listen to its music anymore.
npc.elvith.stdmod_13: [EN] The Cenath think they know the 'art' but the only true art is the music.
npc.elvith.stdmod_14: [EN] I went down to the mines and tried to lighten up their spirit, the foolish creatures did not listen to my songs, though.
npc.elvith.stdmod_15: [EN] Sorry, I don't feel like teaching magic today.
npc.elvith.stdmod_16: [EN] For the worst of crimes, criminals are cast into hellgate. It is said no one can return from there. Since it is not actually forbidden to enter hellgate, you might convince Elathriel to grant you entrance.
npc.elvith.stdmod_2: [EN] I sell lyres, lutes, drums, and simple fanfares.
npc.elvith.stdmod_3: [EN] Music is an attempt to condensate emotions in harmonies and save them for the times to come.
npc.elvith.stdmod_4: [EN] Time has its own song. Close your eyes and listen to the symphony of the seasons.
npc.elvith.stdmod_5: [EN] Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
npc.elvith.stdmod_6: [EN] Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
npc.elvith.stdmod_7: [EN] We are the most graceful of all races. We feel the music of the universe in our hearts and souls.
npc.elvith.stdmod_8: [EN] They could dig some halls for a big musical event, but they won't listen to me about that matter.
npc.elvith.stdmod_9: [EN] I bet they were great musicians.
npc.elyen_ravenlock.greet_msg_1: [EN] A shadow preceded you. You wish a {scroll} or a {mission}?
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_1: [EN] You have indeed. The shrines have sung back to you. Well done, brother. Not many men take such an interest in our art. ...
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_2: [EN] I will take the flute back. Our bargain stands. You may take the scroll.
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_3: [EN] I would have to sing to the Dark Shrines, but I cannot. ...
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_4: [EN] I... cannot bear Urgith's breed. Everywhere, I hear them - scrabbling, squeaking ...
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_5: [EN] Take this bone flute and play it in front of the five Dark Shrines so that they answer with song in return. You will find them in the Gardens of Night. ...
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_6: [EN] If you have done that, you may have the scroll piece. Now go.
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_7: [EN] The scroll piece there? The symbols look promising, but it is incomplete. ...
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_8: [EN] It is of little use to us. But it seems to be of interest to you ...
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_9: [EN] In exchange for the scroll piece, you must assist me with something. {Agreed}?
npc.elyen_ravenlock.say_1: [EN] Hello, brother. You come with a question to me, I believe?
npc.elyen_ravenlock.say_2: [EN] And what is it you want? Do you bring news from the undead, or do you seek a dark {artefact}?
npc.elyen_ravenlock.say_3: [EN] Hello, brother. You have finished the dance?
npc.elyen_ravenlock.voice_3: [EN] The rats... the rats in the walls...
npc.emael.farewell_msg_1: [EN] I wish you a good hunt. Goodbye!
npc.emael.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello! Ever asked yourself who killed all the monsters for the wall trophies? Yeah, that was me, Emael the Beasthunter! I am an expert in displaying trophies. ...
npc.emael.greet_msg_2: [EN] So if you have at least some dangerous monster to show off I strongly advise you to aquire a {podium} of vigour.
npc.emael.say_1: [EN] Do you want to appropriately show off your boss trophies and buy an additional podium of vigour for 1000000 Gold?
npc.emael.say_11: [FR] You have not aquired enough knowledge in hunting big scary creatures.
npc.emael.say_2: [EN] Ah, I see you killed a lot of dangerous creatures. Here's your podium of vigour!
npc.emael.say_3: [EN] Please make sure you have free slots in your store inbox.
npc.emael.say_5: [EN] You have not aquired enough knowledge in hunting big scary creatures.
npc.emael.say_7: [FR] Do you want to appropriately show off your boss trophies and buy an additional podium of vigour for 1000000 Gold?
npc.emael.say_8: [FR] Ah, I see you killed a lot of dangerous creatures. Here's your podium of vigour!
npc.emael.say_9: [FR] Please make sure you have free slots in your store inbox.
npc.emael.voice_1: [EN] Not enough space for all my trophies...
npc.emma.farewell_msg_1: [EN] LONG LIVE THE QUEEN! You may leave now!
npc.emma.multi_1: [EN] I have bad news: a mad dwarf threatens to destroy our beloved city. He claims to have invented some device that enables him to destroy the whole city ...
npc.emma.multi_10: [EN] And this is where you come into play. Find the ship plans in the Venorean shipyard or perhaps at the harbour and bring them here immediately.
npc.emma.multi_11: [EN] The scheming Venoreans are a constant thorn in our side. They supply our enemies with all kind of equipment to boost the threat they pose to our freedom. It will be your task to hinder future weapon deliveries significantly ...
npc.emma.multi_12: [EN] The druids have supplied us with some exotic bugs. They are called rust bugs and they did not receive this name for their colour ...
npc.emma.multi_13: [EN] Take this box of rust bugs and use them on the keyhole of the smithy in the Ironhouse. These 'pets' will ruin all metal there and it will take them a while to get rid of them.
npc.emma.multi_14: [EN] The druids have asked the brigade for a favour. Given that we heavily rely on their resources and they are important supporters of our cities, we can't deny them the request ...
npc.emma.multi_15: [EN] A wandering druid has recently visited the Green Claw Swamp, located north west of that corrupted hell hole Venore. While gathering herbs, he noticed some malignant presence in the said area ...
npc.emma.multi_16: [EN] Searching for the source of evil there, he detected some old ruin. Suddenly, he was attacked by bonelords and their undead minions. He barely managed to escape alive ...
npc.emma.multi_17: [EN] The evidence he found let him conclude that the bonelords in the ruins were raising so-called death trees.These trees are full of negative energy and slowly but steadily corrupt their surrounding ...
npc.emma.multi_18: [EN] After the druid's return to Carlin, divination confirmed his upsetting assumptions about the existence of these trees ...
npc.emma.multi_19: [EN] Over the years, hundreds have fallen victim to the swamp, conserved by mud and water for eternity. With the help of the death trees, the bonelords strive for an army of undeads. This cannot be tolerated ...
npc.emma.multi_2: [EN] He has a laboratory somewhere in Kazordoon, probably somewhere near the technomancer hall. Find him and kill him! Bring me his beard as a proof!
npc.emma.multi_20: [EN] Travel to Green Claw Swamp and rip out the heart out of the master tree. Without it, the unnatural trees will wither soon. Bring me the heart as proof.
npc.emma.multi_21: [EN] Our relations with Thais can be called strained at best. Therefore, it's not really astounding that the Thaian financed Edron's academy but refuse to share some knowledge with our druids ..
npc.emma.multi_22: [EN] But we won't accept this so easily. With the help of divination, we learnt that the knowledge our druids are looking for is found in a certain book ...
npc.emma.multi_23: [EN] It will be your task to enter the academy and to steal this book for us.
npc.emma.multi_24: [EN] Excellent. The queen was not amused about this threat. It's a good thing that you have saved the city ...
npc.emma.multi_25: [EN] Unfortunately, as we are secret agents we can't parade for you or something like that, but let me express our gratitude for everything you have done for our city ...
npc.emma.multi_26: [EN] Take this token of gratitude. You will know when to use it!
npc.emma.multi_3: [EN] As you might know, once the old aristocracy of our city shared blood-ties with the noblemen of Thais. There are many unresolved claims for titles and family heirlooms and Thais does little to help in this matter ...
npc.emma.multi_4: [EN] Therefore, we will take matters into our own hands. There is a grave in the crypts on the Isle of the Kings in which we assume a book containing ancient family histories and family trees ...
npc.emma.multi_5: [EN] We need this book! We will not ask how you acquired it.
npc.emma.multi_6: [EN] Ruins of some ancient cathedral are found south west of Venore. It was a project that the Thaians never finished. However, our scouts reported some suspicious activities there ...
npc.emma.multi_7: [EN] There is a continual coming and going which hints on something big hiding there. We ask you to enter the ruins of the cathedral and to find out what all these people are doing there ...
npc.emma.multi_8: [EN] You might find several hints there, but I am sure you will know exactly when you have found what we are looking for.
npc.emma.multi_9: [EN] Venore has plans for a new kind of ship. It will be faster and more resilient than any other known ship. It will surely improve their dominance over the sea trade. Unless we get those plans for ourselves ...
npc.emma.say_1: [EN] The girls brigade is the foremost front on which we fight the numerous enemies of our city ... It's a constant race to stay ahead of our enemies. Absolute loyalty and the willingness to put ones life at stake are attributes that are vital for this brigade ... If you join, you dedicate your service to Carlin alone! Do you truly think that you are girl enough to join the brigade?
npc.emma.say_10: [EN] Bring me back some hints or something!
npc.emma.say_11: [EN] I hope this old book will do those researches any good. Personally I see little use to proof some bloodlines after we cut all ties to Thais.
npc.emma.say_12: [EN] You need to bring us that book of family trees!
npc.emma.say_13: [EN] Please bring me proof of the mad technomancers defeat!
npc.emma.say_15: [EN] A man in the girls brigade? Come on this is hilarious, this is outright stupid, this is ... exactly what no one would expect. Mhm, on second thought the element of surprise might offset your male inferiority.
npc.emma.say_16: [EN] Don't try to fool me. We are perfectly aware to whom you are loyal.
npc.emma.say_2: [EN] How unnecessarily complicated, but that's the way those Thaians are. In the end we got what we wanted and they can't do anything about it.
npc.emma.say_4: [EN] I think the druids will be pleased to hear that the immediate threat has been averted.
npc.emma.say_5: [EN] Bring me the heart as proof.
npc.emma.say_6: [EN] Great! This blow strikes them where it hurts most: profit.
npc.emma.say_7: [EN] I hope our craftsmen can do something with this stuff. For me it makes hardly any sense.
npc.emma.say_8: [EN] You need to bring me those plans!
npc.emma.say_9: [EN] I will have this correspondence examined by our specialists. I am sure they are quite revealing.
npc.emma.say_join_female: [EN] The girls brigade is the foremost front on which we fight the numerous enemies of our city ... It's a constant race to stay ahead of our enemies. Absolute loyalty and the willingness to put ones life at stake are attributes that are vital for this brigade ... If you join, you dedicate your service to Carlin alone! Do you truly think that you are girl enough to join the brigade?
npc.emma.stdmod_1: [EN] I am privileged to be in service of our beloved queen!
npc.emma.stdmod_10: [EN] Darashia never bothers about the affairs of other cities.
npc.emma.stdmod_11: [EN] It's just another Thaian puppet. Still, it is distant enough to stand a fair chance to get rid of Thais's oppression one day.
npc.emma.stdmod_12: [EN] The dwarfs of Kazordoon usually mind their own business. I wish all other cities would do the same.
npc.emma.stdmod_13:
[EN] The CGB is a patriotic organisation that fights our numerous enemies with means that guards or army do not have at their disposal. ... \z
	We work secretly and covertly. We uncover secret plots and we are both the first line of defence of our city and the last. We are joined only by the best of the best.
npc.emma.stdmod_14:
[EN] The AVIN is rather a crime syndicate than anything else. If there is something dirty and illegal, they are most likely involved. ... \z
	They are unscrupulous and also do not back away from blackmailing and assassination.
npc.emma.stdmod_15:
[EN] The TBI is as old-fashioned, stubborn and inflexible as only males can be. What makes this bureaucracy somewhat dangerous, is the money they have at their disposal. ... \z
	They buy spies and traitors - all of them weak-willed or greedy individuals.
npc.emma.stdmod_16:
[EN] The elves of Ab'Dendriel are our allies. Our druids contribute most to keeping such a good relation. ... \z
	They seem to understand the elves a bit better than we ordinary people do.
npc.emma.stdmod_17:
[EN] The name of the city is a cruel joke. The people there are oppressed by Thais and Venore who slowly bleed the isle and its people white. ... \z
	It shows what would have happened to us if our rebellion had failed.
npc.emma.stdmod_2: [EN] We are proud people who fought hard for their freedom and won't allow others to oppress us again.
npc.emma.stdmod_3: [EN] I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also known as CGB.
npc.emma.stdmod_4: [EN] I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also known as CGB.
npc.emma.stdmod_6: [EN] The Thaians never got over the fact that we gained our independence. They do everything they can to hinder the prospering of our city.
npc.emma.stdmod_7: [EN] Venore is a hellhole of evil. The trade barons' greed lets them plot against all other cities and even against each other.
npc.emma.stdmod_8: [EN] Svargrond is an important project for our city. It's not a colony but many of our people live there alongside those barbarians. If everything works out fine, Carlin and Svargrond will both prosper.
npc.emma.stdmod_9: [EN] Strange people with strange customs live in this city. Luckily, we rarely have to deal with them.
npc.emperor_kruzak.greet_1: [EN] Hiho, may fire and earth bless you, my child. Are you looking for a promotion?
npc.emperor_kruzak.greet_2: [EN] Hiho, may fire and earth bless you, my child. Are you looking for a promotion?
npc.emperor_kruzak.multi_1: [EN] Excellent! Now, let me explain. If you donate 1.000.000.000 gold pieces, you will be entitled to wear a unique outfit. ...
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_1: [EN] In exchange for a truly generous donation, I will offer a special outfit. Do you want to make a donation?
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_10: [EN] You need to donate {armor} outfit first.
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_11: [EN] Take this boots as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend.
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_12: [EN] You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_14: [EN] You need to donate {helmet} addon first.
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_15: [EN] So you wold like to donate 500.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear a unique armor?
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_16: [EN] So you would like to donate 250.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear unique helmet?
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_17: [EN] So you would like to donate 250.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear a unique boots?
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_2: [EN] In that case, return to me once you made up your mind.
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_3: [EN] Take this armor as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend!
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_4: [EN] Please make sure you have free slots in your store inbox.
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_5: [EN] You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_7: [EN] Take this helmet as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend.
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_8: [EN] You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
npc.emperor_kruzak.stdmod_1: [EN] I can promote you for 20000 gold coins. Do you want me to promote you?
npc.emperor_rehal.multi_1: [EN] Splendid! My son Rehon set off on an expedition to the deeper mines. He and a group of dwarfs were to search for new veins of crystal. Unfortunately they have been missing for 2 weeks now. ...
npc.emperor_rehal.multi_2: [EN] Find my son and if he's alive bring him back. You will find a reactivated ore wagon tunnel at the entrance of the great citadel which leades to the deeper mines. If you encounter problems within the tunnel go ask Xorlosh, he can help you.
npc.emperor_rehal.say_1: [EN] May Fire and Earth bless you, stranger. What leads you to Beregar, the dwarven city?
npc.emperor_rehal.say_2: [EN] I always liked him and I still can't believe that he really stole that ring.
npc.emperor_rehal.say_3: [EN] Interesting. The fact that you have the ring means that Nokmir can't have stolen it. Combined with the information Grombur gave you, the case appears in a completely different light. ...
npc.emperor_rehal.say_4: [EN] Let there be justice for all. Nokmir is innocent and acquitted from all charges! And Rerun... I want him in prison for this malicious act!
npc.emperor_rehal.say_5: [EN] He's very ambitious and always volunteers for the long shifts.
npc.emperor_rehal.say_6: [EN] As you have proven yourself trustworthy I'm going to assign you a special mission. Are you interested?
npc.emperor_rehal.say_7: [EN] My son was captured by trolls? Doesn't sound like him, but if you say so. Now you want a reward, huh? ...
npc.emperor_rehal.say_8: [EN] Look at these dwarven legs. They were forged years ago by a dwarf who was rather tall for our kind. I want you to have them. Thank you for rescuing my son |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.emperor_rehal.say_9: [EN] Alright then, come back when you are ready.
npc.emperor_rehal.stdmod_1: [EN] I can promote you for 20000 gold coins. Do you want me to promote you?
npc.erayo.greet_msg_1: [EN] What the... I mean, of course I sensed you.
npc.erayo.multi_1: [EN] Thought so. Could use some help anyway. Listen, I need stuff. Someone gave me a strange assignment - sneak into Thais castle at night and shroud it with cloth without anyone noticing it. ...
npc.erayo.multi_2: [EN] I wonder why anyone would want to shroud a castle, but as long as long as the guy pays, no problem, I'll do the sneaking part. Need a lot of cloth though. ...
npc.erayo.multi_3: [EN] Gonna make it colourful. Bring me 50 pieces of {blue cloth}, 50 pieces of {green cloth}, 50 pieces of {red cloth}, 50 pieces of {brown cloth}, 50 pieces of {yellow cloth} and 50 pieces of {white cloth}. ...
npc.erayo.multi_4: [EN] Besides, gonna need 10 {spools of yarn}. Understood?
npc.erayo.say_1: [EN] Vescu gave you an assassin outfit? Haha. Noticed it lacks the head piece? You look a bit silly. Want my old head piece?
npc.erayo.say_2: [EN] Good. Start with the blue cloth. I'll wait.
npc.erayo.say_3: [EN] You don't have the required items.
npc.erayo.stage_1_progress: [EN] Good. Get me 50 pieces of green cloth now.

npc.eremo.farewell_msg_1: [EN] It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.eremo.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to my little garden, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.eremo.say_1: [EN] A letter from that youngster Morgan? I believed him dead since years. These news are good news indeed. Thank you very much, my friend.
npc.eremo.stdmod_1: [EN] Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.eremo.stdmod_10:
[EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, \
		the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. \
		Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.eremo.stdmod_11: [EN] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.eremo.stdmod_12: [EN] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.eremo.stdmod_13: [EN] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.eremo.stdmod_14:
[EN] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by \
		the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.eremo.stdmod_15: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.eremo.stdmod_16: [EN] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.eremo.stdmod_17: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.eremo.stdmod_18: [EN] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.eremo.stdmod_2: [EN] So receive the wisdom of solitude, pilgrim.
npc.eremo.stdmod_3: [EN] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.eremo.stdmod_4: [EN] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.eremo.stdmod_5:
[EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional \
		protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.eremo.stdmod_6: [EN] Should I teleport you back to Pemaret?
npc.eremo.stdmod_9:
[EN] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a \
		chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, \
		this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.eremo.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.eroth.farewell_1: [EN] Asha Thrazi. Go, where you have to go.
npc.eroth.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Asha Thrazi. Go, where you have to go.
npc.eroth.multi_1: [EN] Recently we found out that they are in the possession of a scrying crystal ball. They can hear all our discussions about tactics and upcoming attacks. ...
npc.eroth.multi_2: [EN] No wonder that they always have been so well prepared. Now you come into play, destroy the scrying crystal ball in Elvenbane. It should be on the top floor. ...
npc.eroth.multi_3: [EN] We don't really know how to destroy it but we suppose it may work if you reflect the invisible power of the ball. The beam should be adjusted to Ab'Dendriel. Take this mirror and give it a try. Good luck.
npc.eroth.say_1: [EN] Have you ever heard of Elvenbane? It is the castle west of Ab'Dendriel which is inhabited by villains from all over the continent. Any support in this war is welcome. Are you willing to help?
npc.eroth.say_2: [EN] I heard the blow! The reflection must have caused a overcharge of magical energy leading to the contraction and the implosion. Just like I hoped! Please take this as a reward. Thank you very much.
npc.eroth.stdmod_1: [EN] I am the leader of the Cenath caste.
npc.eroth.stdmod_2: [EN] The Kuridai are aggressive and victims of their instincts. Without our help they would surely die in a foolish war.
npc.eroth.stdmod_3: [EN] Gods are for the weak. We will master the world on our own. We need no gods.
npc.eroth.stdmod_4: [EN] They lack the understanding of unity. We are keeping them together and prevent them from being slaughtered one by one.
npc.eroth.stdmod_5: [EN] We are the shepherds of our people. The other castes need our guidance.
npc.eroth.stdmod_6: [EN] Magic comes almost naturally to the Cenath. We keep the secrets of ages.
npc.eroth.stdmod_7: [EN] I can teach the spells 'magic shield', 'destroy field', 'creature illusion', 'chameleon', 'convince creature', and 'summon creature'.

npc.eshaya.greet_msg_1: [EN] Suon's and Bastesh's blessing, dear guest!
npc.eshaya.multi_1: [EN] {Kilmaresh} and {Oramond} maintain important commercial relations, and for this reason Rathleton has an envoy here. In the past, the relations were good but now ..
npc.eshaya.multi_2: [EN] I hate to admit it but I heavily suspect that the current {Ambassador} is a traitor and consorts with the forbidden cult of {Fafnar}. I have several hints and {Kallimae} saw it in one of her visions. ...
npc.eshaya.multi_3: [EN] But the vision of a Kilmareshian seer is no proof they will ever accept in Rathleton. And without proof we can't banish the {Ambassador}, this would cause major diplomatic fallout or even a war. I can't risk that. ...
npc.eshaya.multi_4: [EN] I need unequivocal evidence that the {Ambassador} conspires with the Fafnar cultists. Please go to his residence in the eastern part of the city and search for letters, journals ... anything that could prove him guilty.
npc.eshaya.multi_5: [EN] I need unequivocal evidence that the {Ambassador} conspires with the Fafnar cultists. Please go to his residence in the eastern part of the city and search for letters, journals ... anything that could prove him guilty.
npc.eshaya.multi_6: [EN] But there is only one way to achieve this: You have to find a Ring of {Secret Thoughts}. Legend has it that a monstrous being called {Urmahlullu} has such a ring. If the myths are true you can find this creature in a subterranean tomb south of Issavi.
npc.eshaya.multi_7: [EN] But there is only one way to achieve this: You have to find a Ring of {Secret Thoughts}. Legend has it that a monstrous being called {Urmahlullu} has such a ring. If the myths are true you can find this creature in a subterranean tomb south of Issavi.
npc.eshaya.say_1: [EN] Very good. But now you need the Ring of Secret Thoughts back in order to extract the Ambassador's memories.
npc.eshaya.say_2: [EN] You found the Ring of Secret Thoughts! Well done! Now give it to the Ambassador as a present. He's a peacock and will accept such a precious gift for sure. As soon as he wears it, his memories will be stored in the ring.
npc.eshaya.say_3: [EN] I'm willing to admit that I need help. And the help of someone who is not from {Issavi} at that. But the task could be dangerous and you would become embroiled in the politics and court intrigues of {Kilmaresh}. Will you help me anyhow?
npc.eshaya.say_4: [EN] This is the proof we need! Very well done! You have to report this to our {Empress}. She will grant you an audience now.
npc.eshaya.say_5: [EN] You haven't completed your mission yet. Keep searching!
npc.eshaya.say_6: [EN] I don't know whether you are experienced in such things. If not, you could ask somebody who is. But I'm not sure where in Issavi you should look to hire a thief.
npc.eshaya.say_7: [EN] I guess claiming back a present would be a bit suspicious. You'll have to find another way. I resent thinking about theft but sometimes, desperate times call for desperate measures.
npc.eshaya.say_8: [EN] You got the ring back? Very well done! Now search for the memories that will prove the Ambassador's treason. I don't know much about ancient artefacts but you could ask the librarian in the palace. I'm sure he knows something helpful.
npc.eshaya.say_9: [EN] Good luck on your audience with the Empress. May Kilmaresh prosper.
npc.eshaya.voice_2: [EN] I should talk to Kallimae soon.
npc.eshaya.voice_3: [EN] Issavi's safety is my first concern.
npc.esrik.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello, |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to my little forge.
npc.eustacio.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello my friend. What a delight to see you, even on a busy day. You can check your status or ask me about the location of ongoing raids.
npc.eustacio.greet_msg_2: [EN] Hello my friend. What a delight to see you, even on a {busy} day. I see you already talked to my agent. I'm willing to lend you my boat if you want to take a {shortcut}. ...
npc.eustacio.multi_1: [EN] You are trustworthy enough to take my boat. My agent made sure it takes me to their island. Do you want to take it?
npc.eustacio.say_1: [EN] I am Eustacio. At your service.
npc.eustacio.say_2: [EN] It's just the time to make a fortune.
npc.eustacio.say_3: [EN]  I am an aspiring businessman, who thrives to climb the ladder of success in the Venorean society.
npc.eva.greet_msg_1: [EN] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.eva.voice_1: [EN] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.example_merchant.greeting: [EN] Hello {0}! Welcome to my shop. Say {trade} to see my offers.
npc.example_merchant.help: [EN] I can sell you potions, weapons and armor. Say {trade} to browse my goods.
npc.example_merchant.job: [EN] I am a merchant. I sell various goods to adventurers.
npc.example_merchant.low_level: [EN] Sorry, but you are too inexperienced. Come back when you reach level 8.
npc.example_merchant.name: [EN] My name is Marcus. I run this shop.
npc.example_merchant.news_1: [EN] Have you heard? Dragons were spotted near the mountains!
npc.example_merchant.news_2: [EN] The king is looking for brave adventurers.
npc.example_merchant.special: [EN] Today we have a special offer: {0} with {1}% discount!
npc.example_merchant.trade: [EN] Of course! Here are my offers.
npc.example_merchant_i18n.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello {}! Welcome to my shop. Say {trade} to see my offers.
npc.example_merchant_i18n.stdmod_2: [EN] Of course! Here are my offers.
npc.ezebeth.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello! I guess you are here for a {mission}.
npc.ezebeth.multi_1: [EN] We provide addons to people dedicated to our city. So the first addon is granted to someone who has voted for each of the available shortcuts and each dungeon at least once. ...
npc.ezebeth.multi_2: [EN] The second addon is granted to someone who has voted for each bossfight at least once.
npc.ezebeth.say_1: [EN] Well, there is little where we need help beyond the normal tasks you can do for the city. However, there is one thing out of the ordinary where some {assistance} would be appreciated.
npc.ezebeth.say_2: [EN] You already asked for a mission, go to the next.
npc.ezebeth.say_3: [EN] It's nothing really important, so no one has yet found the time to look it up. It concerns the town's beggars that have started to behave {strange} lately.
npc.ezebeth.say_4: [EN] They usually know better than to show up in the streets and harass our citizens, but lately they've grown more bold or desperate or whatever. I ask you to investigate what they are up to. If necessary, you may scare them away a bit.
npc.fa_hradin.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Farewell, human. I will always remember you. Unless I forget you, of course.
npc.fa_hradin.multi_1: [EN] Don't waste any more time. We need the spyreport of our man in Mal'ouquah as soon as possible! ...
npc.fa_hradin.multi_10: [EN] In order to stay informed about our enemy's doings, we have managed to plant a spy in Mal'ouquah. ...
npc.fa_hradin.multi_11: [EN] He has kept the Efreet and Malor under surveillance for quite some time. ...
npc.fa_hradin.multi_12: [EN] But unfortunately, I have lost contact with him months ago. ...
npc.fa_hradin.multi_13: [EN] I do not fear for his safety because his cover is foolproof, but I cannot contact him either. This is where you come in. ...
npc.fa_hradin.multi_14: [EN] I do not have to add that this is a dangerous mission, do I? If you are discovered expect to be attacked! So goodluck, human!
npc.fa_hradin.multi_15: [EN] I do not have to add that this is a dangerous mission, do I? If you are discovered expect to be attacked! So goodluck, human!
npc.fa_hradin.multi_17: [EN] |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
npc.fa_hradin.multi_2: [EN] Also don't forget the password to contact our man: PIEDPIPER!
npc.fa_hradin.multi_3: [EN] You really have made it? You have the report? How come you did not get slaughtered? I must say I'm impressed. Your race will never cease to surprise me. ...
npc.fa_hradin.multi_5: [EN] I think I need to talk to Gabel about this. I am sure he will know what to do. Perhaps you should have a word with him, too.
npc.fa_hradin.multi_6: [EN] Don't waste any more time. We need the spyreport of our man in Mal'ouquah as soon as possible! ...
npc.fa_hradin.multi_7: [EN] Also don't forget the password to contact our man: PIEDPIPER!
npc.fa_hradin.multi_8: [EN] I have heard some good things about you from Bo'ques. But I don't know. ...
npc.fa_hradin.multi_9: [EN] Well, all right. I do have a job for you. ...
npc.fa_hradin.say_1: [EN] Whoa! A human! This is no place for you, |PLAYERNAME|. Go and play somewhere else.
npc.fa_hradin.say_2: [EN] Aaaah... what have we here. A human - interesting. And such an ugly specimen, too... All right, human |PLAYERNAME|. How can I help you?
npc.fa_hradin.say_3: [EN] Looking for work, are you? Well, it's very tempting, you know, but I'm afraid we do not really employ beginners. Perhaps our cook could need a helping hand in the kitchen.
npc.fa_hradin.say_4: [EN] Did you already retrieve the spyreport?
npc.fa_hradin.say_5: [EN] Did you already talk to Gabel about the report? I think he will have further instructions for you.
npc.fa_hradin.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Farewell, human. I will always remember you. Unless I forget you, of course.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_1: [EN] I'm professor Falonzo from the mage's guild.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_10:
[EN] Something is tearing at the fabric of reality. I can't tell what is it but the {boundaries} between worlds are fading. ... \z
	A process that what watched for over a century but which has extremely grown in momentum over the last few years. Something is happening and it's for sure nothing good. ... \z
	Be it as it may, the plane trying to reconnect was only a side effect. It still might teach us about what is happening and it has for sure attracted some {attention} already.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_11:
[EN] We know about other planes of existence but in all history it has never been as easy to reach them as it is now. ... \z
	Sometimes world seem to overlap and we can identify more and more such planes and worlds. More then we ever had imagined. All we can tell is, that something is changing. And not for the good.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_2: [EN] I'm a researcher of scientific council of the mage guild and I came to that {place} to study this {anomaly}.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_3: [EN] This is a lesser plane of tarnished, elemental fire that once belonged to the world that we know. It was despoiled in the wars of the gods and broke loose from our world. {Lost} and drifting through the void, without a connection to our plane.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_4: [EN] Infernalists were the first who found their way into this sphere. Hoping to tap its rotten power somehow. Yet this sphere created creatures of its own and draw others here from other planes.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_5: [EN] Well, that was how it used to be. Lost and without any connection to our world. But that was before things ... have {changed}.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_6: [EN] Such an anomaly can't go unnoticed for long. That lead to the presence to unwanted {intruders} and other entities were {dragged} into by the nature of the sphere.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_7:
[EN] This {plane} is now inhabited by {intruders} and creatures that accidentally became {dragged} in. ... \z
	It is neither completely of our world nor is it still that disconnected and unreachable as it used to be. I fear it's only a harbinger of something more dangerous and more {sinister}.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_8:
[EN] Well, the whole place here is an anomaly so to say. You can hardly have missed the fact that you arrived here through a mystical gate. ... \z
	Well actually it's no gate at all but a rift in the fabric of nature. It is this minor {plane} trying to reconnect to our world.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_9:
[EN] This place became a fiery trap to certain beings with an affinity to fire. Somehow it reconnects randomly with the known world, to which it once belonged ... \z
	but also to other places that it shares some affinity with like hellish places of unspeakable evil that spawn infernal creatures.
npc.faloriel.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings, dear guest and welcome to my {potion} shop.
npc.faloriel.say_1: [EN] So, the Librarian sent you. Well, yes, I have a vial of the hallucinogen you need. I'll give it to you for 1000 gold. Do you agree?
npc.faloriel.say_2: [EN] I don't have anything to offer you regarding a ring.
npc.faloriel.say_4: [EN] You do not have enough money.
npc.faloriel.voice_1: [EN] Health potions! Mana potions! Buy them here!
npc.faloriel.voice_2: [EN] All kinds of potions available here!
npc.farhilorn_of_the_winter_court.greet_: [EN] Hello fighter. I guess you are here to {fight} for our noble {cause}.
npc.farhilorn_of_the_winter_court.say_1: [EN] We allow able champions of all races to fight for our cause against the challenges of the {arena}. So are you interested? I'm not interested in fancy'wordplay, so a simple {yes} or {no} will suffice!
npc.farhilorn_of_the_winter_court.say_2: [EN] You are now able to enter the teleport.
npc.farhilorn_of_the_winter_court.say_4: [EN] This place has always been a site where the champions of summer and winter have clashed in battle. Over the centuries this spectacle has drawn many creatures here to watch, participate and indulge in less savory activities.
npc.feizuhl.greet_msg_1: [EN] Be mourned pilgrim in flesh and welcome to the furniture store.
npc.feizuhl.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain type of furniture?
npc.feizuhl.voice_1: [EN] I sell furniture both to the mourned and the enlightened.

npc.ferus.stdmod_1: [EN] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.ferus.stdmod_11: [EN] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.ferus.stdmod_12: [EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.ferus.stdmod_13: [EN] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.ferus.stdmod_14: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.ferus.stdmod_15: [EN] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.ferus.stdmod_16: [EN] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.ferus.stdmod_17: [EN] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.ferus.stdmod_18: [EN] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.ferus.stdmod_19: [EN] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.ferus.stdmod_2: [EN] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.ferus.stdmod_20: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.

npc.ferus.stdmod_22: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.

[EN] This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z

npc.flickering_soul.say_1: [EN] It has been a while since I roamed the world of the living in a mortal shell.
npc.flickering_soul.say_10: [EN] Thank you for accepting this burden.
npc.flickering_soul.say_11: [EN] You haven't killed Malice yet. You haven't killed Hatred yet. You haven't killed Spite yet. You haven't killed Cruelty yet. You haven't killed Greed yet.
npc.flickering_soul.say_12: [EN] My daughter was as ambitious as me, yet she lacked my intellect and my raw talent. She still was great and talented yet I sadly let her feel my disdain. One of the many errors that my way of hubris made me do.
npc.flickering_soul.say_13: [EN] I'm not aware of the fate of my linage. Neither I'm able to relate to the mortal world in that way. Each of us is an individual, not bound by ties of blood or herritage.
npc.flickering_soul.say_14: [EN] His avatar might be destroyed for now and it'd grip on Zarganash considerably weakened. Yet he burrowed to deep into the essence of this realm to be annihilated this easy.
npc.flickering_soul.say_15: [EN] I despised my followers for their petty agendas and for their limited vision of my own goals and personality.
npc.flickering_soul.say_16: [EN] I have cleansed you from the taints that you carried with you. You are now free from the burden that you should not have to bear.
npc.flickering_soul.say_17: [EN] You are not tainted by the darkness of the world. You are pure and free from the burdens that others carry.
npc.flickering_soul.say_18: [EN] I was once known as the necromant king. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_19: [EN] For some it was meant as a curse, others used the name with reverence. To me it was just another stepping stone, in a life that burned with ambition.
npc.flickering_soul.say_2: [EN] I had many names in my live. The one that would be the most recognizable is probably the name Goshnar. Even that was an assumed name that I took when I left my mundane past behind.
npc.flickering_soul.say_20: [EN] My ambitions were high and knew no limits. Mastery over life and death was but a milestone that I wanted to accomplish. In the end I aspired probably somewhat like godhood. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_21: [EN] Though in hindsight even that wouldn't have been enough. There was a hunger in me that nothing could put to rest.
npc.flickering_soul.say_22: [EN] I was so convinced about my brilliance, my greatness, my destiny. And this hunger for more, it let me not have peace at any point in my life. I was always driven. There was no time to rest. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_23: [EN] And there was no looking back. I never cared to remember my humble beginnings, what I had sacrificed to get where I was. All that I had left behind and that I had lost forever. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_24: [EN] Now I see the bitter irony. I could bring back the dead, but I couldn't create second chances. I couldn't restore the truly important things that I had lost.
npc.flickering_soul.say_25: [EN] Zarganash was not a place without its dangers, but for a soul as powerful as mine, there was little threat at all. For the first time in my existence I had to stop running forward. I had to wait for things to fit into their places. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_26: [EN] And me, who had seen things that horrible, they would have obliterated a lesser man's mind, finally took the time to look back. And what I saw was frightening in its own right. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_27: [EN] A great tiredness overcame me. With the flames of my ambitions calming down for the first time since I could remember, all my aspirations and plans seemed to petty and futile. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_28: [EN] Everything I had worked for and my plans for the things to come seemed pointless, and the things I had lost and never allowed myself to experience weighed heavily on my soul.
npc.flickering_soul.say_29: [EN] I talked to other souls, lost in Zarganash, and most of them seemed like mirrors to myself. Their faults, their shortcomings, the things that were important to them and the things they had lost. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_3: [EN] Everything in my life was just a tool to further my goals. The brotherhood of bones was just a tool for me. As was everyone or everything. In the path I had chosen nothing mattered but me and my ambitions.
npc.flickering_soul.say_30: [EN] It was all like miniature copies of my own grand plans and losses. It made me think. And the great tiredness weighed even more heavy on me. A weariness of the world, of the hunger that drove me.
npc.flickering_soul.say_31: [EN] Then I met a wise soul. A teacher that did not lecture. I never was impressed by anything but my own accomplishments. But the inner balance and peace of this soul, it did impress me. A lot. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_32: [EN] I, who fancied myself to have been the epitome of knowledge, learned things that were entirely new to me. But this knowledge wasn't about power. It was about me.
npc.flickering_soul.say_33: [EN] I decided to stay here, even pass on into the great beyond at some point. Yet I still feel the pull of my fetters. I can faintly hear those who think they are my followers, calling to me.
npc.flickering_soul.say_34: [EN] And I feel others, many others who crave my powers and try to bring me back for their own gain.
npc.flickering_soul.say_35: [EN] Over my time in Zarganash I split away the parts of me that my worldly fetters were bound to. Yet I had to recognize that they are still a part of me and I'm bound to them. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_36: [EN] The fetters and the efforts to call me back are empowering them. I feel them growing in strength and gaining awareness on their own. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_37: [EN] They are beginning to feed not only on the fetters and incarnations but also on me. As I grow weaker, they grow more powerful over time.
npc.flickering_soul.say_38: [EN] You did it! For the first time I can feel free from the pull of my past. Now I'm free at last. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_39: [EN] I might stay a while and teach other souls about the inner peace, but will eventually pass on. Thank you so much, my hero. My eternal gratitude and blessings will be with you!
npc.flickering_soul.say_4: [EN] Necromancy was a passion at first, another tool while I amassed power and a crutch when my ambitions surpassed that what it could accomplish.
npc.flickering_soul.say_40: [EN] You will have to reach each of the negative parts of my personality that I split away. They are hidden deep in the depths of Zarganash and will have corrupted and twisted their surroundings into dangerous nightmares. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_41: [EN] Even worse, you'll likely encounter minions of those who want to claim my soul as their prize for their own depraved reasons. You will have to destroy my shards to set me free.
npc.flickering_soul.say_42: [EN] I hated the world for its flaws and the reluctance of people to comply with my will. I was convinced I was destined for greatness and to change everything. Ordinary beings were far beneath me and my consideration. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_43: [EN] All this opposition, all the wars were a nuisance on my way to greatness. I would have sacrificed the whole world to reach my goals.
npc.flickering_soul.say_44: [EN] Even in the lands of the dead, this one caused a stir. The dead were whispering his name. It made me feel jealous and angry at first, but at some point, after much self-reflection, I could recognize my own faults in the stories about him.
npc.flickering_soul.say_45: [EN] It was almost like looking into a mirror for the first time. However, he lived way later than me, and I never met his soul here, so I can't tell more about him.
npc.flickering_soul.say_46: [EN] They called me the necromant king, in an act of reverence, but to me it was always more of a slander. To limit my greatness to this insignificant aspect was an insult to my ego. But I let it slip for the greater good. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_47: [EN] I felt it was beneath me to correct them and I went along.

npc.flora.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings, {}. Well, we all know what time it is. Always when we meet, the citizens of rathleton voted for the {Glooth Fairy}! ... Well, the rules are as simples as always. Ask me for a {fight} and I'll teleport you into the room with the lever, therefore I'll charge one voting right. ... From this room there is no way back to me. Pull the trigger and after one minute you and your buddies will face the {Glooth Fairy}.
npc.flora.say_1: [EN] Do you really want to enter the Glooth Fairy's hideout. There is no chickening out and I also have to charge one voting right! {Yes} or {no}?
npc.florentine.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you?
npc.florentine.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares.
npc.frafnar.greet_msg_1: [EN] Don't you see that I'm trying to write a poem? <sighs> So what's the matter?
npc.frafnar.multi_1: [EN] Great! That's my breakthrough. Now she can't refuse to go out with me. I grant you access to the western part of the mine.
npc.frafnar.multi_2: [EN] So did you tell her that the cake came from me?
npc.frafnar.say_1: [EN] There is indeed something you could do for me. You must know, I'm in love with Bolfana. I'm sure she'd have a beer with me if I got her a chocolate cake. Problem is that I can't leave this door as I'm on duty. Would you be so kind and help me?
npc.frafnar.say_2: [EN] So did you tell her that the cake came from me?
npc.frafnar.say_3: [EN] Great! She works in the tavern of Beregar. It's situated in the western part of the city. Bring her a chocolate cake and tell her that it was me who sent it.
npc.frafnar.say_4: [EN] I hope your kidding 'cause I'll find out WHAT you've told her and I can get reeeeaaaalllly angry. I grant you access to the western part of the mine.....for NOW.
npc.frans.greet_msg_1: [EN] Beeee greeeeted, Simula! What is your neeeed?
npc.frans.say_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.

npc.frederik.say_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.

npc.freezhild.say_2: [EN] I'm wondering why you are doing this. Well, we accept the gift. Don't think that this makes you a friend though.
npc.freezhild.say_3: [EN] You don't have any crate of weapons!
npc.freezhild.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] I hope you have a cold day, friend.
