npc.frodo.stdmod_1: [EN] Come into my tavern and share some stories!
npc.frodo.stdmod_11: [EN] Ah yes, the graveyard dungeon. All I know is this riddle: His Grave to the south, the tree above, his soul in the shade. No idea what that means, though!
npc.frodo.stdmod_12: [EN]  I heard it when I was a child.
npc.frodo.stdmod_13: [EN] Yes, I remember him. His name was Berfasmur.
npc.frodo.stdmod_14: [EN] Sorry, he spoke only very little. I know nothing more about him.
npc.frodo.stdmod_15: [EN] Come on! You know that our world is called Tibia.
npc.frodo.stdmod_16: [EN] Nothing more than a tale for warriors.
npc.frodo.stdmod_17: [EN] Uhm, do not mention him. It may scare customers away.
npc.frodo.stdmod_18: [EN] No idea who that is, but maybe you'll find something in the Royal Archives...
npc.frodo.stdmod_19: [EN] Oh, the Royal Archives are in Rain Castle!
npc.frodo.stdmod_2: [EN] I hope you like it. Would you like some {food}?
npc.frodo.stdmod_20: [EN] The king's residence has been renovated lately.
npc.frodo.stdmod_21: [EN] Many travellers tell funny stories about all the emancipated women in this northern town.
npc.frodo.stdmod_22: [EN] Here in Thais is the center of Tibia.
npc.frodo.stdmod_23: [EN] He is a little shy. In his youth he dreamed to become a druid.
npc.frodo.stdmod_24: [EN] He's able to drink a bottle or two.
npc.frodo.stdmod_25: [EN] I am trying to hire him for an evening or two.
npc.frodo.stdmod_26: [EN] Oh, that old guy! He's a good customer, that's for sure.
npc.frodo.stdmod_27: [EN] Can you believe that she actually told her guildfellows that alcohol is a bad thing?
npc.frodo.stdmod_28: [EN] She makes excellent arrows and bows.
npc.frodo.stdmod_29: [EN] Many of his customers visit my Hut, too.
npc.frodo.stdmod_3: [EN] I am the owner of this saloon. I call it Frodo's Hut. I am also {selling} food.
npc.frodo.stdmod_30: [EN] The knights have sometimes parties here after some arena fights.
npc.frodo.stdmod_32: [EN] I think some time ago a stranger from Fibula with that name stayed here for some nights.
npc.frodo.stdmod_33: [EN] I overheard some conversations about his evilness. That's enough to hope, that I never ever meet him.
npc.frodo.stdmod_34: [EN] A sorceress, you can find her in their guild sitting befor a book - always!
npc.frodo.stdmod_35: [EN] Just between you and me: What a babe!
npc.frodo.stdmod_36: [EN] Marvik seldom leaves his guildhall at all.
npc.frodo.stdmod_37: [EN] The McRonalds are a nice couple. Donald is a dear friend of mine.
npc.frodo.stdmod_38: [EN] Muriel has never visited this place.
npc.frodo.stdmod_39: [EN] I hate him. Each of his visits here ends with a bar brawl.
npc.frodo.stdmod_4: [EN] I can offer you bread, cheese, ham, or meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
npc.frodo.stdmod_40: [EN] He hardly visits my humble tavern.
npc.frodo.stdmod_41: [EN] A loud neighbour, I get a lot of complaints about him.
npc.frodo.stdmod_42: [EN] That fellow is filthy rich. He rented a room upstairs for months in advance and always orders the best beer and wine i serve.
npc.frodo.stdmod_5: [EN] Some travelers from Edron told about a great treasure guarded by cruel demons in the dungeons there.
npc.frodo.stdmod_6: [EN] Oh, our beloved king! Thanks to him, alcohol is so cheap.
npc.frodo.stdmod_7: [EN] Harkath Bloodblade is the royal general.
npc.frodo.voice_1: [EN] Come into my tavern and share some stories!
npc.frodo.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Please come back from time to time.
npc.frosty.greet_msg_1: [EN] No, you can't have my nose! If you're in need of a {carrot}, go to the market or just dig up one! Or did you come to bring me a {percht skull}?
npc.frosty.say_1: [EN] For a {} you will need {}. Do you have it with you?
npc.frosty.say_2: [EN] I can give you one of the following sleighs: {{}}.
npc.frosty.say_3: [EN] Nasty creatures especially their queen that sits frozzen on her throne beneath this island.
npc.frosty.say_5: [EN] You do not have needed items!
npc.frosty.say_6: [EN] Just tell me which {sleigh} you want to know more about.
npc.frosty.say_7: [EN] Come back when you get these items.
npc.frosty.say_8: [FR] For a {} you will need {}. Do you have it with you?
npc.frosty.stdmod_1: [EN] What about 'no' do you not understand, hrm? You are more annoying than any {percht} around here! Not to mention those bothersome {bunnies} who try to graw away my nose!
npc.frosty.stdmod_2: [EN] Well why didn't you say that rightaway, if you give me such a skull I can give you one of my {sleighs}.
npc.frosty.stdmod_3: [EN] Always trying to eat my nose!
npc.gabel.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Farewell, stranger. May Uman open your minds and your hearts to Daraman's wisdom!
npc.gabel.multi_1: [EN] So you've been there and faced Merikh the Slaughterer! Whether you killed him or not, I hope your presence at least scared him. He is so mighty that we can only hope to truly defeat him one day. ...
npc.gabel.multi_10: [EN] All right. Listen! Thanks to Rata'mari's report we now know what Malor is up to: he wants to do to me what I have done to him - he wants to imprison me in Fa'hradin's lamp! ...
npc.gabel.multi_11: [EN] Of course, that won't happen. Now, we know his plans. ...
npc.gabel.multi_12: [EN] But I am aiming at something different. We have learnt one important thing: At this point of time, Malor does not have the lamp yet, which means it is still where he left it. We need that lamp! If we get it back we can imprison him again! ...
npc.gabel.multi_13: [EN] From all we know the lamp is still in the Orc King's possession! Therefore I want to ask you to enter thewell guarded halls over at Ulderek's Rock and find the lamp. ...
npc.gabel.multi_14: [EN] Once you have acquired the lamp you must enter Mal'ouquah again. Sneak into Malor's personal chambersand exchange his sleeping lamp with Fa'hradin's lamp! ...
npc.gabel.multi_15: [EN] If you succeed, the war could be over one night later! I and all djinn will be in your debt forever! May Daraman watch over you!
npc.gabel.multi_16: [EN] Sooo. Fa'hradin has told me about your extraordinary exploit, and I must say I am impressed. ...
npc.gabel.multi_17: [EN] Your fragile human form belies your courage and your fighting spirit. ...
npc.gabel.multi_18: [EN] I hardly dare to ask you because you have already done so much for us, but there is a task to be done, and I cannot think of anybody else who would be better suited to fulfill it than you. ...
npc.gabel.multi_19: [EN] Think carefully, human, for this mission will bring you into real danger. Are you prepared to do us that final favour?
npc.gabel.multi_2: [EN] When you've recovered from your fight and would like to kill green djinns in our service again, just talk to me about that task.
npc.gabel.multi_20: [EN] So you would like to fight for us, would you. Hmm. ...
npc.gabel.multi_21: [EN] That is a noble resolution you have made there, human, but I'm afraid I cannot accept your generous offer at this point of time. ...
npc.gabel.multi_22: [EN] Do not get me wrong, but I am not the kind of guy to send an inexperienced soldier into certain death! So you might ask around here for a more suitable mission.
npc.gabel.multi_24: [EN] |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
npc.gabel.multi_3: [EN] You've done it, human! Daraman be praised! Take this for your efforts. ...
npc.gabel.multi_4: [EN] What's left to do now is seek out Merikh the Slaughterer, an especially cruel Efreet. He hides somewhere in Yalahar. I don't know if you can kill him, but you should at least try.
npc.gabel.multi_5: [EN] You've proven to be an experienced soldier, human. Though I still hope the war to be over soon, the Efreet are still threatening our tower. ...
npc.gabel.multi_6: [EN] Thus we need your help in killing the green ones. If you kill 500 green djinns or Efreet for us, I'll reward you with bonus experience and some extra gold pieces. Do you agree?
npc.gabel.multi_7: [EN] Daraman shall bless you and all humans! You have done us all a huge service! Soon, this awful war will be over! ...
npc.gabel.multi_8: [EN] Know, that from now on you are considered one of us and are welcome to trade with Haroun and Nah'bob whenever you want to!
npc.gabel.multi_9: [EN] Farewell, stranger. May Uman open your minds and your hearts to Daraman's wisdom!
npc.gabel.say_1: [EN] Whoa! A human! This is no place for you, |PLAYERNAME|. Go and play somewhere else.
npc.gabel.say_2: [EN] Welcome, human |PLAYERNAME|, to our humble abode.
npc.gabel.say_3: [EN] You haven't finished your final mission yet. Shall I explain it again to you?
npc.gabel.say_4: [EN] Have you found Fa'hradin's lamp and placed it in Malor's personal chambers?
npc.gabel.say_5: [EN] There's no mission left for you, friend of the Marid. However, I have a task for you.
npc.gabel.say_7: [EN] Don't give up! May Daraman watch over you!
npc.gabel.say_8: [EN] Come back when you kill 500 green djinns or Efreet.
npc.gabel.say_9: [EN] All right. May Daraman bless your hunt, human.
npc.gabel.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Farewell, stranger. May Uman open your minds and your hearts to Daraman's wisdom!
npc.gail.say_1: [EN] I always feared that I lost her. And yet, all those years, I still had a gleam of hope. I'm devastated to learn about her fate - but at least I have certainty now. Thank you for telling me.
npc.galuna.greet_msg_1: [EN] Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What do you need? Distance weapons? I sell lots of them.
npc.galuna.voice_1: [EN] Bows, crossbows and ammunition on special sale today.
npc.gamel.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Bye. Tell others about... my little shop here.
npc.gamel.greet_msg_1: [EN] Pssst! Be silent. Do you wish to {buy} something?
npc.gamel.say_1: [EN] I don't like the way you look. Help me boys!
npc.gamel.say_2: [EN] You have a letter for me?
npc.gamel.say_3: [EN] Oh well. I guess I am still on the hook. Tell your 'uncle' I will proceed as he suggested.
npc.gamel.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Bye. Tell others about... my little shop here.
npc.gamon.farewell_msg_1: [EN] You'll come back. They all do.
npc.gamon.greet_msg_1: [EN] Nice to meet you, Mister |PLAYERNAME|! Looking for furniture? You've come to the right place!
npc.gamon.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain type of furniture?
npc.gamon.stdmod_1: [EN] Any time's a good time to buy some furniture!
npc.gamon.stdmod_2: [EN] Making a stake from a chair? Are you insane??! I won't waste my chairs on you for free! You will have to pay for it, but since I consider your plan a blasphemy, it will cost 5000 gold pieces. Okay?
npc.gamon.stdmod_3: [EN] Argh... my heart aches! Alright... a promise is a promise. Here - take this wooden stake, and now get lost.
npc.gamon.stdmod_4: [EN] You can't even pay for that.
npc.gamon.voice_1: [EN] Any time's a good time to buy some furniture!
npc.garamond.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, child. Have you come to learn about {magic}? Then you are in the right place. I can teach you many useful {spells}.
npc.garamond.say_1: [EN] Spells are very useful in combat - not only for mages, though of course we particularly rely on them for much of our damage output. ...
npc.garamond.say_10: [EN] Ah, the beauty of our world! It is vast and extraordinarily diverse. Strange islands, beautiful cities and fierce monsters that roam the wildernesses. Mysteries, adventures, danger around every corner. ...
npc.garamond.say_11: [EN] Once you have reached level 8, you are ready to choose a vocation and go to the Tibian Mainland.
npc.garamond.say_12: [EN] Your choice of vocation will determine your life in Tibia, and the skills and fighting techniques you may use. ...
npc.garamond.say_13: [EN] There are four vocation: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. If you want to know more about them, talk to Oressa in the temple. ...
npc.garamond.say_14: [EN] I myself teach try-out spells for both the magical classes, whereas Tybald in the next room specialises in knight and paladin spells.
npc.garamond.say_15: [EN] A very intelligent girl. Prefers to listen to wild animals' noises instead of humans', which is quite understandable when you think about it. ...
npc.garamond.say_16: [EN] However, she's also a very apt healer and can give you advice on your choice of vocation.
npc.garamond.say_2: [EN] There's a broad variety of what spells can do, as you will see as you progress further. The next spells you can buy with level 8 and on. ...
npc.garamond.say_3: [EN] Some attack spells can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having an effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other spells protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...
npc.garamond.say_4: [EN] Each vocation has its own individual spells that none of the other vocations can use. You can only learn spells at a spell trainer of your vocation. ...
npc.garamond.say_5: [EN] The spells here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...
npc.garamond.say_6: [EN] There, you can go to a spell teacher in a city to permanently learn a spell.
npc.garamond.say_7: [EN] The Mainland offers many more adventures, dangers and quests than this small isle, and also has spell teachers where you can permanently learn a spell for your vocation. ...
npc.garamond.say_8: [EN] Once you reach level 8 you may choose your definite vocation and leave for Main. Go to a city and seek out the spell trainer of your vocation to learn a spell. And make sure you have enough gold! ...
npc.garamond.say_9: [EN] The art of spell teaching is complex and dangerous, and we will only impart our valuable knowledge of a spell to a novice if they can pay the price.
npc.garamond.stdmod_1: [EN] In this category I have '{Lighthealing}', '{Healfriend}', and '{Curepoison}'.
npc.garamond.stdmod_10: [EN] Roughened and toughened by life's tragedies. A good man, but somber.
npc.garamond.stdmod_11: [EN] Yes, child. If you wish to learn a spell, tell me.
npc.garamond.stdmod_12:
[EN] A very headstrong young man, though I appreciate his devotion to the craft of potion-making. \z
		No respect for senior authority or age at all! Except maybe for a little soft spot for Mr Morris.
npc.garamond.stdmod_13:
[EN] A strange young man. He seems driven, to my mind. By what force, I do not know. \z
		I take it the world needs adventurers such as him.
npc.garamond.stdmod_14:
[EN] Redeeming one's soul by becoming a clerk? Not very likely. Once a pirate, always a pirate. \z
		But he's a charming old rogue.
npc.garamond.stdmod_15:
[EN] Not a half bad cook, truly. Must have been that squirrel diet, it seems to have lead him to \z
		discover a new cuisine - everything to forget the bad taste of squirrels, he said.
npc.garamond.stdmod_16:
[EN] He is proficient in the martial arts. A very skilled teacher of spells for knights and paladins. \z
		If that is your vocation, you should talk to Ser Tybald.
npc.garamond.stdmod_17:
[EN] Ah, yes. Travelled with Plunderpurse a lot as I recall. Captain Plunderpurse, then. \z
			Got his head full of numbers and statistics, that boy.
npc.garamond.stdmod_2:
[EN] In this category I have '{Findperson}', '{Magicrope}', '{Levitate}', '{Light}', \z
		'{Greatlight}', '{Haste}', '{Poisonfield}', '{Firefield}', '{Lightmagicmissile}' and '{Energyfield}'.
npc.garamond.stdmod_4:
[EN] I can teach you {healing spells}, {support spells} and {attack spells}. \z
		What kind of spell do you wish to learn?
npc.garamond.stdmod_6:
[EN] Did you not listen? I am the teacher of druid and sorcerer spells for level 8 to 18. \z
		I teach young adventurers spells they can use once they have the proper vocation - druid or sorcerer.
npc.garamond.stdmod_7: [EN] I have an old friend there. Haven't heard from him in a while.
npc.garamond.stdmod_8:
[EN] Oh, it's not too bad here, believe me. At least I always get young and enthusiast disciples! \z
		Though I must confess I miss the vastness of the Tibian plains. <sighs>
npc.garamond.stdmod_9:
[EN] A kind old hunter. He loves to see young life around, taking on the ways and lays of the land. \z
		If you have any question, ask Inigo for help.
npc.gareth.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to the wonderful and only recently opened Museum of Tibian Arts! Free entrance for everybody, but patrons of the arts are wanted and favoured.
npc.gareth.greet_msg_2: [EN] The Druid of Crunor has sent you? He seems to know that this new museum shines like a diamond. Enjoy your stay! If you like to {support} this place, talk to me.
npc.gareth.greet_msg_4: [EN] You again? How could you flee from the last floor. The cultists should have 'dealt' with you! That beats me. You have to leave this place right now. There's nothing more to say.
npc.gareth.multi_1: [EN] Hmm, interesting. Several years ago I have read some books dealing with strange locking mechanisms. I think what you have found here is a bone lever of category 3. ...
npc.gareth.multi_10: [EN] Nice! I'm really happy to have the picture back. First of all I have to check if everything's fine. Then I'll put it back on its place. For now, I'd like you to find out if some rumours about fake pictures in the MOTA are true. ...
npc.gareth.multi_11: [EN] Then do your job here in the museum and come back.
npc.gareth.multi_12: [EN] Then do your job here in the museum and come back.
npc.gareth.multi_13: [EN] This is a very wise decision. You won't regret it. Congratulations! As your first task I like you to investigate the crime scene of a theft wich occurred last night. ...
npc.gareth.multi_14: [EN] A very varuable artefact has been stolen. I open the door for you. You can find the room on the same floor as we are right now.
npc.gareth.multi_2: [EN] Normally this is not used because it is not secure. The production failed and the lever can always be activated as follows: back, back, up, right, left. Just have a try, it should work.
npc.gareth.multi_3: [EN] Well, the situation is this: We have explored a portal, I would say a very aggressive, capriciously and dangerous one. Through this gate monsters entered the construction site and attacked our workers. ...
npc.gareth.multi_4: [EN] With enormous effort they could have been dispersed. When my fellows tried to fill up the portal, it appeared again and again. So the only thing they could do was to stop working for the moment. Are you eventually interested in further investigations?
npc.gareth.multi_5: [EN] You have found an inscription I would like to translate for you. The tibianus cipher was used: ...
npc.gareth.multi_6: [EN] Those who are accorded the honour to visit this exclusive place will smash their blindness and face the truth. ...
npc.gareth.multi_7: [EN] Astonishingly, Dedoras from Cormaya has recently asked me for these kinds of inscriptions. For sure he is able to bring light into the darkness. You should visit him.
npc.gareth.multi_8: [EN] You're back, nice. Angelo's team hasn't found an artefact yet? I thought the progress would be faster. Anyway thanks for you efforts. ...
npc.gareth.multi_9: [EN] I have no work for you right now. If you like to, you can have a look at the last floor. I open the door for you.
npc.gareth.say_1: [EN] If you like to, you can pay some gold to become a patron of the arts for this wonderful museum. The price is 10,000 gold. Your personal gain will be priceless. Do you want to {pay}?
npc.gareth.say_3: [EN] They want us to buy the picture back. Unfortunately this artefact is so important that I don't see an alternative. Please got to Iwar in Kazordoon and pay the money.
npc.gareth.say_4: [EN] So the rumours are true. How could this happen? I'll keep the picture at its place until we've got a replacement. Please fo to {Angelo} and ask him if he has a new artefact for our museum.
npc.gareth.say_5: [EN] You didn't investigate the pictures yet. Do your job and then come back.
npc.gareth.say_6: [EN] It is planned to extend the MOTA. But this will take time, because our workers have faced a little {problem}.
npc.gareth.say_7: [EN] You are a true patron of the arts! I have opened the construction site for you. Start your work right now!
npc.gate_guardian.greet_msg_1: [EN] Chhhhzzz. Ugly humanzzz! You better have a good reazzzon to be here!
npc.gate_guardian.say_1: [EN] You want entranzzze to zzze zzzity?
npc.gate_guardian.say_2: [EN] Mh, zzzezzze paperzzz zzzeem legit, I have orderzzz to let you pazzz. Zzzo be it.
npc.gelagos.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Hope you die and lose it.
npc.gelagos.stdmod_6: [EN] You are as stupid as Bron.
npc.gelagos.stdmod_7: Any cyclops is smarter than Bron.
npc.gelidrazahs_thirst.greet_msg_1: [EN] Have you come to answer Gelidrazah's questions?
npc.gelidrazahs_thirst.multi_1: [EN] There are three questions. First: What is the name of the princess who fell in love with a Thaian nobleman during the regency of pharaoh Uthemath? Second: Who is the author of the book ,The Language of the Wolves'? ...
npc.gelidrazahs_thirst.multi_2: [EN] Third: Which ancient Tibian race reportedly travelled the sky in cloud ships? Can you answer these questions?
npc.gelidrazahs_thirst.say_1: [EN] So I ask you: What is the name of the princess who fell in love with a Thaian nobleman during the regency of pharaoh Uthemath?
npc.gelidrazahs_thirst.say_2: [EN] That's right. Listen to the second question: Who is the author of the book ,The Language of the Wolves'?
npc.gelidrazahs_thirst.say_3: [EN] That's right. Listen to the third question: Which ancient Tibian race reportedly travelled the sky in cloud ships?
npc.gelidrazahs_thirst.say_4: [EN] That is correct. You satisfactorily answered all questions. You may pass and enter Gelidrazah's lair.
npc.gelidrazahs_thirst.say_5: [EN] I don't know what you are talking about.
npc.gerimor.barkless_complete_1: [EN] The Penitent, thats what they called him? If their spiritual leader and creator of this following changed so radically...
npc.gerimor.barkless_complete_2: [EN] Something far more dangerous must have stood behind this.
npc.gerimor.barkless_text_1: [EN] However, recently they became more prominent as their leader seems to hava taken a turn for the worse. Rumors of violent acts and disappearing people are linked to this cult. ...
npc.gerimor.barkless_text_2: [EN] Someone... Should look into that, don't you think?
npc.gerimor.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greeting, |PLAYERNAME|! I welcome you to this sacred {place}. If you are interested in {missions} just ask.
npc.gerimor.humans_complete_1: [EN] Zathroth wasn't behind this after all. That's good... what's not good is that we have to deal with an unknown power now, let's hope for the best.
npc.gerimor.humans_text_1: [EN] It's a forbidden and abandoned place but... There is an ancient temple of Zathroth beneath Carlin. Some say it's not that abandoned anymore. ...
npc.gerimor.humans_text_2: [EN] Voices, flickering lights in the dead of night, and even a strange gate like sphere wich leads to who knows where. I can't really request this from you but... Someone should take a look, or not?
npc.gerimor.life_complete_1: [EN] Thanks a lot. You have revealed the mystery of this cult and killed the sandking. ...
npc.gerimor.life_complete_2: [EN] The signature AM you have seen, could stand for 'Aeterna Exsistentia' regarding the eternal life. As a reward I give this to you.
npc.gerimor.life_text_1: [EN] Its worshippers wish for eternal, life free of pain and sorrow. The entrance to this cult can be found in the dark pyramid. Would you life to investigate it for me?
npc.gerimor.minotaurs_complete_1: [EN] You have found the source of power which strengthened the minotaurs. Thanks a lot! Here your reward.
npc.gerimor.minotaurs_text_1: [EN] This is an animal-like cult. Only minotaurs can be found there, but no idea what there are expecting and what they are worshipping. ...
npc.gerimor.minotaurs_text_2: [EN] Maybe they are a bit different to the creatures you already know. Would you like to dinf out more for me?
npc.gerimor.misguided_complete_1: [EN] So the leader of these... Misguided was actually controlled and not the other way round? Whatever is behind all this, that's some first-rate irony right there.
npc.gerimor.misguided_text_1: [EN] There's a camp of outlaws to the east of Thais. Rumour has it that people are going missing but it's not linked to the bandits. ...
npc.gerimor.misguided_text_2: [EN] Lights have been seen at night in the abandoned ruin in the vicinity of the camp, somewhere to the south-west. Brave enough to check it out?
npc.gerimor.multi_1: [EN] You have done our world a great favour and reason enough to be proud of yourself. ...
npc.gerimor.multi_2: [EN] Although we could not rout out each and every cult and they will soon find another source to fuel their evil, we have dealt the enemy a vital blow that will take time and resources to recouperate from. ...
npc.gerimor.multi_3: [EN] You have undoubtedly bought your world some valuable time and weakened the enemy. Take my thanks in behalf of the world and keep up your heroic work. For your reward you must have two free slots. Are you ready to receive it?
npc.gerimor.multi_4: [EN] Your actions have weakened the worldly anchors of the enemy and unveiled the source they use to strengthen their cults. ...
npc.gerimor.multi_5: [EN] Our circle has used this opportunity to breach their protective shroud and aim a teleporter to this source. I would like to ask you to use it, to travel to this source and destroy it. ...
npc.gerimor.multi_6: [EN] But be warned, you will need a group twice as great compared to those with which you defeated the cults. Go now, with my blessings.
npc.gerimor.orcs_complete_1: [EN] That was no god - yet you rid the world of a being which, without the help of one, would not even have been here in the first place. Nicely done.
npc.gerimor.orcs_text_1: [EN] Several Edron orcs have taken to a dangerous idol it seems. It may not be too late to stop them if you act quickly. A powerful cult of orcs with a broad following could prove unsurmountable in the end. ...
npc.gerimor.prosperity_complete_1: [EN] Thanks a lot. As I already supposed the museum is just a disguise. ...
npc.gerimor.prosperity_complete_2: [EN] You found out the true meaning. As you have described their cult object the AM on the floor might stand for "Aurea Manus". Here is your reward for your effort.
npc.gerimor.prosperity_text_1: [EN] The alleged incentive to follow this cult is infinite prosperity. Therefore most of the worshippers are already very rich citizens of Tibia. ...
npc.gerimor.prosperity_text_2: [EN] This cult is abandoned in the recently opened new museum in Thais. This can be entered in the Thais exhibition. Would you like to have a look at this cult?
npc.gerimor.say_1: [EN] You have already fulfilled your job to my full satisfaction. The cults are investigated and the final boss is eliminated. I have nothing more for you to do. Fare you well!
npc.gerimor.say_3: [EN] Very nice! Come back if you have found what's going on in this cult.
npc.gerimor.say_4: [EN] You have not finished your work yet. Come back when you're done.
npc.gerimor.say_5: [EN] Here's your reward. Thank you and farewell!
npc.gerimor.say_6: [EN] What a pitty! You can come back, when ever you want, if you have changed your opinion.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_1: [EN] This place is a sanctuary of Crunor and provides me with a opportunity of spiritual contemplation.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_10:
[EN] I'm a member of a circle of persons, that joined wisdom and resources for a common purpose. Let's say, we have an eye on the greater picture in the matters of our world. ... \z
	We are watching and evaluating what is happening in our world.	Trying to avert the worst and offering a helping hand where we deem it needed. ... \z
	We usually avoid to interfere directly in the affairs of the world and vain politics are not our concern at all.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_11:
[EN] Well, while I focus more on the matters of life, some of my peers have different approaches and emphasize other aspects of the world more in their observations. ... \z
	Regardless we share a common goal of balance and harmony.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_12:
[EN] Even we know the individual that was somewhat of our funder, only as the wise man. ... \z
	He was the first to bring bright and dedicated minds together, to bring at least a little order and guidance into troubled and chaotic times. ... \z
	The order predates mankind and never bothered to give itself a name. Such assumptions of pretence and vanity have no place in our mindset.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_13:
[EN] Most times we are silent watchers and keeper of knowledge that share what they have learned with each other. We are more concerned about knowledge and wisdom and power means little to us. ... \z
	To solve problems we usually try to convince the right people to do the right thing. We usually even lack the means for a more direct interference.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_14:
[EN] Sometimes it's necessary to do something about a situation that became threatening to the world itself. ... \z
	It is gladly a rare occurrence and usually it is sufficient to somewhat offer a guiding hand to avert a course that would lead to more dire consequences. Nonetheless sometimes we have to interfere.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_15:
[EN] The fae vary greatly in size and appearance. There are different kinds of fae like fauns, pixies, pookas, swan maidens, nymphs and boogies. Those mystical creatures are wielding power in magic and elementals. ... \z
	Most of them are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in their secret realm. Sometimes they are called the 'children of dreams' or 'the dream born' because the fae are born from the mortals' dreams.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_16:
[EN] Fauns are half-human, half-beast nature spirits inhabiting the woods and mountains of Feyrist. They are a slightly roguish but cheerful folk, lovers of wine and dancing. ... \z
	Fauns show a youthful and graceful aspect but they are also brave and fearless when it comes to defend themselves. As Maelyrra told me, they emerge from mortals' dreams about celebrations, music and dancing. ... \z
	Lately, some fauns on Feyrist are tainted by the mysterious, sinister force that is threatening Feyrist as well as the rest of Tibia.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_17:
[EN] Pixies are small nature spirits and mythical creatures inhabiting the forests and plains of Feyrist. They are generally benign, but at times, they may also display mischievous traits. ... \z
	Like most of the fae, pixies love dancing and are often gathering in larger groups to dance on secluded glades. Pixies love flowers, butterflies, shimmering beetles, gems and other colourful things. ... \z
	They also love the taste of honey, sweetened oat and ripe grapes. As Maelyrra told me, pixies emerge from mortals' dreams about friends and family.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_18:
[EN] Pookas are nature spirits in animal form, looking like big hares with a faintly glittering fur. They are benign but mischievous, for sure with good reason regarded as the tricksters among the fae. ... \z
	Pookas love to play pranks on others, snitching and hiding things or telling made-up stories. They are capricious and fickle creatures. Pookas emerge from mortals' dreams about gems, treasures and gold. ... \z
	Lately, some pookas on Feyrist are tainted by a mysterious, sinister force that is threatening Feyrist as well as the rest of Tibia.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_19:
[EN] Swan maidens are fae who can shapeshift from human form to swan form. The magical item allowing this transformation is a swan feather cloak, a garment with swan feathers attached. ... \z
	Here on Feyrist it is always hard to tell whether a swan swimming on a lake is an ordinary animal or a swan maiden in her bird shape. ... \z
	They protect the wilds of their secret realm from every intruder and live in small flocks along secluded lakeshores. As Maelyrra told me, swan maidens emerge from mortals' dreams about flying.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_2: [EN] We focus our interest on this we see as threatening for live and the laws of nature itself.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_20:
[EN] Nymphs are female nature spirits and usually take the form of beautiful, young maidens who love to dance and sing. They dwell in the hills and forests of Feyrist, often near lakes and streams and they can't die of old age nor illness. ... \z
	They have a special, strong bond to the plants and animals of their domain and are very protective of Feyrist's flora and fauna. As Maelyrra told me, nymphs emerge from mortals' dreams about love.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_21:
[EN] Boogies are a rather twisted kind of fae. Other than pixies, nymphs or fauns they favour underground caves and tunnels over forests or lush meadows. ... \z
	Only at night, they are roaming the surface, chasing other fae and visitors to Feyrist alike. They were once clumsy yet peaceful fae, but they are now twisted and tainted by a mysterious, sinister force.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_22:
[EN] She's the queen of a fae court. You can find her on a glade in the deep forest. It was queen Maelyrra who granted me permission to stay here in Feyrist. ... \z
	I promised to inform her about anything I find out about the abominable force that threatens this world.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_23:
[EN] The fae vary greatly in size and appearance. There are different kinds of fae like fauns, pixies, pookas, swan maidens, nymphs and boogies. Those mystical creatures are wielding power in magic and elementals. ... \z
	Most of them are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in their secret realm. Sometimes they are called the ,children of dreams' or ,the dream born' because the fae are born from the mortals' dreams.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_24:
[EN] It doesn't seem that the cults share a common theme or object of reverence but there has to be some connection beyond being at the centre of culminations of disruptive power from beyond. ... \z
	The connection is of second thought though. Connected or not, they further the death of our world. That alone makes it imperative to dig those cults out and destroy their cores. ... \z
	We won't be able to rout our each and any movement but if we manage to neutralize the worst, we gain some time and deny the enemy much of its leverage on the future of our world.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_25:
[EN] We have located some of the worst culminations of otherworldly presence and our sources returned information about them with different results of success. ... \z
	Some information I can provide you will be rather sparse and much is left to speculation but you should have at least some lead where to go and investigate.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_26:
[EN] We haven't completely figured out what our enemy exactly is. For one, this thing defies all laws of nature and comprehension, ... \z
	that understanding it is either impossible or twist a mind in ways that are not meant to be. Also the Yalahari who figured out way too much about the thing, became tainted and changed by this knowledge ... \z
	And ultimately not only fell and became his, they also provided the thing with something of their own, be it knowledge, understanding or even direction, purpose. ... \z
	In some way their tainted knowledge brought the unthinkable into a resemblance of existence. ... \z
	That is why we cant dabble too much in figuring this out and rather concentrate on our fight to severe its ties to our world.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_3: [EN] We might not be many but we are diverse. Our rather informal order came together in the dawn of time, when the wars of the gods ravaged the world.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_4: [EN] Interference comes in different forms. In this particular case there is sadly little time for subtlety and a more direct approach is necessary.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_5: [EN] The fae granted me permission to enter their hidden realm. As a druid I'm in close touch with nature so I could gain their trust. The nature spirits are inhabiting this peninsula for ages.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_6: [EN] Those cults have to be stopped by any means possible. These are desperate times and they demand desperate actions.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_7: [EN] Spare lives where you see it fit but the cults may not be allowed to exist and disrupt the fabric of the world even more.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_8: [EN] The weakened fabric of our reality still repels the unnatural intruder. The cults provide the thing a hold and supply it with more power, even if we couldn't figure out yet, how this works at all.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_9: [EN] I have several missions available that deal with servering the ties of the corrupting influence on our world.
npc.gewen.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Where do you want me to {fly} you? Or do you need a weekly ticket for the Kazordoon public lorry transport?
npc.gewen.say_1: [EN] Your weekly ticket is still valid. Would be a waste of money to purchase a second one
npc.gewen.say_2: [EN] Do you want to purchase a weekly ticket for the ore wagons? With it you can travel freely and swiftly through Kazordoon for one week. 250 gold only. Deal?
npc.gewen.say_4: [EN] Here is your stamp. It can't be transferred to another person and will last one week from now. You'll get notified upon using an ore wagon when it isn't valid anymore.
npc.gewen.stdmod_1: [EN] Nothing beats the feeling of flying with a carpet!
npc.gewen.stdmod_3: [EN] Do you seek a ride to {0} for {1}?
npc.gewen.voice_1: [EN] Nothing beats the feeling of flying with a carpet!
npc.ghorza.say_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.ghorza.voice_3: [EN] All water drying up and Vuzrog does nothing!
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.multi_1: [EN] Even though we are spirits, we can't create anything out of thin air. You will have to donate some precious metal which we can drain for energy and substance. ...
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.multi_2: [EN] The equivalent of 5000 gold will do. Are you willing to make such a donation?
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.multi_3: [EN] Even though we are spirits, we can't create anything out of thin air. You will have to donate some precious metal which we can drain for energy and substance. ...
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.multi_4: [EN] The equivalent of 5000 gold will do. Are you willing to make such a donation?
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.multi_5: [EN] Even though we are spirits, we can't create anything out of thin air. You will have to donate some precious metal which we can drain for energy and substance. ...
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.multi_6: [EN] The equivalent of 5000 gold will do. Are you willing to make such a donation?
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.multi_7: [EN] Although we are willing to hand this item to you, there is something you have to understand: There is no such thing as 'the' sceptre. ...
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.multi_8: [EN] Then go to the holy altar and create a new one.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.multi_9: [EN] Then go to the holy altar and create a new one.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.say_1: [EN] So be it! Here is my part of the sceptre. Combine it with the other parts on the altar of the Great Snake in the depths of this temple.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.say_2: [EN] So be it! Here is my part of the sceptre. Combine it with the other parts on the altar of the Great Snake in the depths of this temple.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.say_3: [EN] So be it! Here is my part of the sceptre. Combine it with the other parts on the altar of the Great Snake in the depths of this temple.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_1: [EN] We are the {guardians}. We are all what is left from the glory of the past.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_10: [EN] There are many forms of corruption in this world. All of it is the work of the egg stealers who spread their taint. The creation hatched by the Great {Snake} was perfect without even the option of corruption.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_11: [EN] Creatures from beyond. Greedy and traitorous, they stole parts of the world and of life for themselves. They corrupted the world by their deceptions and stole our {birthright}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_12: [EN] We were overthrown by those of who we vainly thought we could use for our advantage, even though we knew about the foulness of the false-born.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_13: [EN] Everything that lacks scales is no true litter of the Great Snake. They are the corrupted kin of the egg stealers.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_14: [EN] Such concepts are of little consequence for the dead.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_15: [EN] They are a manifestation of the snake god's power. They are its avatars in some way.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_16: [EN] We are the true-born. We are the children of the snake. But as children we have yet much to learn. One day we might take our rightful place in creation, but only if we prove {worthy}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_17: [EN] They are the false-born. They hatched from foul eggs - poisoned by the egg stealers. They are numerous and like a plague for the world.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_18: [EN] This was once the centre of power of our religion. From here we ruled Tiquanda in the name of the snake god.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_19: [EN] We were not aware of another civilisation that was left. Only recently the awareness of the Great Snake touched us in our slumber and we learnt through visions of its other children.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_2: [EN] We are the keepers of this old temple and the guardians of its sacred {secrets}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_20:
[EN] Some of the relics are still left in this world. They are insignia of the snake god's power. We know that you came for one of those insignia. ... \z
	The Great {Snake} approves that you acquire its holy {sceptre}. We will not question the wisdom of the god to hand this relic to one of the false-born.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_21:
[EN] We have failed our god and paid a high price. But all tragedies and obstacles are just a test of the Great Snake. We will have to prove we are worthy to be its first true-born. ... \z
	Only in the face of seemingly impossible odds, we can prove what we are capable of. If we overcome all obstacles, the favour of the Great {Snake} will return to us. ... \z
	The god has cast us down only to elevate us to new heights if we are worthy.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_22:
[EN] We understand what he is and what he has become. We were not aware there were others like us left in the world. ... \z
	Perhaps there is still a chance our race can redeem itself in the eyes of the Great {Snake}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_23:
[EN] The father and mother of everything. Its first egg hatched the world. Its second egg hatched life itself. The lizard people were of its third litter. ... \z
	Of the third litter but the first true-born, we became its keepers. As its first true children, we inherited the earth but it was taken from us by the {egg stealers}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_24:
[EN] We were the rulers of the world. We overlooked the world in the name of the Great {Snake}. The egg stealers and their creatures stole it from our claws. ... \z
	We have failed the Great {Snake} and our {decline} is its punishment.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_25:
[EN] The Great Snake deserves that we try to use the best of our abilities and capabilities to serve it. Our existence is a test in this world corrupted by the egg stealers. ... \z
	Only when we overcome all obstacles cast into our way, we will become worthy to serve the Great Snake in all eternity.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_26:
[EN] Some of the relics are still left in this world. They are insignia of the snake god's power. We know that you came for one of those insignia. ... \z
	The Great Snake approves that you acquire its holy sceptre. We will not question the wisdom of the god to hand this relic to one of the false-born.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_27:
[EN] We were once the heigh priests of the Great Snake. We willingly left our mortal existence behind to become bound to this temple. ... \z
	In this state we can serve the Great Snake in a more suitable way. You have to understand that it is an honour and a privilege, not a sacrifice.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_3: [EN] We are keepers of the {lore} of the Great {Snake} and we guard some of its {relics}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_4: [EN] The lore of the Great {Snake} is contorted like a snake. Although we feel you are touched by the snake's essence, you are not ready yet to receive the blessing of the deeper wisdom.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_5: [EN] Once the powerful relics of the Great {Snake} were abundant. Most got lost to the ravages of time and our enemies. What is {left} is all the more precious.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_6: [EN] We are the guardians. We are all what is left from the glory of the past.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_7: [EN] What you call Banuta was once a centre of our civilisation and culture. We gave those {apes} so much, but they wanted more. In the end, the Great {Snake} used them as a tool to teach our people a painful but necessary lesson.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_8: [EN] In their vanity our descendants thought they could use those false-born as servants. They paid a terrible price. Their downfall might only be temporary though if we can {redeem} our race in the eyes of the snake god.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_9: [EN] Dragons are one of the greatest creations of the Great {Snake}. Yet, they are still distanced from the Great {Snake} and susceptible for {corruption} and the lies of the egg stealers.
npc.ghostly_wolf.greet_msg_1: [EN] You are speaking the language of animals? I'm surprised. But I'm not in the right mood for a chat.
npc.ghostly_wolf.multi_1: [EN] I didn't dare hope for it! The man told something about selling my babies to the orcs so they could train them as war wolves. ...
npc.ghostly_wolf.multi_2: [EN] I guess he mentioned Ulderek's Rock. Please search for them and - be they alive or not - return and tell me what happened to them.
npc.ghostly_wolf.multi_3: [EN] I'm heartbroken, traveler. Some months ago, I was taking care of my three newborn whelps. They just opened their eyes and started exploring the wilderness as a hunter came by. ...
npc.ghostly_wolf.multi_4: [EN] He shot me and took my three puppies with him. I have no idea where he brought them or whether they are still alive. This uncertainty harrows me and thus I'm unable to find peace. Will you help me?
npc.ghostly_wolf.say_1: [EN] I guess I will stick around for a time to watch over the grave. After this final watch I will find peace, I can feel this. Thank you, human being. You redeemed me.
npc.ghostly_wolf.say_2: [EN] I guess I will stick around for a time to watch over the grave. After this final watch I will find peace, I can feel this. Thank you, human being. You redeemed me.
npc.ghostly_wolf.say_3: [EN] You are not on that mission.
npc.gnomad.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hi there! I'm ready to brief you with {tactical} advice.
npc.gnomad.multi_1: [EN] You will encounter quite a lot of beasties in the area ahead of us. The end of the cave-system is where the trouble begins though. The monsters here all serve some massive creature only known as Deathstrike. ...
npc.gnomad.multi_2: [EN] The creature is hidden in a well protected chamber. The good news is, we've managed to erect a crystal structure close to the cave that is able to breach its defence and teleport someone into the chamber. ...
npc.gnomad.multi_3: [EN] The bad new is that the crystals need a specific charge before they can work. As soon as the crystals begin to charge up, Deathstrikes' minions will frenzy and spawn in waves to crush all opposition. ...
npc.gnomad.multi_4: [EN] You will have to kill them quite fast, to not be overwhelmed by their numbers! Our own tries to breach the defence has proven that you'll have to endure six waves until the teleporter to Deathtstrikes' cave opens for a short 30 seconds. ...
npc.gnomad.multi_5: [EN] Use the GREEN command crystal in the cave to begin the charging of the teleport! Good luck.
npc.gnomad.say_1: [EN] I'm the gnomish tactical advisor for this area!
npc.gnomad.say_2: [EN] Ah you are amazed by our crystals, aren't you? Well, you have only seen a tiny fraction of what they are able to do.
npc.gnomad.say_3: [EN] In the last century mushrooms have become more and more important for producing raw materials and tools and less important for sustenance.
npc.gnomad.say_4: [EN] We gnomes are masters of growing and working crystals and we also mastered the raising of a variety of mushrooms for different purposes.
npc.gnomadness.greet_1: [EN] Hello and welcome in the Gnomprona Gardens. If you want to change your {hazard} level, I 'm who you're looking for.
npc.gnomadness.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello and welcome in the Gnomprona Gardens
npc.gnomadness.say_1: [EN] I can change your hazard level to spice up your hunt in the gardens. Your current level is set to {}. And your maximum unlocked level is {{}}. What level would you like to hunt in?
npc.gnomadness.say_2: [EN] Your hazard level has been set to {}. Good luck!
npc.gnomadness.say_4: [EN] You've achieved the necessary hazard level. As a reward, you've received the Noxious Ripptor mount and a primal bag.
npc.gnomadness.say_5: [EN] You can't set your hazard level higher than your maximum unlocked level.
npc.gnomadness.say_6: [FR] Your hazard level has been set to {}. Good luck!
npc.gnomadness.voice_1: [EN]  I'll have to write that idea down.
npc.gnomadness.voice_2: [EN] So many ideas, so little time
npc.gnomally.greet_msg_1: [EN] Oh, hello! I'm the gnome-human relations assistant. I am here for you to trade your tokens for {equipment}, resupply you with mission {items} and talk to you about your {relations} to us gnomes! ...
npc.gnomally.multi_1: [EN] For seventy tokens, I can offer you a voucher for an {addition to the soil guardian outfit}, or a voucher for an {addition to the crystal warlord armor outfit}.
npc.gnomally.multi_2: [EN] For seventy tokens, I can offer you a voucher for an {addition to the soil guardian outfit}, or a voucher for an {addition to the crystal warlord armor outfit}.
npc.gnomally.multi_3: [EN] For twenty major tokens, I can offer you a {basic soil guardian outfit}, a {basic crystal warlord outfit}, an {iron loadstone} or a {glow wine}.
npc.gnomally.multi_4: [EN] For twenty major tokens, I can offer you a {basic soil guardian outfit}, a {basic crystal warlord outfit}, an {iron loadstone} or a {glow wine}.
npc.gnomally.multi_5: [EN] By the way, if you want to have a look on the prismatic and gill items first, just head over to the depot and check the market.
npc.gnomally.multi_6: [EN] By the way, if you want to have a look on the prismatic and gill items first, just head over to the depot and check the market.
npc.gnomally.say_1: [EN] Do you want to trade {} {} for {} {} tokens?
npc.gnomally.say_10: [EN] Let us see if I have what you need.
npc.gnomally.say_12: [FR] Our relations improve with every mission you undertake on our behalf. Another way to improve your relations with us gnomes is to trade in minor crystal tokens. ...
npc.gnomally.say_13: [FR] You are not even a recruit of the Bigfoots. Sorry I can't help you.
npc.gnomally.say_14: [FR] Sorry, you don't have enough {} tokens with you.
npc.gnomally.say_15: [FR] As you wish! Your new renown is {{}}.
npc.gnomally.say_2: [EN] Your renown amongst us gnomes is currently {{}}. Do you want to improve your standing by sacrificing tokens? One token will raise your renown by 5 points.
npc.gnomally.say_3: [EN] Do you really want to trade {} minor tokens for {} renown?
npc.gnomally.say_4: [EN] Sorry, you don't have enough {} tokens with you.
npc.gnomally.say_6: [EN] As you wish! Your new renown is {{}}.
npc.gnomally.say_7: [EN] First make sure you have enough space in your inventory.
npc.gnomally.say_8: [EN] How many tokens do you want to trade?
npc.gnomally.say_9: [EN] You don't have these many tokens.
npc.gnomargery.multi_1: [EN] On the levels outside, we encountered the first serious resistance of our true enemy. As evidenced by the unnatural heat in an area with little volcanic activity, there is 'something' strange going on here. ...
npc.gnomargery.multi_2: [EN] Even the lava pools we have found here are not actually lava, but rock that was molten pretty much recently without any reasonable connection to some natural heat source. And for all we can tell, the heat is growing, slowly but steadily. ...
npc.gnomargery.multi_3: [EN] This is the first time ever that we can witness our enemy at work. Here we can learn a lot about its operations. ...
npc.gnomargery.multi_4: [EN] How they work, and possibly how to stop them. But therefore expeditions into the depths are necessary. The areas around us are highly dangerous, and a lethal threat to us and the Spike as a whole. ...
npc.gnomargery.multi_5: [EN] Our first object is to divert the forces of the enemy and weaken them as good as we can while gathering as much information as possible about them and their movements. Only highly skilled adventurers stand a chance to help us down here. ...
npc.gnomargery.say_1: [EN] Sorry, you have to wait {} before this task gets available again.
npc.gnomargery.say_10: [EN] You have not started that mission.
npc.gnomargery.say_11: [EN] You have done well. Here, take your reward.

npc.gnomargery.say_48: [FR] I'm the officer responsible for this area. I give out missions, accept mission reports and oversee our defences.
npc.gnomargery.say_49: [FR] It's good to be a gnome for sure!
npc.gnomargery.say_5: [EN] Sorry, you have to wait {} before this task gets available again.
npc.gnomargery.say_50: [FR] On the levels outside, we encountered the first serious resistance of our true enemy. As evidenced by the unnatural heat in an area with little volcanic activity, there is 'something' strange going on here. ...
npc.gnomargery.say_51: [FR] Even the lava pools we have found here are not actually lava, but rock that was molten pretty much recently without any reasonable connection to some natural heat source. And for all we can tell, the heat is growing, slowly but steadily. ...
npc.gnomargery.say_52: [FR] This is the first time ever that we can witness our enemy at work. Here we can learn a lot about its operations. ...
npc.gnomargery.say_53: [FR] How they work, and possibly how to stop them. But therefore expeditions into the depths are necessary. The areas around us are highly dangerous, and a lethal threat to us and the Spike as a whole. ...
npc.gnomargery.say_54: [FR] Our first object is to divert the forces of the enemy and weaken them as good as we can while gathering as much information as possible about them and their movements. Only highly skilled adventurers stand a chance to help us down here. ...
npc.gnomargery.say_55: [FR] Now that's gnomish ingenuity given shape! Who but a gnome would come up with such a plan to defeat our enemies.
npc.gnomargery.say_56: [FR] Sorry, but no! Your expertise could be put to better use elsewhere. You are desperately needed in the upper levels of the Spike. Report there immediately.
npc.gnomargery.say_57: [FR] I can offer you several missions: to {deliver} parcels to our boys and girls in the battlefield, to get reports from our {undercover} gnomes, to do some {temperature} measuring and to {kill} some drillworms.

npc.gnomaticus.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hi there! Are you here for the {shooting} test or to {report} your success?
npc.gnomaticus.multi_1: [EN] To the left you see our shooting range. Grab a cannon and shoot at the targets. You need five hits to succeed. ...
npc.gnomaticus.multi_2: [EN] Shoot at the villain targets that will pop up. DON'T shoot innocent civilians since this will reset your score and you have to start all over. Report to me afterwards.
npc.gnomaticus.say_1: [EN] Shoot at the villain targets that will pop up. DON'T shoot innocent civilians since this will reset your score and you have to start all over. {Report} to me afterwards.
npc.gnomaticus.say_2: [EN] You are showing some promise! Now continue with the recruitment and talk to Gnomewart to the south for your endurance test!
npc.gnomaticus.say_3: [EN] Sorry you are not done yet.

npc.gnombold.multi_1: [EN] Our mission for you is to use a magnet on three different monoliths in the cave system here. After the magnet evaporates on the last charge, enter the magnetic extractor here to deliver your charge.
npc.gnombold.multi_2: [EN] If you are interested, I can give you some more {information} about it. Are you willing to accept this mission?
npc.gnombold.multi_3: [EN] The levels around us are... well, they are strange. We are still not entirely sure how they were created. It seems obvious that they are artificial, but they seem not to be burrowed or the like. ...
npc.gnombold.multi_4: [EN] We found strange stone formations that were not found on other layers around the Spike, but there is no clue at all if they are as natural as they look. It seems someone used some geomantic force to move the earth. ...
npc.gnombold.multi_5: [EN] For what reason this has been done we can't tell as we found no clues of colonisation. ...
npc.gnombold.multi_6: [EN] There are theories that the caves are some kind of burrow of some extinct creature or even creatures that are still around us, but exist as some form of invisible energy; but those theories are far-fetched and not supported by any discoveries. ...
npc.gnombold.multi_7: [EN] Be that as it may, whatever those caves were meant for, these days they are crawling with creatures of different kinds and all are hostile towards us. The competition for food is great down here, and everything is seen as prey by the cave dwellers. ...
npc.gnombold.multi_8: [EN] Some would like to feast on the crystal of the Spike, others would prefer a diet of gnomes. What they have in common is that they are a threat. If we can't keep them under control their constant attacks and raids on the Spike will wear us down. ...
npc.gnombold.multi_9: [EN] That's where adventurers fit in to save the day.

npc.gnome_trooper.greet_msg_1: [EN] Do you have something to deliver?
npc.gnome_trooper.response_1: [EN] It's a pipe! What can be more relaxing for a gnome than to smoke his pipe after a day of duty at the front. At least it's a chance to do something really dangerous after all!
npc.gnome_trooper.response_2: [EN] Ah, a letter from home! Oh - I had no idea she felt that way! This is most interesting!
npc.gnome_trooper.response_3: [EN] It's a model of the gnomebase Alpha! For self-assembly! With toothpicks...! Yeeaah...! I guess.
npc.gnome_trooper.response_4: [EN] A medal of honour! At last they saw my true worth!
npc.gnomegica.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings! You came to the right gnome to buy {potions}, {runes} or {wands}. So let's talk about a {trade}.
npc.gnomegica.say_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.gnomegica.voice_1: [EN] Oh my, such a mess! I really should clean up things more often.
npc.gnomelvis.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello. Is it me you're {looking} for?
npc.gnomelvis.multi_1: [EN] Congratulations on finding your soul melody. And a pretty one as far as I can tell. Now you are a true recruit of the Bigfoot company! Commander Stone might have some tasks for you to do! ...
npc.gnomelvis.multi_2: [EN] Look for him in the central chamber. I marked your map where you will find him.
npc.gnomelvis.multi_3: [EN] Ah well. Everyone has a very personal melody in his soul. Only if you know your soul melody then you know yourself. And only if you know yourself will you be admitted to the Bigfoot company. ...
npc.gnomelvis.multi_4: [EN] So what you have to do is to find your soul melody. Do you see the huge crystals in this room? Those are harmonic crystals. Use them to deduce your soul melody. Simply use them to create a sound sequence. ...
npc.gnomelvis.multi_5: [EN] Every soul melody consists of seven sound sequences. You will have to figure out your correct soul melody by trial and error. If you hit a wrong note, you will have to start over.
npc.gnomelvis.say_2: [EN] What you have to do is to find your soul melody. Use the harmonic crystals to deduce your soul melody. Every soul melody consists of seven sound sequences. ...
npc.gnomelvis.say_3: [EN] You will have to figure out your correct soul melody by trial and error.
npc.gnomelvis.say_4: [EN] Congratulations on finding your soul melody.
npc.gnomeral.multi_1: [EN] We gnomes need some special grindstones to cut and polish specific crystals. The thing is, they can only be found in a quite dangerous lava cave full of vile monsters. You'll reach it via the hot spot teleporter. ...
npc.gnomeral.multi_10: [EN] Be that as it may, in this package you'll find a crystal. Take it out of the package and go to the crystal caves to find it a mate. Just look out for huge red crystals and try your luck. ...
npc.gnomeral.multi_11: [EN] They should look like one of those seen in your soul melody test. You will find them in the crystal grounds. {Report} back to me when you are done.
npc.gnomeral.multi_2: [EN] It will be your task to get one such grindstone and bring it back to me.
npc.gnomeral.multi_3: [EN] We gnomes want you to gather a special collection of spores. All you have to do is use a puffball mushroom and use the spore gathering kit I gave you to gather the spores. ...
npc.gnomeral.multi_4: [EN] There is a catch though. You need to collect different spores in a specific sequence to fill your gathering kit. If you mix the spores in the wrong way, you ruin your collection and have to start over. ...
npc.gnomeral.multi_5: [EN] You have to gather them in this sequence: red, green, blue and yellow. You can see on your kit what is required next.
npc.gnomeral.multi_6: [EN] I'm no expert on how those golems work, but it seems that when the crystals of the golems get out of harmony, they do as they please and even sometimes become violent. The violent ones are lost. ...
npc.gnomeral.multi_7: [EN] Don't bother with them, though you may decide to kill some to get rid of them. The others can be repaired, but to recall them to the workshops, the golems have to be put into a specific resonance. ...
npc.gnomeral.multi_8: [EN] Use the bell I gave you on the golems, so the gnomes can recall them to their workshops. Getting four of them should be enough for now. Report back when you are ready.
npc.gnomeral.multi_9: [EN] You will have to find a lonely crystal a perfect match. I don't understand the specifics but the gnomes told me that even crystals need a mate to produce offspring. ...

npc.gnomercy.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hi there! I'm ready to brief you with {tactical} advice.
npc.gnomercy.multi_1: [EN] With your help and efforts we finally cornered what we think is one of 'those below'! For all you have done and endured you are granted the privilege to be one of the first to fight the true enemy. ...
npc.gnomercy.multi_2: [EN] For all we know your successes have brought some unrest to our enemies and they sent one of their observers to punish their slaves and force them to more fierce attacks. ...
npc.gnomercy.multi_3: [EN] This is our chance to deal the enemy the first blow in this conflict. With reinforcements from Gnomehome we are attacking the troops of the enemy and binding a great deal of their forces in battle. ...
npc.gnomercy.multi_4: [EN] Now it is up to you to fight your way to the heart of the enemy's defences and kill the observer. ...
npc.gnomercy.multi_5: [EN] Our first tries were met with no success though. The observer has brought with him one of his creatures or lieutenants, the lost call the thing Versperoth. I am not sure if it is a name or a race. ...
npc.gnomercy.multi_6: [EN] However Versperoth itself is protected by hoards of minions. Sometimes this thing will withdraw into the ground and let all hell loose in form of its' slaves. ...
npc.gnomercy.multi_7: [EN] You'd better be finished with them before Versperoth re-emerges. ...
npc.gnomercy.multi_8: [EN] Only when you manage to kill Versperoth, will you be able to enter the portal behind him and face the true evil of the observer. ...
npc.gnomercy.multi_9: [EN] Use the GREEN command crystal in the cave to begin the charging of the teleport! Good luck.

npc.gnomillion.greet_msg_1: [EN] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.gnomillion.voice_1: [EN] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.gnomilly.multi_1: [EN] We need you to recharge our ghost pacifiers. They are placed at several strategic points in the caves around us and should be easy to find. Your mission would be to charge seven of them.
npc.gnomilly.multi_2: [EN] If you are interested, I can give you some more {information} about it. Are you willing to accept this mission?
npc.gnomilly.multi_3: [EN] On these levels we found evidence of some monumental battle that has taken place here centuries ago. We also found some grave sites, but oddly enough no clues of any form of settlement. ...
npc.gnomilly.multi_4: [EN] Some evidence we have found suggests that at least one of the battles here was fought for many, many years. People came here, lived here, fought here and died here. ...
npc.gnomilly.multi_5: [EN] The battles continued until someone or something literally ploughed through the battlefields, turning everything upside down. All this killing and death soaked the area with negative energy. ...
npc.gnomilly.multi_6: [EN] Necromantic forces are running wild all over the place and we are hard-pressed to drive all these undead, spirits and ghosts, away from the Spike. ...
npc.gnomilly.multi_7: [EN] Unless we can secure that area somehow, the Spike operation is threatened to become crippled by the constant attacks of the undead. ...
npc.gnomilly.multi_8: [EN] The whole growing downwards could come to a halt, leaving us exposed to even more attacks, counter attacks, and giving the enemy time to prepare their defences. There's a lot to do for aspiring adventurers.

npc.gnomission.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello |PLAYERNAME|. You are probably eager to enter the {warzones}.
npc.gnomission.multi_1: [EN] You can trade special spoils of war to get a permission to use the war teleporters to the area of the corresponding boss without need of mission crystals. ...
npc.gnomission.multi_2: [EN] Which one would you like to trade: the deathstrike's {snippet}, gnomevil's {hat} or the abyssador {lash}?
npc.gnomission.multi_3: [EN] There are three warzones. In each warzone you will find fearsome foes. At the end you'll find their mean master. The masters is well protected though. ...
npc.gnomission.multi_4: [EN] Make sure to talk to our gnomish agent in there for specifics of its' protection. ...
npc.gnomission.multi_5: [EN] Oh, and to be able to enter the second warzone you have to best the first. To enter the third you have to best the second. ...
npc.gnomission.multi_6: [EN] And you can enter each one only once every twenty hours. Your normal teleport crystals won't work on these teleporters. You will have to get {mission} crystals from Gnomally.
npc.gnomission.say_1: [EN] I am responsible for our war {missions}, to {trade} with seasoned soldiers and rewarding war {heroes}. You have to be rank 4 to enter the {warzones}.
npc.gnomission.say_10: [EN] I can't let you enter the warzone teleporter three for free, unless you handle me a Gnomevil's hat. But can still always use a red teleport crystal.
npc.gnomission.say_11: [EN] You need to defeat the second warzone boss to be able to get free access to the third warzone.
npc.gnomission.say_12: [EN] It seems you did not even set one big foot into the warzone, I am sorry.
npc.gnomission.say_13: [EN] Fine, I grant you the permission to enter the warzones. Be warned though, this will be not a picnic. Better bring some friends with you. Bringing a lot of them sounds like a good idea.
npc.gnomission.say_14: [EN] You have already accepted this mission.
npc.gnomission.say_15: [EN] Sorry, you have not yet earned enough renown that we would risk your life in such a dangerous mission.
npc.gnomission.say_16: [EN] Only if you have killed 20 of our major enemies in the warzones I am allowed to trade with you.
npc.gnomission.say_2: [EN] As a war hero you are allowed to use the warzone teleporter one for free!
npc.gnomission.say_3: [EN] I can't let you enter the warzone teleporter one for free, unless you handle me a Deathstrike's snippet. But can still always use a red teleport crystal.
npc.gnomission.say_5: [EN] As a war hero you are allowed to use the warzone teleporter three for free!

npc.gnommander.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hi there! Welcome to the spike.

npc.gnommander.say_13: [EN] You do not have the Cave Explorer outfit.
npc.gnommander.say_15: [EN] Do you want to buy the second addon for 3000 Gold?
npc.gnommander.say_16: [EN] You do not have that money.
npc.gnommander.say_18: [EN] You do not have that money.
npc.gnommander.say_2: [EN] I can sell special outfit parts. If your fame is high enough, you might be {worthy} of such a reward.
npc.gnommander.say_20: [EN] You do not have that money.
npc.gnommander.say_3: [EN] You are not worthy of a special reward yet.
npc.gnommander.say_4: [EN] You can acquire the {basic} outfit for 1000 Gold, the {first} addon for 2000 gold and the {second} addon for 3000 gold. Which do you want to buy?
npc.gnommander.say_5: [EN] You do not have enough level yet.
npc.gnommander.say_7: [EN] Do you want to buy the basic outfit for 1000 Gold?
npc.gnommander.say_8: [EN] You do not have enough level yet.
npc.gnommander.say_9: [EN] You do not have the Cave Explorer outfit.
npc.gnommander.speech_1: [EN] I'm the operating commander of the Spike, the latest great accomplishment of the gnomish race.
npc.gnommander.speech_2: [EN] The Spike is a crystal structure, created by our greatest crystal experts. It has grown from a crystal the size of my fist to the structure you see here and now.
npc.gnommander.speech_3: [EN] Of course this did not happen from one day to the other. It's the fruit of the work of several gnomish generations. Its purpose has changed in the course of time.
npc.gnommander.speech_4: [EN] At first it was conceived as a fast growing resource node. Then it was planned to become the prototype of a new type of high security base.
npc.gnommander.speech_5: [EN] Now it has become a military base and a weapon. With our foes occupied elsewhere, we can prepare our strike into the depths of the earth.
npc.gnommander.speech_6: [EN] This crystal can withstand extreme pressure and temperature, and it's growing deeper and deeper even as we speak.
npc.gnommander.speech_7: [EN] The times of the fastest growth have come to an end, however, and we have to slow down in order not to risk the structural integrity of the Spike. But we are on our way and have to do everything possible to defend the Spike.
npc.gnomole.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hi there! I'm ready to brief you with {tactical} advice.
npc.gnomole.multi_1: [EN] Since you are seasoned adventurers I'll skip the basics and jump right to the important part! This cave system is overrun by the minions of ... ah well, the greatest shame of gnomekind. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_2: [EN] That traitorous gnome, known as Gnomevil, who was my pupil before his changeover to the dark side of gnomedom, has abandoned all gnomish ethics and joined forces with our enemies. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_3: [EN] It's hard to tell what led to his downfall. In the end he seems to have forgotten the principle that with small stature comes great responsibility. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_4: [EN] He became tainted and corrupted by evil, obviously enough to grow in size, which is always an indicator for evil of course. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_5: [EN] Now he commands his armies in the name of those below and hides in his lair protected by layers of thick crystal that only he can form and change due to his corrupted powers! ...
npc.gnomole.multi_6: [EN] There is one thing though that could cause his downfall! His corruption has spread to his minions and in his lair there are some infected weepers that are full of parasites. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_7: [EN] These parasites will spread a fluid that will weaken the integrity of the crystals in front of Gnomevils lair when they die. The entrance is marked with crystal columns, so you can't miss it. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_8: [EN] You have to kill enough of the parasites DIRECTLY in front of the crystals. Eventually the columns will collapse and allow you entrance to Gnomevils lair. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_9: [EN] Take care though, due to Gnomevils power the crystals will grow back quite fast. Better manage the parasites in quick succession or everything will be for naught. ..., Enter his lair and bring an end to his despicable reign!
npc.gnomus.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings, member of the Bigfoot Brigade. We could really use some {help} from you right now. You should prove {worthy} to our alliance.
npc.gnomus.multi_1: [EN] Very good. We prepared a lot of maps as the complete mapping of this system will probably take a lot of research. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_10: [EN] As we have our hands full with a lot of things right now, we could need someone to chart the unknown parts of this underground labyrinth ...
npc.gnomus.multi_11: [EN] I am especially interested in the scattered dark structures around these parts. Would you do that?
npc.gnomus.multi_12: [EN] Excellent, just follow the path to east until you reach a dead end, there is a hole that leads to a small cave underneath which will bring you right to the old trail. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_13: [EN] Help whoever you can and return them to the save cave exit - oh, and while you're at it... some of them will have pack animals. If you can rescue those as well, I'll hand you a bonus. Good luck!
npc.gnomus.multi_14: [EN] AMAZING! Not only did you salve all our friends - you also rescued the animals! Here is your reward and bonus! ...
npc.gnomus.multi_15: [EN] The other are already telling stories about you. Please return to me later if you want to help out some more!
npc.gnomus.multi_16: [EN] I am constantly waiting for ordnance to arrive. A lot of gnomes intend to travel out here to help us but the main access path to our base is not safe anymore. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_17: [EN] Tragically we lost several gnomes after an outbreak of what I can only describe as a force from below. We were completely surprised by their onslaught and retreated to this outpost. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_18: [EN] All our reinforcements arrive at the crystal teleporter to the east of the cave system. We need someone to navigate the new arrivals through the hazards of the dangerous caves. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_19: [EN] Hideous creatures and hot lava makes travelling extremely dangerous. And on top of that there is also the constant danger from falling rocks in the area. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_2: [EN] Take one from the stack here next to me and map as many structures as possible. However, we need at least three locations to make any sense of this ancient layout at all. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_21: [EN] I am constantly waiting for ordnance to arrive. A lot of gnomes intend to travel out here to help us but the main access path to our base is not safe anymore. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_22: [EN] Tragically we lost several gnomes after an outbreak of what I can only describe as a force from below. We were completely surprised by their onslaught and retreated to this outpost. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_23: [EN] All our reinforcements arrive at the crystal teleporter to the east of the cave system. We need someone to navigate the new arrivals through the hazards of the dangerous caves. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_24: [EN] Hideous creatures and hot lava makes travelling extremely dangerous. And on top of that there is also the constant danger from falling rocks in the area. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_26: [EN] How fortunate! There are some trignometres lying around next to that device behind me. Take one and hold it next to high temperature heat sources. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_27: [EN] If you gathered enough data, you will actually smell it from the device. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_28: [EN] Return to me with the results afterwards. Best of luck, we count on you!
npc.gnomus.multi_29: [EN] Excellent, you returned with more data! Let me see... hmm. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_3: [EN] If you manage to map one of each structure around these parts - I assume there must be at least two times as many around here - I will hand you a bonus!
npc.gnomus.multi_30: [EN] Well, we need more data on this but first I will have to show this to our grand horticulturist. Thank you for getting this for us!
npc.gnomus.multi_31: [EN] The heat down here is not the only problem we have but one of our greatest concerns. Not only is it almost unbearable for us, it also seems to be rising. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_32: [EN] We need to find out if this is true and what that means for this place - and for us gnomes. You can help us do this by grabbing one of our trignometres and collecting as much as data from the heat in this area as possible. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_33: [EN] We'd need at least 5 measurements. Are you willing to do this?
npc.gnomus.multi_34: [EN] The heat down here is not the only problem we have but one of our greatest concerns. Not only is it almost unbearable for us, it also seems to be rising. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_35: [EN] We need to find out if this is true and what that means for this place - and for us gnomes. You can help us do this by grabbing one of our trignometres and collecting as much as data from the heat in this area as possible. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_36: [EN] We'd need at least 5 measurements. Are you willing to do this?
npc.gnomus.multi_4: [EN] While exploring these caves to find places to collect spores and grow mushrooms, we found several strange structures. I am convinced that this system was once home to intelligent beings. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_5: [EN] However, the creatures from below are now disturbing our research as well as some particularly pesky dwarves who just would not leave us alone. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_6: [EN] As we have our hands full with a lot of things right now, we could need someone to chart the unknown parts of this underground labyrinth ...
npc.gnomus.multi_7: [EN] I am especially interested in the scattered dark structures around these parts. Would you do that?
