npc.gnomus.say_1: [EN] You want to offer {} suspicious device{}. Which leader shall have it, (Gnomus) of the {gnomes}, (Klom Stonecutter) of the {dwarves} or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.gnomus.say_12: [EN] You don't have enough suspicious devices.
npc.gnomus.say_14: [EN] You don't have enough suspicious devices.
npc.gnomus.say_16: [EN] You don't have enough suspicious devices.
npc.gnomus.say_17: [EN] So you want to know what we all think about your deeds? What leader's opinion are you interested in, the {gnomes} (Gnomus), the {dwarves} (Klom Stonecutter) or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.gnomus.say_18: [FR] You want to offer {} suspicious device{}. Which leader shall have it, (Gnomus) of the {gnomes}, (Klom Stonecutter) of the {dwarves} or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.gnomus.say_19: [FR] The gnomes are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.gnomus.say_2: [EN] The gnomes are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.gnomus.say_20: [FR] The dwarves are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.gnomus.say_21: [FR] The scouts are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.gnomus.say_3: [EN] The dwarves are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.gnomus.say_4: [EN] The scouts are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.gnomus.say_5: [EN] The other are already telling stories about you. Please return to me later if you want to help out some more!
npc.gnomus.say_6: [EN] I don't need your help for now. Come back later.
npc.gnomus.say_7: [EN] Come back when you have finished your job.
npc.gnomus.say_8: [EN] Thank you very much! With those structures mapped out we will be able to complete the puzzle in no time!
npc.gnomus.say_9: [EN] If you bring me any suspicious devices on creatures you slay down here, I'll make it worth your while by telling the others of your generosity. How many do you want to offer?
npc.gnomus.stdmod_1: [EN] If you're willing to help us, we could need an escort for arriving {ordnance}, help with {charting} the cave system and someone needs to get some heat {measurements} fast.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_3: [EN] I'm the main gnomish contact for this base. I coordinate our efforts with those of the dwarves to ensure everything is running smoothly.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_4:
[EN] You're already known amongst the gnomes, member of the Bigfoot Brigade. I will make sure that the alliance learns of your deeds but you'll still need to help the dwarves and gnomes of this outpost to show your worth. ... \z
	We also found {suspicious devices} carried by all kinds of creatures down here. Down here, they are of extreme worth to us since they could contain the key to what's happening all around us. ... \z
	If you can aquire any, return them to me and I make sure to tell the others of your generosity. Return to me afterwards to check on your current {status}.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_5:
[EN] Our surveys of the area showed us some spikes in heat and seismic activity at very specific places. ... \z
	We conclude this is no coincidence and the enemy is using devices to pump up the lava to flood the area. We have seen it before and had to retreat each time. ... \z
	This time though we might have a counter prepared - given me manage to pierce their defences.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_6:
[EN] Gnomish supplies and ingenuity have helped to establish and fortify this outpost. ... \z
	Our knowledge of the enemy and it's tactics would be of more use if the dwarves would listen to us somewhat more. But gnomes have learned to live with the imperfection of the other races.
npc.gnomux.say_1: [EN] I'm responsible for resupplying foolish adventurers with equipment that they may have lost. If you're one of them, just ask me about a {trade}.
npc.gnomux.say_2: [EN] What could I say about gnomes that anyone would not know? I mean, we're interesting if not fascinating, after all.
npc.gnomux.say_3: [EN] I came here as a crystal farmer and know the Spike all the way back to when it was a little baby crystal. I admit I feel a little fatherly pride in how big and healthy it has become.
npc.gnomux.say_4: [FR] I'm responsible for resupplying foolish adventurers with equipment that they may have lost. If you're one of them, just ask me about a {trade}.
npc.gnomux.say_5: [FR] What could I say about gnomes that anyone would not know? I mean, we're interesting if not fascinating, after all.
npc.gnomux.say_6: [FR] I came here as a crystal farmer and know the Spike all the way back to when it was a little baby crystal. I admit I feel a little fatherly pride in how big and healthy it has become.
npc.gnomux.say_7: [FR] When most other crystal experts left for new assignments, I decided to stay and help here a bit.
npc.gorn.greet_msg_1: [EN] Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What do you need?
npc.gorn.say_1: [EN] Do you want to buy a football for 111 gold?
npc.gorn.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
npc.gorn.stdmod_1: [EN] General goods and paperware for sale!

npc.gorn.stdmod_12: [EN] Bah! Go away with this bozoguy.

npc.gorn.stdmod_15: [EN] Even the strong knights need my equipment on their travels though Tibia.

npc.gorn.stdmod_19: [EN] This Oswald has not enough to work and too much time to spread rumours.
npc.gorn.stdmod_2: [EN] I am selling equipment of all kinds. Do you need anything?
npc.gorn.stdmod_20: [EN] He advices newcomers to buy at my store. I love that guy!
npc.gorn.stdmod_21: [EN] Strong as an ox, could armwrestle a minotaur, I bet.
npc.gorn.stdmod_3: [EN] The king supports Tibia's economy a lot.
npc.gorn.stdmod_4: [EN] Magic? Ask a sorcerer or druid about that.
npc.gorn.stdmod_5: [EN] I am Gorn. My goods are known all over Tibia.
npc.gorn.stdmod_6: [EN] It is exactly |TIME|. Maybe you want to buy a watch?
npc.gorn.stdmod_7: [EN] This druids are nice people, you will find them in the east of the town.
npc.gorn.stdmod_8: [EN] Even the strong knights need my equipment on their travels though Tibia.

npc.gorn.voice_1: [EN] General goods and paperware for sale!
npc.graubart.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Good bye and don't forget me!
npc.graubart.greet_msg_1: [EN] Ahoi, young man |PLAYERNAME|. Looking for work on my ship?
npc.graubart.stdmod_1: [EN] My name is Graubart, captain of the great SeaHawk!
npc.graubart.stdmod_10: [EN] Bruno is one of the best sailors I know. He is nearly as good as me. *laughs loudly*
npc.graubart.stdmod_2: [EN] Ah, my whole proud: My ship named SeaHawk. We rode out so many stormy nights together. I think I couldn't live without it.
npc.graubart.stdmod_3: [EN] Ah, my whole proud: My ship named SeaHawk. We rode out so many stormy nights together. I think I couldn't live without it.
npc.graubart.stdmod_4: [EN] I'm a merchant. I sail all over the world with my ship and trade with many different races!
npc.graubart.stdmod_5: [EN] A merchant is someone who trades goods with other people and tries to make a little profit. *laughs*
npc.graubart.stdmod_6: [EN] I trade nearly everything, for example weapons, food, water, and even magic runes.
npc.graubart.stdmod_7: [EN] You know; elves, dwarfs, lizardmen, minotaurs and many others.
npc.graubart.stdmod_9: [EN] Pssst. Marlene is not near right now...? You know... she is a lovely woman, but she talks too much! So I always try to keep distance from her because she can't stop talking.
npc.gregor.say_1: [EN] Well then, listen closely. First, you will have to prove that you are a fierce and restless warrior by bringing me 100 perfect behemoth fangs. ...
npc.gregor.say_10: [EN] Have you really managed to fulfil the task and brought me 100 perfect behemoth fangs?
npc.gregor.say_11: [EN] You're not serious asking that, are you? They come from behemoths, of course. Unless there are behemoth rabbits. Duh.
npc.gregor.say_12: [EN] Did you recover the helmet of Ramsay the Reckless?
npc.gregor.say_13: [EN] These pesky apes steal everything they can get their dirty hands on.
npc.gregor.say_14: [EN] Were you able to get hold of a flask with pure warrior's sweat?
npc.gregor.say_15: [EN] Warrior's sweat can be magically extracted from headgear worn by a true warrior, but only in small amounts. Djinns are said to be good at magical extractions.
npc.gregor.say_16: [EN] Ah, have you brought the royal steel?
npc.gregor.say_17: [EN] Royal steel can only be refined by very skilled smiths.
npc.gregor.say_18: [EN] Bah. Then you will have to wait for the day these helmets are sold in shops, but that will not happen before hell freezes over.
npc.gregor.say_19: [EN] Alright then. Come back to me once you have collected 100 perfect behemoth fangs.
npc.gregor.say_2: [EN] Secondly, please retrieve a helmet for us which has been lost a long time ago. The famous Ramsay the Reckless wore it when exploring an ape settlement. ...
npc.gregor.say_20: [EN] Would you like me to repeat the task requirements then?
npc.gregor.say_21: [EN] Lying is not exactly honourable, |PLAYERNAME|. Shame on you.
npc.gregor.say_22: [EN] I'm deeply impressed, brave Knight |PLAYERNAME|. I expected nothing less from you. Now, please retrieve Ramsay's helmet.
npc.gregor.say_23: [EN] There is no need to rush anyway.
npc.gregor.say_24: [EN] Lying is not exactly honourable, |PLAYERNAME|. Shame on you.
npc.gregor.say_25: [EN] Good work, brave Knight |PLAYERNAME|! Even though it is damaged, it has a lot of sentimental value. Now, please bring me warrior's sweat.
npc.gregor.say_26: [EN] There is no need to rush anyway.
npc.gregor.say_27: [EN] Lying is not exactly honourable, |PLAYERNAME|. Shame on you.
npc.gregor.say_28: [EN] Now that is a pleasant surprise, brave Knight |PLAYERNAME|! There is only one task left now: Obtain royal steel to have your helmet refined.
npc.gregor.say_29: [EN] There is no need to rush anyway.
npc.gregor.say_3: [EN] Third, we need a new flask of warrior's sweat. We've run out of it recently, but we need a small amount for the show battles in our arena. ...

npc.gregor.stdmod_1: [EN] Gather around me, young knights! I'm going to teach you some spells!
npc.gregor.stdmod_10: [EN] Beautiful Tibia. And with our help everyone is save.
npc.gregor.stdmod_11: [EN] It is time to join the Knights!
npc.gregor.stdmod_12: [EN] Knights are the warriors of Tibia. Without us, no one would be safe. Every brave and strong man or woman can join us.
npc.gregor.stdmod_13: [EN] Some day someone will make something happen to him...
npc.gregor.stdmod_14: [EN] A bow might be a fine weapon for someone not strong enough to wield a REAL weapon.
npc.gregor.stdmod_15: [EN] I and my students often share a cask of beer or wine at Frodo's hut.
npc.gregor.stdmod_16: [EN] Always concerned with his profit. What a loss! He was adventuring with baxter in the old days.
npc.gregor.stdmod_18: [EN] Before she became a priest she won the Miss Tibia contest three times in a row.
npc.gregor.stdmod_2: [EN] In this category I have '{Wound Cleansing}' and '{Cure Poison}'.
npc.gregor.stdmod_20: [EN] A fine game to hunt. But be careful, he cheats!
npc.gregor.stdmod_21: [EN] Bah, go away with these sorcerer tricks. Only cowards use tricks.
npc.gregor.stdmod_23: [EN] I will never understand this peaceful monks and priests.
npc.gregor.stdmod_24: [EN] He has the muscles, but lacks the guts.
npc.gregor.stdmod_3: [EN] In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.gregor.stdmod_4: [EN] I can teach you {healing spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.gregor.stdmod_5: [EN] I am the first knight. I trained some of the greatest heroes of Tibia.
npc.gregor.stdmod_6: [EN] Of course, you heard of them. Knights are the best fighters in Tibia.
npc.gregor.stdmod_8: [EN] You are joking, eh? Of course, you know me. I am Gregor, the first knight.
npc.gregor.voice_1: [EN] Gather around me, young knights! I'm going to teach you some spells!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_10a: [EN] Superb work. However, there is something else I want you to do. It is said that there is a quara general named 'Thul' who is responsible for the attacks on Liberty Bay. Find and kill the general and bring peace back to Liberty Bay! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_10b: [EN] If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Thul' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_11: [EN] Well THAT was a hunt. Good job. Have you heard about the 'Old Widow'? It must have a hideout. Try to find it and slay the beast. You can ask about new {tasks} by the way. Be aware that you can only have one 'Old Widow' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_12a: [EN] What an impressive hunt. Nicely done. By the way there is still something I want you to do for me. 'Hemming' a furious werewolf is up to mischief. Find its hideout and bring it down! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_12b: [EN] If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Hemming' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_13a: [EN] Thumbs up, nice performance. Have you heard about 'Tormentor'? Find it and slay the beast. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_13b: [EN] If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Tormentor' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_14: [EN] Well THAT was a hunt. Good job. Have you heard about 'Flameborn'? It must have a hideout. Try to find it and slay the beast. You can ask about new {tasks} by the way. Be aware that you can only have one 'Flameborn' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_15a: [EN] What an impressive hunt. Nicely done. Have you heard about 'Fazzrah'? Try to find it and slay the beast. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_15b: [EN] You can ask about new {tasks} by the way. Be aware that you can only have one 'Fazzrah' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_16a: [EN] Nicely done. However, there is something else I want you to do. I have heard that there is a stampor the hunters in the Muggy Plains call 'Tromphonyte'. It is an extremely dangerous example of its kind! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_16b: [EN] I believe you are equal to the task, |PLAYERNAME|! Find and kill it and bring peace back! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_16c: [EN] If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Tromphonyte' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_17: [EN] If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Sulphur Scuttler' task active at the same time!

npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_19: [EN] If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Many' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_1a: Spiffing work, old chap. Now I have a special task for you. Recently several citizens of Port Hope vanished. It is rumoured that they were killed by a crocodile. The people call it 'Snapper'. Hunt down and kill that evil man-eating beast. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_1b: Ask me about new {tasks} if you're up for a further hunting mission. Be aware that you can only have one 'Snapper' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_2: [EN] Nicely done! Now I shall assign you a special task. Rumour has it that there is an ancient and evil tarantula who preys on humans. She is called 'Hide'. Track her down and kill her! Good luck, old chap.
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_20a: [EN] My - you can be proud of yourself! However, you're not finished yet. There are rumours about a being called 'The Noxious Spawn' which was seen deep down in the ruins of Banuta. Try to find its hideout. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_20b: [EN] You can ask about new {tasks} bye the way. Be aware that you can only have one 'Noxious Spawn' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_21: [EN] If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Gorgo' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_22a: Such marvellous hunting skills! Perhaps you can help me with this one. Have you heard about 'Stonecracker'? ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_22b: It's the oldest and most dangerous of all behemoths and was last seen under the Cyclopolis in Edron. What do you think? Are you hunter enough? I think you are!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_23a: [EN] Good job, old chap! Are you up for a challenge? Have you heard of the legendary sea serpent called the 'Leviathan'? It must be somewhere near the spot you found. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_23b: [EN] This is a true test of your hunting skills - find it and kill it. Good hunting! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_23c: [EN] You can ask about new {tasks} by the way. Be aware that you can only have one 'Leviathan' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_24a: [EN] Outstanding! You do have impressive hunting skills. Have you already heard about Kerberos the oldest and most dangerous of all hellhounds? He must have a hideout somewhere. Try to find him and slay the beast. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_24b: [EN] You can ask about new tasks by the way. Be aware that you can only have one Kerberos task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_25: [EN] If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Ethershreck' task active at the same time!

npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_28: [EN] If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Zanakeph' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_3a: [EN] Well done, old chap. Now i shall assign you a special task. Rumour has it that there is an old carniphila somewhere in the jungle. Find Deathbine's hideout and kill it! Good luck, old chap ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_3b: [EN] Ask me about new {tasks} if you're up for further hunting mission. Be aware that you can only have one 'Deathbine' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_4: [EN] Jolly good job you did there, but now I have a special task for you. The citizens of Svargrond live in fear because of a frightfully bad-tempered mammoth they call 'Blood Tusk'. Go there and put an end to him. Happy hunting!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_5a: [EN] As I see it, you need more of a challenge! I have heard that there is an ice golem the hunters in Svargrond call 'Shardhead'. It is an extremely dangerous example of its kind! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_5b: [EN] I believe you are equal to the task, |PLAYERNAME|! If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Shardhead' task active at the same time!

npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_6b: [EN] The Yalaharians are having a spot of bother with a huge mutated rat. They call it 'Esmeralda' and you should find her somewhere in the sewers. Good hunting!

npc.grizzly_adams.boss_start_deathbine: [EN] Find Deathbine, the old carniphila, somewhere in the jungle. Find its hideout and kill it!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_start_default: [EN] Okay. Go forth and kill him.
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_start_many: [EN] Keep your head and focus when you confront her!
npc.grizzly_adams.carniphilas_1: [EN] Interesting kind and not so easy to find. The fun begins when you want to hunt {Tiquanda's Revenge}. It's strong and smart like no other carniphila.
npc.grizzly_adams.carniphilas_2: [EN] Damn walking weed-thingies! You'll find them deeper in the jungle. Weed out 150 carniphilas for our society. Alright?

npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_ancient_sca: [EN] They can be found in tombs beneath the desert around Ankrahmun. Hunt 250 ancient scarabs of them. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_apes: [EN] You'll find the apes deeper in the jungle. Hunt 300 merlkins, kongras or sibangs to complete this task. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_badgers: [EN] You'll find them in the surrounding of Svargrond. Hunt 300 badgers and you'll get a reward. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_behemoths: Behemoths must be kept away from the settlements at all costs. You'll find them east of here in the taboo-area or under Cyclopolis in Edron. Go there and hunt a few of them - shall we say... 700? Are you up for that?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_bonebeasts: [EN] In this task you must defeat 300 bonebeasts. Are you sure that you want to start this task?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_brimstone_b: [EN] You can find them on the Zaoan landmass. Kill 500 brimstone bugs to complete this task. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_crocodiles: [EN] They are a nuisance! You'll find them here in the jungle near the river. Hunt 300 crocodiles and you'll get a nice reward. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_crystal_spi: [EN] In this task you must defeat 300 crystal spiders. Are you sure that you want to start this task?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_destroyers: [EN] You can find those dark creatures on several places all over Tibia. For this task I want you to kill 650 destroyers. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_drakens: [EN] Go to the Zaoan landmass and reduce their number! Kill 900 drakens, I'll accept: draken abomination, draken elite, draken spellweaver and draken warmaster. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_gargoyles: [EN] They can be found all over Tibia. Hunt 300 gargoyles of them. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_ghastly_dra: [EN] Ghastly dragons are devastating creatures which can be found in many dangerous places all over Tibia. Kill 500 of them. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_giant_spide: [EN] Never liked spiders. Simply too many legs. And I always find them in my bath! Those nasty creepy-crawlies are a threat to the hygiene of every living being in Tibia. Hunt 500 of them. Okay?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_gnarlhounds: [EN] This particular species is found in Zao Steppe. Hunt 300 gnarlhounds of them. Understood?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_hellhounds: [EN] These harbingers of darkness can be found in many deep dungeons all over Tibia. Kill 250 of them. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_hellspawns: [EN] Recently, I heard of a disturbing development - hellspawns. If they spread to the rest of Tibia... <shudders> My task for you is to contain their numbers. Hunt 600 of them. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_high_class_: [EN] I want you to decrease the number of high class lizards on the Zaoan landmass. Hunt 800 of them. I accept lizard chosens, lizard dragon priests, lizard high guards, lizard legionnaires and lizard zaoguns. Are you interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_hydras: [EN] The hydras are located in the eastern jungle of Tiquanda and there are several mountain caves that are inhabited by them. Your task is to hunt a mere 650 hydras. Are you willing to do that?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_ice_golems: [EN] The ice golems on the glacier of Hrodmir are becoming a threat to the civilians in Svargrond. Travel to the Ice Islands and hunt 300 ice golems. Do you accept this task?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_killer_caim: [EN] Killer caiman populations can be found on the landmass of Zao. Hunt down 250 of them for this task. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_lancer_beet: [EN] Lancer beetle populations can be found on the landmass of Zao. Hunt down 300 of this crawlers for this task. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_mammoths: [EN] This particular species is found in Svargrond. Impressive beasts, but you wouldn't want one in your backyard. Hunt 300 mammoths of them. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_medusae: [EN] They live deep in the old ruins of Banuta and they are nasty! I think a mere 500 medusae should do the trick. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_mutated_bat: [EN] Recently, I heard of a disturbing development in Yalahar - a plague of monstrous mutated bats! If they were to spread to the rest of Tibia... <shudders> My task for you is to contain their numbers in Yalahar. Hunt 400 of them. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_mutated_rat: [EN] Recently, I heard of a disturbing development in Yalahar - a plague of monstrous Mutated rats! If they were to spread to the rest of Tibia.. <shudders> My task for you is to contain their numbers in Yalahar. Hunt 400 mutated rats of them. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_mutated_tig: [EN] In this task you must defeat 300 mutated tigers. Are you sure that you want to start this task?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_nightmares: [EN] Nightmares and nightmare scions can be found all over Tibia. For this task kill 400 of them. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_quara_scout: [EN] The {scouts} can be found on Malada, one of the Shattered Isles. Your task is to kill 400 quara scouts. I accept quara constrictor scouts, quara hydromancer scouts, quara mantassin scouts, quara pincher scouts and quara predator scouts, are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_sea_serpent: [EN] The sea serpent threat increases! Captain Haba knows where to find them. ...
[EN] Go to Svargrond and talk to him. 900 sea serpents, including the young ones, should be enough to reduce the threat. Got it?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_serpent_spa: [EN] Very dangerous, nasty and slimy creatures. They live deep in the old ruins of Banuta. I think a mere 800 serpent spawns should do the trick. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_stampors: [EN] Stampors can be found in a dungeon on the Zaoan landmass. Hunt 600 of them. Are you interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_stone_golem: [EN] They can be found all over Tibia. You'll find them in mountain caves or rocky dungeons. Hunt 200 stone golems of them and come back to me. Understood?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_tarantulas: [EN] There is a veritable plague of tarantulas living in the caves north of the river to the east. Can you squish 300 tarantulas for the Hunting Elite. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_terramites: [EN] This particular species can be found beneath Zao Steppe. Hunt 300 terramites of them. Understood?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_thornback_t: [EN] You'll find them on the Laguna Islands. Hunt 300 thornback tortoises of them. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_undead_drag: [EN] You are a thrill seeker? Undead dragons belong to one of the most powerful races that can be found in Tibia. Kill 400 of them. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_underwater_: [EN] As you wish. Seek out a quara settlement and hunt 600 underwater quara, it doesn't matter which type you hunt. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_wailing_wid: [EN] Wailing widow populations can be found on the landmass of Zao. Hunt down 400 of them. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_werewolves: [EN] Those nasty creatures can be found on the island of Vengoth. Hunt 300 of them. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_wyverns: [EN] They can be found all over Tibia. Hunt 300 wyverns. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.task_complete_1: [EN] Nice work, old chap. If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}.
npc.grizzly_adams.task_complete_2: [EN] Jolly good job you did there, old chap. If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}.
npc.grizzly_adams.task_complete_3: [EN] Well done! If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}.
npc.grizzly_adams.task_complete_4: [EN] That took some time, huh? Good hunting though. If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}.
npc.grizzly_adams.yes_1: [EN] Happy hunting, friend! Come back to me when you are through with your task.

npc.grof_the_guard.say_1: [EN] I think it'll rain soon and I left some laundry out for drying.
npc.grof_the_guard.say_2: [EN] Yes I'm pretty sure they have failed to send the laundry police to take care of it, you fool.
npc.grof_the_guard.stdmod_1: [EN] It's my duty to protect the city.
npc.grombur.greet_msg_1: [EN] STOP RIGHT THERE!..... Oh, just a human. What's up big guy?
npc.grombur.say_1: [EN] Oh well, I liked Nokmir. He used to be a good dwarf until that day on which he stole the ring from {Rerun}.
npc.grombur.say_2: [EN] Yeah, he's the lucky guy in this whole story. I heard rumours that emperor Rehal had plans to promote Nokmir, but after this whole thievery story, he might pick Rerun instead.
npc.grombur.say_3: [EN] Got any dwarven brown ale?? I DON'T THINK SO....and Bolfana, the tavern keeper, won't sell you anything. I'm sure about that...she doesn't like humans... I tell you what, if you get me a cask of dwarven brown ale, I allow you to enter the mine. Alright?
npc.grombur.say_4: [EN] HOW?....WHERE?....AHHHH, I don't mind....SLUUUUUURP....tastes a little flat but I had worse. Thank you. Just don't tell anyone that I let you in.
npc.grombur.say_5: [EN] Haha, fine! Don't waste time and get me the ale. See you.
npc.guard_saros.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. I really hope we'll talk again soon.
npc.guard_saros.greet_msg_1: [EN] Suon's and Bastesh's blessings! Welcome to {Issavi}, traveller.
npc.guard_saros.greet_msg_2: [EN] Suon's and Bastesh's blessings! Welcome to {Issavi}, traveller.
npc.guard_saros.say_1: [EN] I would never have guessed that.
npc.guard_saros.say_11: [EN] I am a little sad, that you seem to have forgotten me, handsome. I am Aruda.
npc.guard_saros.say_13: [EN] Oh, I like it, how you say my name.
npc.guard_saros.say_14: [EN] Please don't be so rude to look for the time if you are talking to me.
npc.guard_saros.say_15: [EN] I am deeply sorry, I can't help you.
npc.guard_saros.say_16: [EN] UH! What a terrifying topic. Please let us speak about something more pleasant, I am a weak and small woman after all.
npc.guard_saros.say_17: [EN] What gives you the impression, I am the kind of women, you find in sewers?
npc.guard_saros.say_18: [EN] You should ask about that in one of the temples.
npc.guard_saros.say_19: [EN] The king, that lives in this fascinating castle? I think he does look kind of cute in his luxurious robes, doesn't he?
npc.guard_saros.say_2: [EN] Oh, sorry, I was distracted, what did you say?
npc.guard_saros.say_20: [EN] He is soooo strong! What muscles! What a body! Did you ask him for a date?
npc.guard_saros.say_21: [EN] He is soooo strong! What muscles! What a body! On the other hand, compared to you he looks quite puny.
npc.guard_saros.say_22: [EN] He is a little simple minded but always nice and well dressed.
npc.guard_saros.say_23: [EN] He should really sell some stylish gowns or something like that. We Tibians never get some clothing of the latest fashion. It's a shame.
npc.guard_saros.say_24: [EN] I don't understand this lonely monks. I love company too much to become one. Hehehe!
npc.guard_saros.say_25: [EN] Oh, isn't he funny? I could listen to him the whole day.
npc.guard_saros.say_26: [EN] As far as I know, he is working in the castle.
npc.guard_saros.say_27: [EN] I am a little shy and so don't hear many rumors.
npc.guard_saros.say_28: [EN] Oh, you little devil, stop talking like that! <blush>
npc.guard_saros.say_29: [EN] I know only little about weapons. Can you tell me something about them, please?
npc.guard_saros.say_3: [EN] Oh, I just remember I have some work to do, sorry. Bye!
npc.guard_saros.say_30: [EN] I believe that love is stronger than magic, don't you agree?
npc.guard_saros.say_31: [EN] Oh, sorry, I have to hurry, bye!
npc.guard_saros.say_32: [EN] I would like to visit the beach more often, but I guess it's too dangerous.
npc.guard_saros.say_33: [EN] I love this castle! It's so beautiful.
npc.guard_saros.say_34: [EN] Powerful sorcerers frighten me a little.
npc.guard_saros.say_35: [EN] I personally think it's inappropriate for a woman to become a warrior, what do you think about that?
npc.guard_saros.say_36: [EN] Druids seldom visit a town, what do you know about druids?
npc.guard_saros.say_37: [EN] I like brave fighters like him.
npc.guard_saros.say_39: [EN] I like dogs, the little ones at least. Do you like dogs, too?
npc.guard_saros.say_4: [EN] Take some time to talk to me!
npc.guard_saros.say_40: [EN] Oh, I am just a girl and know nothing about magic swords and such things.
npc.guard_saros.say_41: [EN] I ... don't know someone named like that.
npc.guard_saros.say_42: [EN] Yenny? I know no Yenny, nor have I ever used that name! You have mistook me with someone else.
npc.guard_saros.say_5: [EN] Well ... I have met him for a little while .. but this was nothing serious.
npc.guard_saros.say_6: [EN] I remember that grapes were his favourites. He was almost addicted to them.
npc.guard_saros.say_7: [EN] Thank you very much. How kind of you to care about me. I am fine, thank you.
npc.guard_saros.say_8: [EN] This is the continent you are currently visiting. You will find vast, dry steppes here as well as high mountains, the river Nykri and the big city {Issavi}.
npc.guard_saros.say_9: [EN] Issavi is the capital of {Kilmaresh}, also called the Golden City. This city has a motto: An open gate for those of peace. This means, anyone is welcome here as long as they respect our laws, be it humans, elves, minotaurs or even a medusa.
npc.guard_saros.voice_1: [EN] Praised be Suon, the Benevolent King!
npc.guard_saros.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] I hope to see you soon.

npc.gurbasch.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Lovely steamboat, ain't it? I can even offer you a {passage} if you like.
npc.gurbasch.greet_msg_1: [EN] Where do you want me to take you? To {Kazordoon}, {Farmine} or {Gnomprona}?
npc.gurbasch.stdmod_1: [EN] Passages to Kazordoon! Gotta try the beer there.
npc.gurbasch.stdmod_10: [EN] Would you like to travel to Gnomprona for |TRAVELCOST|?
npc.gurbasch.stdmod_3:
[EN] Well, you might be just the hero they need there. To tell you the truth, some our most reliable ore mines have started to run low. ... \z
	This is why we developed new steamship technologies to be able to further explore and cartograph the great subterraneous rivers. Our brothers have established a base on a continent far, far away. ... \z
	We call that the far, far away base. But since it will hopefully become a flourishing mine one day, most of us started to call it {Farmine}. The dwarfs there could really use some help right now.
npc.gurbasch.stdmod_4: [EN] Do you seek a ride to Farmine for |TRAVELCOST|?
npc.gurbasch.stdmod_7: [EN] Do you want to go to Kazordoon to try the beer there? |TRAVELCOST|?
npc.gurbasch.voice_1: [EN] Passages to Kazordoon! Gotta try the beer there.
npc.habdel.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome |PLAYERNAME|! See the fine {weapons} I sell.
npc.habdel.multi_1: [EN] Listen, um... I know that Ishina has been wanting a comb for a long time... not just any comb, but a mermaid's comb. She said it prevents split ends... or something. ...
npc.habdel.multi_2: [EN] Do you think you could get one for me so I can give it to her? I really would appreciate it.
npc.habdel.say_1: [EN] My scimitar? Yes, that is a true masterpiece. Of course I could make one for you, but I have a small request. Would you fulfil a task for me?
npc.habdel.say_2: [EN] Have you brought a mermaid's comb for Ishina?
npc.habdel.say_3: [EN] Brilliant! I will wait for you to return with a mermaid's comb then.
npc.habdel.say_5: [EN] Yeah! That's it! I can't wait to give it to her! Oh - but first, I'll fulfil my promise: Here is your scimitar! Thanks again!
npc.habdel.stdmod_1: [EN] I sell the finest weapons in town. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.hairycles.greet_msg_1: [EN] Oh! Hello! Hello! Did not notice!
npc.hairycles.greet_msg_2: [EN] Be greeted, friend of the ape people. If you want to {trade}, just ask for my offers. If you are injured, ask for healing.
npc.hairycles.multi_1: [EN] So listen, please. Plague was not ordinary plague. That's why Hairycles could not heal at first. It is new curse of evil lizard people ...
npc.hairycles.multi_10: [EN] Me sure to make cure so strong to drive away all plague. But to create great cure me need powerful components ...
npc.hairycles.multi_11: [EN] Me need whisper moss. Whisper moss growing south of human settlement is. Problem is, evil little dworcs harvest all whisper moss immediately ...
npc.hairycles.multi_12: [EN] Me know they hoard some in their underground lair. My people raided dworcs often before humans came. So we know the moss is hidden in east of upper level of dworc lair ...
npc.hairycles.multi_13: [EN] You go there and take good moss from evil dworcs. Talk with me about mission when having moss.
npc.hairycles.multi_14: [EN] Finally my people are safe! You have done incredible good for ape people and one day even me brethren will recognise that. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_15: [EN] I wish I could speak for all when me call you true friend but my people need time to get accustomed to change. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_16: [EN] Let us hope one day whole Banuta will greet you as a friend. Perhaps you want to check me offers for special friends... or shamanic powers.
npc.hairycles.multi_17: [EN] You have proven yourself a friend, me will grant you permission to enter the deepest catacombs under Banuta which we have sealed in the past. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_18: [EN] Me still can sense the evil presence there. We did not dare to go deeper and fight creatures of evil there. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_19: [EN] You may go there, fight the evil and find the monument of the serpent god and destroy it with hammer me give to you. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_2: [EN] I think curse on little one was only a try. We have to be prepared for big strike ...
npc.hairycles.multi_20: [EN] Only then my people will be safe. Please tell Hairycles, will you go there?
npc.hairycles.multi_21: [EN] Now that the false cult was stopped, we need to strengthen the spirit of my people. We need a symbol of our faith that ape people can see and touch. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_22: [EN] Since you have proven a friend of the ape people I will grant you permission to enter the forbidden land. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_23: [EN] To enter the forbidden land in the north-east of the jungle, look for a cave in the mountains east of it. There you will find the blind prophet. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_24: [EN] Tell him Hairycles you sent and he will grant you entrance. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_25: [EN] Forbidden land is home of Bong. Holy giant ape big as mountain. Don't annoy him in any way but look for a hair of holy ape. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_26: [EN] You might find at places he has been, should be easy to see them since Bong is big. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_27: [EN] Return a hair of the holy ape to me. Will you do this for Hairycles?
npc.hairycles.multi_28: [EN] Mighty life charm is protecting us now! But my people are still in danger. Danger from within. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_29: [EN] Some of my people try to mimic lizards to become strong. Like lizards did before, this cult drinks strange fluid that lizards left when fled. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_3: [EN] Me need papers of lizard magician! For sure you find it in his hut in their dwelling. It's south east of jungle. Go look there please! Are you willing to go?
npc.hairycles.multi_30: [EN] Under the city still the underground temple of lizards is. There you find casks with red fluid. Take crowbar and destroy three of them to stop this madness. Are you willing to do that?
npc.hairycles.multi_31: [EN] Last ingredient for charm of life is thing to lure magic. Only thing me know like that is mushroom called witches' cap. Me was told it be found in isle called Fibula, where humans live. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_32: [EN] Hidden under Fibula is a secret dungeon. There you will find witches' cap. Are you willing to go there for good ape people?
npc.hairycles.multi_33: [EN] So much there is to do for Hairycles to prepare charm that will protect all ape people. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_34: [EN] You can help more. To create charm of life me need mighty token of life! Best is egg of a regenerating beast as a hydra is. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_35: [EN] Bring me egg of hydra please. You may find it in lair of Hydra at little lake south east of our lovely city Banuta! You think you can do?
npc.hairycles.multi_36: [EN] Ah yes that scroll. Sadly me not could read it yet. But the holy banana me insight gave! In dreams Hairycles saw where to find solution. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_37: [EN] Me saw a stone with lizard signs and other signs at once. If you read signs and tell Hairycles, me will know how to read signs. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_38: [EN] You go east to big desert. In desert there city. East of city under sand hidden tomb is. You will have to dig until you find it, so take shovel. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_39: [EN] Go down in tomb until come to big level and then go down another. There you find a stone with signs between two huge red stones. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_4: [EN] So listen, little ape was struck by plague. Hairycles not does know what plague it is. That is strange. Hairycles should know. But Hairycles learnt lots and lots ...
npc.hairycles.multi_40: [EN] Read it and return to me. Are you up to that challenge?
npc.hairycles.multi_41: [EN] Whisper moss strong is, but me need liquid that humans have to make it work ...
npc.hairycles.multi_42: [EN] Our raiders brought it from human settlement, it's called cough syrup. Go ask healer there for it.
npc.hairycles.multi_5: [EN] Me sure to make cure so strong to drive away all plague. But to create great cure me need powerful components ...
npc.hairycles.multi_6: [EN] Me need whisper moss. Whisper moss growing south of human settlement is. Problem is, evil little dworcs harvest all whisper moss immediately ...
npc.hairycles.multi_7: [EN] Me know they hoard some in their underground lair. My people raided dworcs often before humans came. So we know the moss is hidden in east of upper level of dworc lair ...
npc.hairycles.multi_8: [EN] You go there and take good moss from evil dworcs. Talk with me about mission when having moss.
npc.hairycles.multi_9: [EN] So listen, little ape was struck by plague. Hairycles not does know what plague it is. That is strange. Hairycles should know. But Hairycles learnt lots and lots ...
npc.hairycles.say_1: [EN] These are dire times for our people. Problems plenty are in this times. But me people not grant trust easy. Are you willing to prove you friend of ape people?
npc.hairycles.say_10: [EN] You brought Hairycles witches' cap from Fibula?
npc.hairycles.say_11: [EN] You do please Hairycles again, friend. Me hope madness will not spread further now. Perhaps you are ready for other mission.
npc.hairycles.say_12: [EN] Please destroy three casks in the complex beneath Banuta, so my people will come to senses again.
npc.hairycles.say_13: [EN] You brought hair of holy ape?
npc.hairycles.say_14: [EN] Get a hair of holy ape from forbidden land in east. Speak with blind prophet in cave.
npc.hairycles.say_15: [EN] Me know its much me asked for but go into the deepest catacombs under Banuta and destroy the monument of the serpent god.
npc.hairycles.say_16: [EN] No more missions await you right now, friend. Perhaps you want to check me offers for special friends... or shamanic powers.
npc.hairycles.say_17: [EN] Oh you bring cookie for old Hairycles?
npc.hairycles.say_18: [EN] Me truly proud of you, friend. You learn many about plants, charms and ape people. Me want grant you shamanic power now. You ready?
npc.hairycles.say_19: [EN] You already are shaman and doctor. Me proud of you.
npc.hairycles.say_2: [EN] Oh, you brought me whisper moss? Good hairless ape you are! Can me take it?
npc.hairycles.say_20: [EN] You not have finished journey for wisdom yet, young human.
npc.hairycles.say_21: [EN] You look for food and rest.
npc.hairycles.say_22: [EN] You look for food and rest.
npc.hairycles.say_23: [EN] To become friend of ape people a long and difficult way is. We do not trust easy but help is needed. Will you listen to story of Hairycles?
npc.hairycles.say_24: [EN] Hairycles sad is now. But perhaps you will change mind one day.
npc.hairycles.say_26: [EN] Stupid, you no have the moss me need. Go get it. It's somewhere in dworc lair. If you lost it, they might restocked it meanwhile. If you need to hear background of all again, ask Hairycles for {background}.
npc.hairycles.say_27: [EN] Ah yes! That's it. Thank you for bringing mighty whisper moss to Hairycles. It will help but still much is to be done. Just ask for other mission if you ready.
npc.hairycles.say_28: [EN] Strange being you are! Our people need help!
npc.hairycles.say_29: [EN] No no, not right syrup you have. Go get other, get right health syrup.
npc.hairycles.say_3: [EN] Please hurry. Bring me whisper moss from dworc lair. Make sure it is from dworc lair! Take it yourself only! If you need to hear background of all again, ask Hairycles for {background}.
npc.hairycles.say_30: [EN] You so good! Brought syrup to me! Thank you, will prepare cure now. Just ask for {mission} if you want help again.
npc.hairycles.say_32: [EN] Me sad. Me expected better from you!
npc.hairycles.say_33: [EN] Good thing that is! Report about your mission when have scroll.
npc.hairycles.say_34: [EN] Me sad. Me expected better from you!
npc.hairycles.say_35: [EN] That's bad news. If you lost it, only way to get other is to kill holy serpents. But you can't go there so you must ask adventurers who can.
npc.hairycles.say_36: [EN] No! That not scroll me looking for. Silly hairless ape you are. Go to village of lizards and get it there on your own!
npc.hairycles.say_37: [EN] You brought scroll with lizard text? Good! I will see what text tells me! Come back when ready for other mission.
npc.hairycles.say_38: [EN] That's bad news. If you lost it, only way to get other is to kill holy serpents. But you can't go there so you must ask adventurers who can.
npc.hairycles.say_39: [EN] Good thing that is! Report about mission when you have read those signs.
npc.hairycles.say_4: [EN] You brought me that cough syrup from human healer me asked for?
npc.hairycles.say_40: [EN] Me sad. Me expected better from you!
npc.hairycles.say_41: [EN] Oh, so clear is all now! Easy it will be to read the signs now! Soon we will know what to do! Thank you again! Ask for mission if you feel ready.
npc.hairycles.say_42: [EN] Me need to see it in your mind, other there is no way to proceed.
npc.hairycles.say_43: [EN] You brave hairless ape! Get me hydra egg. If you lose egg, you probably have to fight many, many hydras to get another.
npc.hairycles.say_44: [EN] Me sad. Me expected better from you!
npc.hairycles.say_45: [EN] You not have egg of hydra. Please get one!
npc.hairycles.say_46: [EN] Ah, the egg! Mighty warrior you be! Thank you. Hairycles will put it at safe place immediately.
npc.hairycles.say_47: [EN] Please hurry. Hairycles not knows when evil lizards strike again.
npc.hairycles.say_48: [EN] Long journey it will take, good luck to you.
npc.hairycles.say_49: [EN] Me sad. Me expected better from you!
npc.hairycles.say_5: [EN] Little ape should be healthy soon. Me so happy is. Thank you again! But me suspect we in more trouble than we thought. Will you help us again?
npc.hairycles.say_50: [EN] Not right mushroom you have. Find me a witches' cap on Fibula!
npc.hairycles.say_51: [EN] Incredible, you brought a witches' cap! Now me can prepare mighty charm of life. Yet still other {missions} will await you, friend.
npc.hairycles.say_52: [EN] Please try to find me a witches' cap on Fibula.
npc.hairycles.say_53: [EN] Hairycles sure you will make it. Good luck, friend.
npc.hairycles.say_55: [EN] Hairycles proud of you. Go and find holy hair. Good luck, friend.
npc.hairycles.say_57: [EN] You no have hair. You lost it? Go and look again.
npc.hairycles.say_58: [EN] Incredible! You got a hair of holy Bong! This will raise the spirit of my people. You are truly a friend. But one last mission awaits you.
npc.hairycles.say_59: [EN] You no have hair. You lost it? Go and look again.
npc.hairycles.say_6: [EN] You got scroll from lizard village in south east?
npc.hairycles.say_60: [EN] Hairycles sure you will make it. Just use hammer on all that looks like snake or lizard. Tell Hairycles if you succeed with mission.
npc.hairycles.say_62: [EN] Friend of the ape people! Take my gift and become me apprentice! Here is shaman clothing for you!
npc.hairycles.say_64: [EN] You have no cookie that I'd like.
npc.hairycles.say_65: [EN] Thank you, you are ... YOU SON OF LIZARD!
npc.hairycles.say_7: [EN] Ah yes, you read the signs in tomb? Good! May me look into your mind to see what you saw?
npc.hairycles.say_8: [EN] You still don't know signs on stone, go and look for it in tomb east in desert.
npc.hairycles.say_9: [EN] You bring Hairycles egg of hydra?
npc.hairycles.stdmod_1: [EN] Me great {wizard}. Me great doctor of {ape people}. Me know many plants. Me old and me have seen many things.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_2: [EN] We see many things and learning quick. Merlkin magic learn quick, quick. We just watch and learn. Sometimes we try and learn.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_3: [EN] Things not good now. Need helper to do {mission} for me people.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_4: [EN] We be {kongra}, {sibang} and {merlkin}. Strange hairless ape people live in city called Port Hope.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_5: [EN] Kongra verry strong. Kongra verry angry verry fast. Take care when kongra comes. Better climb on highest tree.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_6: [EN] Sibang verry fast and funny. Sibang good gather food. Sibang know {jungle} well.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_7: [EN] Merlkin we are. Merlkin verry wise, merlkin learn many things quick. Teach other apes things a lot. Making {heal} and making {magic}.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_8: [EN] We see many things and learning quick. Merlkin magic learn quick, quick. We just watch and learn. Sometimes we try and learn.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_9: [EN] Jungle is dangerous. Jungle also provides us food. Take care when in jungle and safe you be.
npc.hal.say_1: [EN] Hicks! I... I... <he is obviously drunk and his report more than confusing>.
npc.hal.say_2: [EN] You can {pass} either to the {Arena Quarter} or {Alchemist Quarter}. Which one will it be?
npc.halvar.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello competitor! Do you want to {fight} in the arena or shall I explain the {rules} first?
npc.halvar.say_1: [EN] So you agree with the {rules} and want to participate in the {challenge}? The {fee} for one try in {{}} is {} gold pieces. Do you really want to participate and pay the {fee}?
npc.halvar.say_13: [EN] You already paid the fee, go and fight!
npc.halvar.say_15: [EN] You've already completed the arena in all {difficulty levels}.
npc.halvar.say_16: [EN] As you wish! You can pass the door now and enter the teleporter to the pits.
npc.halvar.say_17: [EN] You do not have enough money.
npc.halvar.say_18: [EN] Come back when you are ready then.
npc.halvar.stdmod_1: [EN] What do you want to know? Something about the three different {difficulties}, the {general} rules or the {prices}? Maybe you also want to know what happens when you {die}?
npc.halvar.stdmod_10: [EN] Basically you pay me a {fee}, and you are sent into an arena with 10 different stages. If you succeed you will be rewarded accordingly.
npc.halvar.stdmod_11: [EN] My job is to explain about the rules and to get the fee from the competitors.
npc.halvar.stdmod_12: [EN] Well I would rather call it an {Ultimate Challenge} than a mission.
npc.halvar.stdmod_2: [EN] There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_3: [EN] There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_4: [EN] There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_5: [EN] That is the easiest way in our arena. The {fee} is 1000 gold. We were setting this up for of our children to challenge some easy monsters and train them for the future.
npc.halvar.stdmod_6: [EN] The most common difficulty for us. The {fee} is 5000 gold. So if you are experienced in fighting middle class monsters this is your challenge!
npc.halvar.stdmod_7: [EN] Only the strongest among us will take this challenge. The {fee} is 10000 gold. If you pass that I promise you the respect of all citizens here. You will be a hero!
npc.halvar.stdmod_8: [EN] The fee is either 1000, 5000 or 10000 gold for one try. Remember that if you {die}, it is YOUR problem and you won't be able to get back to your corpse and your backpack.
npc.halvar.stdmod_9: [EN] It would be better not to die! In every pit there is an emergency exit, the portal to the south. If you die in a pit... well... your corpse and backpack are gone, so you enter the arena at your own risk.
npc.hamish.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hi there, fellow adventurer. \z What's your need? Say {trade} and we'll soon get you fixed up. Or ask me about {potions}, {wands}, or {runes}.
npc.hamish.say_1: [EN] Small and deceptively friendly-looking island. Well, I used to study the plants and herbs here for my potions.
npc.hamish.say_2: [EN] Nowadays, I leave that to Oressa, she has a better way with that horrible wildlife here. I prefer to distil potions in the quiet of my lab. If you need some potions, runes or other magic equipment, ask for a trade.
npc.hamish.say_3: [EN] Dawnport is not far off from the coast of the Tibian Mainland. Lots of cities, monsters, bandits, brigands, mean folk and people of low understanding with no sense of respect towards alchemical genius. <mutters to himself>
npc.hamish.say_4: [EN] Ahem. Once you're level 8, you should be experienced enough to choose your definite vocation and leave Dawnport for Main - and Tibia definitely needs more skilled adventurers to keep those monsters in check which roam our lands!
npc.hamish.say_5: [EN] I wish I had thought of changing my name to that of a hero. Would have smoothed my way no end!
npc.hamish.say_6: [EN] Anyway, whatever he was before he joined, Tybald now fits the bill of the legendary hero. He even has a crush on lady Oressa. Cute. <chuckles>
npc.hamish.say_7: [FR] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.hamish.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Take your pick! Or maybe you want to look only at {potions}, {wands} or {runes}?
npc.hamish.stdmod_10: [EN] Mana potions to refill your magic power!
npc.hamish.stdmod_2: [EN] Potions! Wands! Runes! Get them here!
npc.hamish.stdmod_3: [EN] You levelled up but your wand is old? Come and buy a new one here!
npc.hamish.stdmod_4: [EN] Ran out of mana or a little kablooie? Come to me to resupply!
npc.hamish.stdmod_5: [EN] Low on magic and need a little extra? Get yourself a rune!
npc.hamish.stdmod_6: [EN] Pack of monsters give you trouble? Throw an area rune at them!
npc.hamish.stdmod_7: [EN] Health potions to refill your health in combat!
npc.hamish.stdmod_8: [EN] Taking back empty potion flasks! Get your deposit back here!
npc.hamish.stdmod_9: [EN] Careful with that! That's a highly reactive potion you have there!
npc.hamish.voice_10: [EN] Mana potions to refill your magic power!
npc.hamish.voice_2: [EN] Potions! Wands! Runes! Get them here!

npc.hanna.greet_msg_1: [EN] Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What do you need? Have a look at my wonderful {offers} in gems and jewellery.
npc.hanna.say_1: [EN] Pretty, isn't it? My friend Amber taught me how to make it, but I could help you with one if you like. What do you say?
npc.hanna.say_2: [EN] Oh, you're back already? Did you bring a legion helmet, 100 chicken feathers and 50 honeycombs?
npc.hanna.say_4: [EN] Okay, here we go, listen closely! I need a few things... a basic hat of course, maybe a legion helmet would do. Then about 100 chicken feathers... and 50 honeycombs as glue. That's it, come back to me once you gathered it!
npc.hanna.say_5: [EN] Aw, I guess you don't like feather hats. No big deal.
npc.hanna.say_6: [EN] Sorry, but I can't see a legion helmet.
npc.hanna.say_7: [EN] Sorry, but you don't enough chicken feathers.
npc.hanna.say_8: [EN] Sorry, but you don't have enough honeycombs.
npc.hanna.say_9: [EN] Great job! That must have taken a lot of work. Okay, you put it like this... then glue like this... here!
npc.hanna.stdmod_1: [EN] Gems and jewellery! Best prices in town!
npc.hanna.stdmod_2: [EN] I am a jeweler. Maybe you want to have a look at my wonderful offers.
npc.hanna.voice_1: [EN] Gems and jewellery! Best prices in town!
npc.hardek.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Good bye. Visit me whenever you want to sell something.
npc.hardek.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need my services?
npc.hardek.stdmod_1: [EN] Buying and selling all sorts of weapons and armors!
npc.hardek.voice_1: [EN] Buying and selling all sorts of weapons and armors!
npc.hardek.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Good bye. Visit me whenever you want to sell something.
npc.harlow.greet_msg_1: [EN] What do you want, |PLAYERNAME|? I'm a {busy} man.
npc.harlow.say_1: [EN] What the heck, stop bothering me with your questions.
npc.harlow.stdmod_1: [EN] So you are saying you're looking for someone to take you to Vengoth?
npc.harlow.stdmod_3: [EN] I could do that, it's not far from here. I don't run a charity organisation, though. Tell you what. Give me 100 gold pieces, and me and my boat are yours for the trip. Okay?
npc.harlow.stdmod_6: [EN] Want me to bring you to Vengoth again for 100 gold?
npc.harlow_vengoth.greet_msg_1: [EN] Want to go back to {Yalahar} for 50 gold? Just ask me.
npc.harlow_vengoth.stdmod_1: [EN] Do you seek a passage to Yalahar for |TRAVELCOST|?
npc.harog.farewell_msg_1: [EN] It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.harog.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Keep in mind you won't find better offers here. Just browse through my wares.
npc.haroun.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Farewell! May the serene light of the enlightened one rest shine on your travels.
npc.haroun.multi_2: [EN] |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
npc.haroun.say_1: [EN] Whoa! A human! This is no place for you, |PLAYERNAME|. Go and play somewhere else.
npc.haroun.say_11: [EN] I'm sorry, human. But you need Gabel's permission to trade with me.
npc.haroun.say_2: [EN] Be greeted, human |PLAYERNAME|. How can a humble djinn be of service?
npc.haroun.say_3: [EN] Do you want to trade Boots of haste for Enchanted Chicken Wing?
npc.haroun.say_4: [EN] Do you want to trade 4 Warrior Helmet for Warrior Sweat?
npc.haroun.say_5: [EN] Do you want to trade 2 Royal Helmet for Fighting Spirit
npc.haroun.say_6: [EN] Do you want to trade 3 Fire Sword for Magic Sulphur
npc.haroun.say_7: [EN] I trade Enchanted Chicken Wing for Boots of Haste, Warrior Sweat for 4 Warrior Helmets, Fighting Spirit for 2 Royal Helmet Magic Sulphur for 3 Fire Swords
npc.haroun.say_9: [EN] Sorry but you don't have the item.
npc.haroun.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] At your service, just browse through my wares.
npc.harsky.farewell_msg_1: [EN] LONG LIVE THE KING! You may leave now!
npc.harsky.stdmod_1: [EN] MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the king greet with his title!
npc.harsky.stdmod_2: [EN] MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the king greet with his title!
npc.hawkhurst.greet_msg_1: [EN] Ahoy, matey! Lookin' for a {passage}, eh.
npc.hawkhurst.stdmod_2: [EN] Ye' want a passage to the blasted isle, right? {Yes} or {no}?
npc.hawkhurst_ingol.greet_msg_1: [EN] Ahoy, matey! Lookin' for a {passage}, eh.
npc.hawkhurst_ingol.stdmod_2: [EN] Ye' want a passage back to cormaya? {Yes} or {no}.
npc.henricus.multi_1: [EN] Even though they claim differently, this city is in the firm grip of Zathroth and his evil minions. Their whole twisted religion is a mockery of the teachings of our gods ...
npc.henricus.multi_10: [EN] Concerned, the inquisition watches the attempts of these guilds to become more and more independent and to make own decisions. ...
npc.henricus.multi_11: [EN] Unfortunately, the sorcerer guild has become dangerously influential and so the hands of our priests are tied due to political matters ...
npc.henricus.multi_12: [EN] The druids lately claim that they are serving Crunor's will and not Uman's. Such heresy could only become possible with the independence of Carlin from the Thaian kingdom. ...
npc.henricus.multi_13: [EN] The spiritual centre of the druids switched to Carlin where they have much influence and cannot be supervised by the inquisition.
npc.henricus.multi_14: [EN] In the past, the order of Banor was the only order of knighthood in existence. In the course of time, the order concentrated more and more on spiritual matters rather than on worldly ones. ...
npc.henricus.multi_15: [EN] Nowadays, the order of Banor sanctions new orders and offers spiritual guidance to the fighters of good.
npc.henricus.multi_16: [EN] The Thaian kings are crowned by a representative of the churches. This means they reign in the name of the gods of good and are part of the godly plan for humanity. ...
npc.henricus.multi_17: [EN] As nominal head of the church of Banor, the kings aren't only worldly but also spiritual authorities. ...
npc.henricus.multi_18: [EN] The kings fund the inquisition and sometimes provide manpower in matters of utmost importance. The inquisition, in return, protects the realm from heretics and individuals that aim to undermine the holy reign of the kings.
npc.henricus.multi_19: [EN] The dark powers are always present. If a human shows only the slightest weakness, they try to corrupt him and to lure him into their service. ...
npc.henricus.multi_2: [EN] As soon as we have gathered the strength, we should crush this city once and for all.
npc.henricus.multi_20: [EN] We must be constantly aware of evil that comes in many disguises.
npc.henricus.multi_21: [EN] Incredible! You're a true defender of faith! I grant you the title of a High Inquisitor for your noble deeds. From now on you can obtain the blessing of the inquisition which makes the pilgrimage of ashes obsolete ...
npc.henricus.multi_22: [EN] The blessing of the inquisition will bestow upon you all available blessings for the price of 110000 gold. Also, don't forget to ask me about your {outfit} to receive the final addon as demon hunter.
npc.henricus.multi_23: [EN] Indeed, this is exactly what my other sources told me. Of course I knew the outcome of this investigation in advance. This was just a test. ...
npc.henricus.multi_24: [EN] Well, now that you've proven yourself as useful, you can ask me for another mission. Let's see if you can handle some field duty, too.
npc.henricus.multi_25: [EN] So the beast is finally dead! Thank the gods. At least some things work out in our favour ...
npc.henricus.multi_26: [EN] Our other operatives were not that lucky, though. But you will learn more about that in your next {mission}.
npc.henricus.multi_27: [EN] We've got information about something very dangerous going on on the isle of Edron. The demons are preparing something there ...
npc.henricus.multi_28: [EN] Something that is a threat to all of us. Our investigators were able to acquire vital information before some of them were slain by a demon named Ungreez. ...
npc.henricus.multi_29: [EN] It'll be your task to take revenge and to kill that demon. You'll find him in the depths of Edron. Good luck.
npc.henricus.multi_3: [EN] Edron illustrates perfectly why the inquisition is needed and why we need more funds and manpower. ...
npc.henricus.multi_30: [EN] You're indeed a dedicated protector of the true believers. Don't stop now. Kill as many of these creatures as you can. ...
npc.henricus.multi_31: [EN] I also have a reward for your great efforts. Talk to me about your {demon hunter outfit} anytime from now on. Afterwards, let's talk about the next mission that's awaiting you.
npc.henricus.multi_32: [EN] You've handled heretics, witches, vampires and ghosts. Now be prepared to face the most evil creatures we are fighting - demons. Your new task is extremely simple, though far from easy. ...
npc.henricus.multi_33: [EN] Go and slay demonic creatures wherever you find them. Bring me 20 of their essences as a proof of your accomplishments.
npc.henricus.multi_34: [EN] We've got a report about an abandoned and haunted house in Liberty Bay. I want you to examine this house. It's the only ruin in Liberty Bay so you should have no trouble finding it. ...
npc.henricus.multi_35: [EN] There's an evil being somewhere. I assume that it will be easier to find the right spot at night. Use this vial of holy water on that spot to drive out the evil being.
npc.henricus.multi_36: [EN] I think it's time to truly test your abilities. One of our allies has requested assistance. I think you are just the right person to help him ...
npc.henricus.multi_37: [EN] Storkus is an old and grumpy dwarf who works as a vampire hunter since many, many decades. He's quite successful but even hehas his limits. ...
npc.henricus.multi_38: [EN] So occasionally, we send him help. In return he trains and tests our recruits. It's an advantageous agreement for both sides ...
npc.henricus.multi_39: [EN] You'll find him in his cave at the mountain outside of Kazordoon. He'll tell you about your next mission.
npc.henricus.multi_4: [EN] Our agents were on their way to investigate certain occurrences there when some faithless knights fled to some unholy ruins. ...
npc.henricus.multi_40: [EN] Listen, we have information about a heretic coven that hides in a mountain called the Big Old One. The witches reach this cursed place on flying brooms and think they are safe there. ...
npc.henricus.multi_41: [EN] I've arranged a flying carpet that will bring you to their hideout. Travel to Femor Hills and tell the carpet pilot the codeword 'eclipse' ...
npc.henricus.multi_42: [EN] He'll bring you to your destination. At their meeting place, you'll find a cauldron in which they cook some forbidden brew ...
npc.henricus.multi_43: [EN] Use this vial of holy water to destroy the brew. Also steal their grimoire and bring it to me.
npc.henricus.multi_44: [EN] Let's see if you are worthy. Take an inquisitor's field guide from the box in the back room. ...
npc.henricus.multi_45: [EN] Follow the instructions in the guide to talk to the Thaian guards that protect the walls and gates of the city and test their loyalty. Then report to me about your {mission}.
npc.henricus.multi_5: [EN] We were unable to wipe them out and the local order of knighthood was of little help. ...
npc.henricus.multi_6: [EN] It's almost sure that something dangerous is going on there, so we have to continue our efforts.
npc.henricus.multi_7: [EN] Fafnar is mostly worshipped by the peasants and farmers in rural areas. ...
npc.henricus.multi_8: [EN] The inquisition has a close eye on these activities. Simply people tend to mix local superstitions with the teachings of the gods. This again may lead to heretical subcults.
npc.henricus.multi_9: [EN] The church of Uman oversees the education of the masses as well as the doings of the sorcerer and druid guilds. It decides which lines of research are in accordance with the will of Uman and which are not. ...
npc.henricus.say_1: [EN] Do you want to receive the blessing of the inquisition - which means {} blessings - for {} gold?
npc.henricus.say_10: [EN] Your current mission is to exorcise an evil being from a house in Liberty Bay. Are you done with that mission?
npc.henricus.say_12: [EN] Destroy the shadow nexus using this vial of holy water and kill all demon lords.
npc.henricus.say_13: [EN] Your current mission is to destroy the shadow nexus in the Demon Forge. Are you done with that mission?
npc.henricus.say_14: [EN] So be it. Now you are a member of the inquisition. You might ask me for a {mission} to raise in my esteem.
npc.henricus.say_15: [EN] You haven't done your mission yet.
npc.henricus.say_16: [EN] Good, you've returned. Your skill in practical matters seems to be useful. If you're ready for a further mission, just ask.
npc.henricus.say_17: [EN] You haven't done your mission with {Storkus} yet.
npc.henricus.say_18: [EN] Well, this was an easy task, but your next mission will be much more challenging.
npc.henricus.say_19: [EN] You haven't done your mission with {Storkus} yet.
npc.henricus.say_2: [EN] Do you want to buy the special flask of holy water for {} gold?
npc.henricus.say_20: [EN] Come back when you have destroyed the shadow nexus.
npc.henricus.say_22: [EN] You have been blessed by all of five gods!, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.henricus.say_23: [EN] Come back when you have enough money.
npc.henricus.say_25: [EN] Come back when you have enough money.
npc.henricus.say_26: [EN] Fine, fine. You have proven that you can work efficiently. Still, only further missions will show if you are truly capable. Ask me for another mission if you're ready.
npc.henricus.say_27: [EN] You need bring me the witches' grimoire.
npc.henricus.say_29: [EN] Here is your demon hunter outfit. You deserve it. Unlock more addons by completing more missions.
npc.henricus.say_3: [EN] You cannot get this blessing unless you have completed The Inquisition Quest.
npc.henricus.say_30: [EN] Here is your demon hunter outfit. You deserve it. Unlock more addons by completing more missions.!
npc.henricus.say_31: [EN] Here is the final addon for your demon hunter outfit. Congratulations!
npc.henricus.say_32: [EN] The priests of Fardos are often mystics who have secluded themselves from worldly matters. Others provide guidance and healing to people in need in the temples.
npc.henricus.say_33: [FR] Do you want to receive the blessing of the inquisition - which means {} blessings - for {} gold?
npc.henricus.say_34: [FR] Do you want to buy the special flask of holy water for {} gold?
npc.henricus.say_5: [EN] You do not need this flask right now.
npc.henricus.say_6: [EN] Do you want to join the inquisition?
npc.henricus.say_7: [EN] Your current mission is to investigate the reliability of certain guards. Are you done with that mission?
npc.henricus.say_8: [EN] Your current mission is to destroy this coven. Are you done with that mission?
npc.henricus.say_9: [EN] Your current mission is to help the vampire hunter Storkus. Are you done with that mission?
npc.henricus.stdmod_1: [EN] It's a shame that only a few paladins still use their abilities to further the cause of the gods of good. Too many paladins have become selfish and greedy.
npc.henricus.stdmod_10: [EN] Drefia used to be a city of sin and heresy, just like Carlin nowadays. One day, the gods decided to destroy this town and to erase all evil there.
npc.henricus.stdmod_11: [EN] Darashia is a godless town full of mislead fools. One day, it will surely share the fate of its sister town Drefia.
npc.henricus.stdmod_12: [EN] Demons exist in many different shapes and levels of power. In general, they are servants of the dark gods and command great powers of destruction.
npc.henricus.stdmod_13: [EN] Carlin is a city of sin and heresy. After the reunion of Carlin with the kingdom, the inquisition will have much work to purify the city and its inhabitants.
npc.henricus.stdmod_14: [EN] We can see his evil influence almost everywhere. Keep your eyes open or the dark one will lead you on the wrong way and destroy you.
npc.henricus.stdmod_15: [EN] The church of Crunor works closely together with the druid guild. This makes a cooperation sometimes difficult.
npc.henricus.stdmod_16: [EN] We owe to the gods of good our creation and continuing existence. If it weren't for them, we would surely fall prey to the minions of the vile and dark gods.
npc.henricus.stdmod_17: [EN] The churches of the gods united to fight heresy and dark magic. They are the shield of the true believers, while the inquisition is the sword that fights all enemies of virtuousness.
npc.henricus.stdmod_18: [EN] The churches of the gods entrusted me with the enormous and responsible task to lead the inquisition. I leave the field work to inquisitors who I recruit from fitting people that cross my way.
npc.henricus.stdmod_19: [EN] Belive on the gods and they will show you the path.
npc.henricus.stdmod_2: [EN] Nowadays, most knights seem to have forgotten the noble cause to which all knights were bound in the past. Only a few have remained pious, serve the gods and follow their teachings.
npc.henricus.stdmod_20: [EN] By edict of the churches I'm the Lord Inquisitor.
npc.henricus.stdmod_3: [EN] Those who wield great power have to resist great temptations. We have the burden to eliminate all those who give in to the temptations.
npc.henricus.stdmod_4: [EN] The druids here still follow the old rules. Sadly, the druids of Carlin have left the right path in the last years.
npc.henricus.stdmod_5: [EN] The dwarfs are allied with Thais but follow their own obscure religion. Although dwarfs keep mostly to themselves, we have to observe this alliance closely.
npc.henricus.stdmod_6: [EN] The dwarfs are allied with Thais but follow their own obscure religion. Although dwarfs keep mostly to themselves, we have to observe this alliance closely.
npc.henricus.stdmod_7: [EN] Those elves are hardly any more civilised than orcs. They can become a threat to mankind at any time.
npc.henricus.stdmod_8: [EN] Those elves are hardly any more civilised than orcs. They can become a threat to mankind at any time.
npc.henricus.stdmod_9: [EN] Venore is somewhat difficult to handle. The merchants have a close eye on our activities in their city and our authority is limited there. However, we will use all of our influence to prevent a second Carlin.
npc.henricus.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] This ungraceful haste is most suspicious!
npc.herbert.say_1: [EN] You would like Chantalle's letter? only if you are willing to pay a price. {gold} maybe?
npc.herbert.say_2: [EN] Are you willing to pay 1000 gold for this letter?
npc.hireling.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, I'll be here if you need me again.
npc.hireling.food_29408: [EN] Oh yes, a tasty roasted wings to make you even tougher and skilled with the defensive arts.
npc.hireling.food_29409: [EN] Divine! Carrot is a well known nourishment that makes the eyes see even more sharply.
npc.hireling.food_29410: [EN] Magnifique! A tiger meat that has been marinated for several hours in magic spices.
npc.hireling.food_29411: [EN] Aaah, the beauty of the simple dishes! A delicate salad made of selected ingredients, capable of bring joy to the hearts of bravest warriors and their weapons.
npc.hireling.food_29412: [EN] Oh yes, very spicy chilly combined with delicious minced carniphila meat and a side dish of fine salad!
npc.hireling.food_29413: [EN] Aaah, the northern cuisine! A catch of fresh salmon right from the coast Svargrond is the base of this extraordinary fish dish.
npc.hireling.food_29414: [EN] A traditional and classy meal. A beefy casserole which smells far better than it sounds!
npc.hireling.food_29415: [EN] A tasty chunk of juicy beef with an aromatic sauce and parsley potatoes, mmh!
npc.hireling.food_29416: [EN] Oooh, well... that one didn't quite turn out as it was supposed to be, I'm sorry.
npc.hireling.goods_no_trader: [EN] While I'm not a trader, I still have a collection of {various} items to sell if you like!
npc.hireling.goods_trader: [EN] I sell a selection of {various} items, {exercise weapons}, {equipment}, {distance} weapons, {wands} and {rods}, {potions}, {runes}, {supplies}, {tools} and {postal} goods. Just ask!
npc.hireling.greet_bank: [EN] Alright! What can I do for you and your bank business, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.hireling.greet_food: [EN] Hmm, yes! A variety of fine food awaits! However, a small expense of 15000 gold is expected to make these delicious masterpieces happen. For 90000 gold I will also serve you a specific dish. Just tell me what it shall be: a {specific} meal or a little {surprise}.
npc.hireling.greet_msg_1: [EN] It is good to see you. I'm always at your {service}.
npc.hireling.greet_stash: [EN] Of course, here is your stash! Well-maintained and neatly sorted for your convenience!
npc.hireling.say_1: [EN] Here are the items for the category {}.
