npc.nah_bob.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Bye now, Neutrala |PLAYERNAME|. Visit old Bob again one day!
npc.nah_bob.multi_2: [EN] |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
npc.nah_bob.say_1: [EN] Whoa! A human! This is no place for you, |PLAYERNAME|. Go and play somewhere else.
npc.nah_bob.say_2: [EN] <Sighs> Another {customer}! I've only just sat down! What is it, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.nah_bob.say_3: [EN] You brought cookies! How nice of you! Can I have one?
npc.nah_bob.say_4: [EN] You have no cookie that I'd like.
npc.nah_bob.say_5: [EN] You see, good deeds like this will ... YOU ... YOU SPAWN OF EVIL! I WILL MAKE SURE THE MASTER LEARNS ABOUT THIS!
npc.nah_bob.say_7: [EN] I'm sorry, human. But you need Gabel's permission to trade with me.
npc.nah_bob.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] At your service, just browse through my wares.
npc.naji.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to the Tibian bank, |PLAYERNAME| What can I do for you?
npc.naji.voice_1: [EN] It's a wise idea to store your money in your bank account.
npc.narsai.say_1: [EN] Could you help me do a ritual?
npc.narsai.say_2: [EN] Here is the list of ingredients that are missing to complete the ritual.
npc.narsai.say_4: [EN] Did you bring all the materials I informed you about?
npc.narsai.say_5: [EN] Thank you this stage of the ritual is complete.
npc.navigator.multi_1: [EN] I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
npc.navigator.multi_10: [EN] And then I laid my eyes on a creature I have never seen before. I now know that they call themselves Njey. You would call them the 'Creatures of the Deep' or 'Deeplings'. ...
npc.navigator.multi_11: [EN] I am now convinced that when they first saw me descending in that suit with the light of the shimmer glower encompassing me, they took me for their God King Qjell. And that's when it all started to make sense. Don't you agree?
npc.navigator.multi_12: [EN] I was once captain of a ship, the Skyflare. We were traders for King Tibianus and on our way home when we got into a storm. We fought hard to escape the cold grip of the sea. ...
npc.navigator.multi_13: [EN] I myself did what I could to navigate the Skyflare out of this mess. They depended on me. Me, the navigator. And I succeeded. ...
npc.navigator.multi_14: [EN] However, when the sea calmed down and the rain was finally gone, we recognised that our ship wouldn't move. It wasn't my fault. ...
npc.navigator.multi_15: [EN] There was a strong gale and we could already see this island on the horizon. There were seagulls all around the Skyflare to lead us to dry land. But the ship did not move a single inch. It was NOT my fault. ...
npc.navigator.multi_16: [EN] We dived under the bow and saw that it was stuck right on the tip of a sharp rock. The world below us was treacherous, we could see large underwater mountains and a labyrinthine system of caves and holes. ...
npc.navigator.multi_17: [EN] Some of my men panicked and hijacked the dinghies to reach the island, others tried to swim. I remained on the ship. It was not my FAULT. It was not. ...
npc.navigator.multi_18: [EN] When none of my men returned, I forced myself to make a decision. Either dying on this dead ship or plunging into the liquid black beneath. ...
npc.navigator.multi_19: [EN] In my desperation my thoughts fell onto a strange armor - a gift from a trader we dealt with just before the storm. Strange ornaments and fish-like elements decorated this armor. We thought it would fit just perfectly into the captain's cabin. ...
npc.navigator.multi_2: [EN] The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
npc.navigator.multi_20: [EN] He said something like a 'blessed breath' and 'to subdue the drift'. We thought he wanted to sell us worthless decoration and make it look interesting. If I had only listened to what he said. ...
npc.navigator.multi_21: [EN] I figured that this thing would have something to do with diving or at least protect me from the icy water. I put it on, grabbed a shimmer glower from our storage to light my path and jumped in. ...
npc.navigator.multi_22: [EN] Do you want me to go on?
npc.navigator.multi_23: [EN] NAAAAARGH. If you promise to leave me alone and NOT TO TELL MY SECRET to anyone - you can have one. ...
npc.navigator.multi_24: [EN] NO! Not the one I'm wearing. I am BOUND to this device. This suit has granted me a longer life. However, once you have spent a certain time with this - there is no turning back if you know what I mean. ...
npc.navigator.multi_25: [EN] The armor will merge with your very body. Holding you captive, holding your life in its hands like a ransom. ...
npc.navigator.multi_26: [EN] Using Deepling craft and various components from down here, I created several spare helmets - just in case this one gets damaged. If you return that small golden anchor to me, you can have one. Will you?
npc.navigator.multi_3: [EN] You thought you could choose sides? Think again! I nearly led you into the destruction of two species! ME, THE NAVIGATOR! I CONTROL YOU, I OWN YOU! QJELL AFAR GOU JEY!
npc.navigator.multi_4: [EN] Of course you do. And they did, too. They obeyed me. They adored me. They followed me. ...
npc.navigator.multi_5: [EN] I learnt everything about their culture, their life, their goals and their problems. I found out about vile insect-like creatures inhabiting the surface of the island. And their waiting for the return of Qjell. ...
npc.navigator.multi_6: [EN] I practically rewrote their history. I WAS THE SECOND COMING. I WAS QJELL. I, THE NAVIGATOR. ...
npc.navigator.multi_7: [EN] And I navigated them out of their miserable lives. Away from their petty interests. I led them to a greater purpose - to form chaos out of order, to bring back the storm to the seas and to make THINGS MOVE. Do you want to hear the rest as well?
npc.navigator.multi_8: [EN] Hmpf. The armor was working. After some time I was surrounded by darkness and could only see as far as my shimmer glower would me allow to. But I didn't feel the cold - I could even breathe through that helmet. ...
npc.navigator.multi_9: [EN] I dived into the deep black. Across rugged mountains, vast fields of kelp, swarms of strange fish. ...
npc.navigator.say_1: [EN] Lhnjei gouthn naumpi! I know why you are here. I can {explain} everything.
npc.navigator.say_2: [EN] By entering this place, you have earned the right to learn what this is all about. This is a long story. Are you sure you want to hear this, {yes}?
npc.navigator.say_3: [EN] Do you have enough, can I stop?
npc.navigator.say_4: [EN] Then take this one. And remember: DO NOT TELL ANYONE ABOUT ME OR ANYTHING YOU HAVE HEARD HERE TODAY.
npc.nelly.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello |PLAYERNAME|, What can I do for you? I'm working for the post office, but I also trade with important {potions}, {runes} and other magical equipment.
npc.nelly.say_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.nelly.voice_2: [EN] Also selling runes, potions and magical equipment!
npc.nielson.greet_msg_1: [EN] Ahoi, young man |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to the Nordic Tibia Ferries. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
npc.nielson.stdmod_2: [EN] Do you want a round-trip passage to {0} for {1}?
npc.nielson.stdmod_5: [EN] Where do you want to go today? We serve the routes to {Folda}, {Senja} and {Vega} and back to Tibia.
npc.nielson.voice_1: [EN] Passages to Senja, Folda and Vega.
npc.nilsor.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Is there anything I can {do for you}?
npc.nilsor.multi_1: [EN] A thousand thanks in advance. I need no less than 7 ingredients for the cure. You can ask me about each specifically ...
npc.nilsor.multi_10: [EN] Are you willing to help me?
npc.nilsor.multi_2: [EN] I need a part of the sun adorer cactus, a vial of geyser water, sulphur of a lava hole, a frostbite herb, a blossom of a purple kiss, a hydra tongue and spores of a giant glimmercap mushroom ...
npc.nilsor.multi_3: [EN] Turn them in individually by talking about them to me. As soon as I obtained them all, talk to me about the medicine. First time bring a Part of the Sun Adorer {Cactus}.
npc.nilsor.multi_4: [EN] You will need a specially prepared waterskin to collect the water. You can buy one from me ...
npc.nilsor.multi_5: [EN] Use it on a geyser that is NOT active. The water of active geysers is far too hot. You can find inactive geysers on Okolnir. Do you have some geyser water with you?
npc.nilsor.multi_6: [EN] Thank you. Now I have all necessary ingredients. As a reward I grant you the use of our dog sled, which is located to the east of here. ...
npc.nilsor.multi_7: [EN] The dogs can be a bit moody, but if you always carry some ham with you there shouldnt be any problems. Oh, and Hjaern might have a mission for you. So maybe you go and talk to him.
npc.nilsor.multi_8: [EN] I am in dire need of help. A plague has befallen my dogs. I even called a druid of Carlin for help but all he could do was to recommend some strong medicine ...
npc.nilsor.multi_9: [EN] The thing is the ingredients of the medicine are extremely rare and some only exist in far away and distant lands. If you could help me collecting the ingredients, I would be eternally grateful ...
npc.nilsor.say_1: [EN] Do you want to travel to Svargrond?
npc.nilsor.say_10: [EN] The giant glimmercap mushroom exists in caves and other preferably warm and humid places. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on a mushroom to collectits spores. Do you have the glimmercap spores?
npc.nilsor.say_13: [EN] Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me Geyser {Water} in a Waterskin.
npc.nilsor.say_14: [EN] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_15: [EN] Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me Fine {Sulphur}.
npc.nilsor.say_16: [EN] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_17: [EN] Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me the Frostbite {Herb}
npc.nilsor.say_18: [EN] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_19: [EN] Thank you for this ingredient Now bring me Purple Kiss {Blossom}.
npc.nilsor.say_2: [EN] What for ingredient do you have?
npc.nilsor.say_20: [EN] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_21: [EN] Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me the {Hydra Tongue}
npc.nilsor.say_22: [EN] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_23: [EN] Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me {Spores} of a Giant Glimmercap Mushroom.
npc.nilsor.say_24: [EN] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_25: [EN] Thank you for this ingredient. Now you finish your {mission}
npc.nilsor.say_26: [EN] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_27: [EN] Then come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_3: [EN] I have now no mission for you.
npc.nilsor.say_4: [EN] Do you want to buy a waterskin for 25 gold?
npc.nilsor.say_5: [EN] You will find this kind of cactus at places that are called deserts. Only an ordinary kitchen knife will be precise enough to produce the ingredient weneed. Do you have a part of that cactus with you?
npc.nilsor.say_6: [EN] I need fine sulphur of an inactive lava hole. No other sulphur will do. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on an inactive lava hole. Do you have fine sulphur with you?
npc.nilsor.say_7: [EN] The frostbite herb is a local plant but its quite rare. You can find it on mountain peaks. You will need to cut it with a fine kitchen knife. Do you have a frostbite herb with you?
npc.nilsor.say_8: [EN] The purple kiss is a plant that grows in a place called jungle. You will have to use a kitchen knife to harvest its blossom. Do you have a blossom of a purple kiss with you?
npc.nilsor.say_9: [EN] The hydra tongue is a common pest plant in warmer regions. You might find one in a shop. Do you have a hydra tongue with you?
npc.nina.greet_msg_1: [EN] Beware, if you go any further you will have to fight a large group of Chosen. This place is called the Fire Dragon Dojo. Tread carefully since these are lizard training grounds.
npc.nina.stdmod_1: [EN] The lizards here are the chosen ones of their kind. We believe them to be the strongest warriors in these lands.So I lead my people here to learn their ways. We are mere assassins but they are using foreign techniques and seem to be far more efficient
npc.nina.stdmod_2: [EN] We of the Grey Shadow clan are studying the ways of the Chosen. Our training is hard, encounters with the lizards often deadly. Every one of us fights on his own. Each one more deadly than the other. Under my lead we wil rise renewed, as the Shadow Nina.
npc.nina.stdmod_3: [EN] I am Nina, leader of the Grey Shadow clan. Me and my followers, the Shadow Nina, are exploring the largely uncharted parts of the continent Zao.
npc.ninev.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free or you want the {adventurer stone}?
npc.ninev.keyword_1: [EN] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.ninev.stdmod_1: [EN] Alright, I guess you need a stake first. Maybe Gamon can help you, the leg of a chair or something could just do. Try asking him for a stake, and if you have one, bring it back to me.
npc.ninev.stdmod_11: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.ninev.stdmod_14: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.ninev.stdmod_16: [EN] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.ninev.stdmod_18: [EN] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.ninev.stdmod_19: [EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.ninev.stdmod_2: [EN] I guess you couldn't convince Gamon to give you a stake, eh?
npc.ninev.stdmod_20: [EN] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.ninev.stdmod_21: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.ninev.stdmod_22: [EN] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.ninev.stdmod_23: [EN] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.ninev.stdmod_24: [EN] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.ninev.stdmod_25: [EN] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.ninev.stdmod_26: [EN] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.ninev.stdmod_27: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.ninev.stdmod_28: [EN] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.ninev.stdmod_29: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.ninev.stdmod_3: [EN] Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.ninev.stdmod_30: [EN] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.ninev.stdmod_32:
[EN] A blessed stake to defeat evil spirits? I do know an old prayer which is said to grant sacred power and to be able to bind this power to someone, or something. ... \z
	However, this prayer needs the combined energy of ten priests. Each of them has to say one line of the prayer. ... \z
	I could start with the prayer, but since the next priest has to be in a different location, you probably will have to travel a lot. ... \z
	Is this stake really important enough to you so that you are willing to take this burden?
npc.ninev.stdmod_33:
[EN] This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.ninev.stdmod_4: [EN] So receive my prayer: 'Light shall be near - and darkness afar'. Now, bring your stake to Tibra in the Carlin church for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
npc.ninev.stdmod_6: [EN] You should visit Tibra in the Carlin church now.
npc.ninev.stdmod_7: [EN] You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.ninev.stdmod_8: [EN] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.ninev.stdmod_9: [EN] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.ninev.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.ninos.farewell_msg_1: [EN] It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.ninos.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
npc.ninos.say_1: [EN] Oh they don't change that much since in the old days as... <tells a boring and confusing story about a cake, a parcel, himself and two squirrels, at least he tells you his measurements in the end>
npc.ninos.voice_2: [EN] If you need help with letters or parcels, just ask me. I can explain everything.
npc.ninos.voice_3: [EN] Hey, send a letter to your friend now and then. Keep in touch, you know.
npc.nipuna.say_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.nipuna.voice_1: [EN] I'm selling magic equipment. Come and have a look.
npc.nipuna.voice_2: [EN] If you need runes, this is the market stall for you!
npc.nokmir.multi_1: [EN] On the next day, the guards brought me to emperor {Rehal}, and Rerun was there, too. He said I had stolen his ring. I'd never steal, you have to believe me.
npc.nokmir.multi_2: [EN] On the next day, the guards brought me to emperor {Rehal}, and Rerun was there, too. He said I had stolen his ring. I'd never steal, you have to believe me.
npc.nokmir.say_1: [EN] I don't see how you could help me. I'm in deep, deep trouble. I'm accused of having stolen a {ring} from Rerun, but I haven't.
npc.nokmir.say_2: [EN] WHAT?! I can't believe it. You saved my life... well, at least one week of it 'cause that would have been the time I had to spend in jail. If you want to, you can pass the door now and take a look at the northern mines. Have fun!
npc.nokmir.say_3: [EN] Maybe Grombur knows more than me. The thing is he won't talk to me, and he will surely not accuse his best friend as a liar. What a dilemma!
npc.nokmir.say_4: [EN] He's a miner in the southern wing. Maybe he has lost the ring there... but even if I find the ring, no one will believe me. Someone should talk to Grombur. He's Rerun's best friend.
npc.nokmir.say_5: [EN] He's a good emperor but I doubt he is wise enough to see the truth behind that false accusation against me. If just someone would find out the truth about that whole mess.
npc.nomad.greet_msg_1: [EN] Ah, another diciple of the extreme... surviving the icy outdoors? Let me {help}! If you need some first aid out here, I can provide {healing} or grant you an {enhanced} blessing!
npc.nomad.keyword_1: [EN] Receive the heart of the mountain then.
npc.nomad.stdmod_1: [EN] I am able to grant you the heart of the mountain's blessing. But I must ask of you to sacrifice |BLESSCOST| gold. Are you willing to part with that amount of wealth?
npc.nomad.stdmod_10: [EN] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.nomad.stdmod_11: [EN] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.nomad.stdmod_12: [EN] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.nomad.stdmod_13: [EN] I know of a mysterious djinn, bound to an existence of slavery far to the north of Tiquanda's jungles. He is bound to tell you his secrets and offer you the 'blood of the mountain'. ...\nI do not know where exactly but I guess you must first dig that one out to actually talk to him.
npc.nomad.stdmod_2: [EN] Receive the heart of the mountain then.
npc.nomad.stdmod_3: [EN] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.nomad.stdmod_4: [EN] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.nomad.stdmod_5: [EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.nomad.stdmod_6: [EN] Besides the {enhanced} blessing available from me, I know of one other, granted by a solitary {nomad} far west of Svargrond. There are also five different other blessings available, each in a sacred place. ...\nThese blessings are: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}.
npc.nomad.stdmod_7: [EN] Well, as I am quite in a {fix} currently, my only hope to escape this situation may be to grant you {healing} or an {enhanced} blessing if you wish. You must desire SOMETHING, right? Sure you do.
npc.nomad.stdmod_8: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.nomad.stdmod_9: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.noozer.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hm? Oh! Oh, yes a... visitor! Intruder? Benefactor...? Wha- what are you? If you want to pass through this cave, I may have to disappoint you. Or maybe not. It... depends. So, just passing through?
npc.noozer.multi_1: [EN] ...wait a second, I lost it. What was I going to say again? Ah yes - DANGEROUS! These. Caves. Are. Dangerous. No way you get out alive. Ever. Again. ...
npc.noozer.multi_2: [EN] Also you should not disturb those... people down there. Yeah. They... hm, wait, they - who are they again? Hey! Who are you? Are you talking to me?! Ah, ah... oh yes, I remember. ...
npc.noozer.multi_3: [EN] Wait - I am the guardian here, yes! The keeper of... something... or another, yes, I... guard this place. With my life. Don't I? Of course! ...
npc.noozer.multi_4: [EN] Is, er... this the moment where I should try to... stop you? Yes? No? Ah, you know what - you go down there, those guys are angry as dung anyway. Try your luck, return to me when you're done. If you still can. Or not.
npc.noozer.multi_5: [EN] Is, er... this the moment where I should try to... stop you? Yes? No? Ah, you know what - you go down there, those guys are angry as dung anyway. Try your luck, return to me when you're done. If you still can. Or not.
npc.noozer.say_1: [EN] I was stationed in this cave to... guard something. Right now I am not even sure what that was.
npc.noozer.say_2: [EN] Then don't waste my time. I'm doing some important... business... here. Actually... where am I? If I find out, I will be even more angry than I am now. Out of my sight.
npc.noozer.say_3: [EN] I was on a mission, too - I guess. It was all quite blurry back then. Maybe I'll leave this place after I recovered completely. I have to find out what happened to me.
npc.nor.say_1: [EN] Here, take the memory crystal and leave immediately.
npc.norf.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, pilgrim. How may I {help} you? Are you in need of {healing}?
npc.norf.keyword_1: [EN] So receive the shielding of your spirit, pilgrim.
npc.norf.stdmod_1: [EN] Here in the whiteflower temple you may receive the blessing of spiritual shielding. But we must ask of you to sacrifice |BLESSCOST| gold. Are you still interested?
npc.norf.stdmod_10: [EN] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.norf.stdmod_11: [EN] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.norf.stdmod_12: [EN] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.norf.stdmod_13: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.norf.stdmod_14: [EN] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.norf.stdmod_2: [EN] So receive the shielding of your spirit, pilgrim.
npc.norf.stdmod_3: [EN] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.norf.stdmod_4: [EN] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.norf.stdmod_5: [EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.norf.stdmod_6: [EN] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.norf.stdmod_7: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.norf.stdmod_8: [EN] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.norf.stdmod_9: [EN] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.norma.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, welcome! Have a seat! If you like a drink or something to eat, just ask me for a {trade}!
npc.norma.say_1: [EN] Oh, you're back already? Did you bring a legion helmet, 100 chicken feathers and 50 honeycombs?
npc.norma.say_2: [EN] Pretty, isn't it? I made it myself, but I could teach you how to do that if you like. What do you say?
npc.norma.say_3: [EN] Okay, here we go, listen closely! I need a few things... a basic hat of course, maybe a legion helmet would do. Then about 100 chicken feathers... and 50 honeycombs as glue.That's it, come back to me once you gathered it!!
npc.norma.say_4: [EN] Aw, I guess you don't like feather hats. No big deal.
npc.norma.say_5: [EN] Sorry, but I can't see a legion helmet.
npc.norma.say_6: [EN] Sorry, but you don't enough chicken feathers.
npc.norma.say_7: [EN] Sorry, but you don't have enough honeycombs.
npc.norma.say_8: [EN] Great job! That must have taken a lot of work. Okay, you put it like this... then glue like this... here!
npc.norma.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Take all the time you need to decide what you want!
npc.norma.stdmod_1: [EN] Great drinks and snacks at fair prices!
npc.norma.stdmod_10: [EN] I've never been better! I love my new {job}!
npc.norma.stdmod_11: [EN] No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Obi} or {Lee'Delle} if you need a weapon.
npc.norma.stdmod_12: [EN] As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.norma.stdmod_13: [EN] Ah, the monsters are far away. Let's party now!
npc.norma.stdmod_14: [EN] If you really want to talk about dungeons, visit Dallheim on the bridge near my bar.
npc.norma.stdmod_15: [EN] Ewww, I don't even want to think about the smell from the sewers right now!
npc.norma.stdmod_16: [EN] Oooh, I wouldn't dare gossiping about the king. He might have his spies here somewhere, you know.
npc.norma.stdmod_17: [EN] This is the world we live in, oh-oh-oh, and these are the hands we're given, oh-oh... oh, I'm sorry, I got carried away!
npc.norma.stdmod_18: [EN] As a premium adventurer you have many advantages, you should check them out!
npc.norma.stdmod_19: [EN] I serve the best drinks in town! What's it gonna be, lemonade? Wine? Milk? Beer? Just ask me for a {trade}!
npc.norma.stdmod_2: [EN] You know you want a party after all that tiring hunting!
npc.norma.stdmod_20: [EN] The temple is a good place to visit if you're in urgent need for healing.
npc.norma.stdmod_21: [EN] Well, the only help I could give you are some general {hints}. And a delicious {drink} along with it.
npc.norma.stdmod_22: [EN] No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.
npc.norma.stdmod_23: [EN] No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.
npc.norma.stdmod_24: [EN] Oh, would you like something to eat or drink? Ask me for a {trade} to see my offers!
npc.norma.stdmod_25: <gets a dreamy look in her eyes>
npc.norma.stdmod_26: [EN] Al Dee treats his customers friendly, but he's badmouthing them once he had a few beers.
npc.norma.stdmod_27: [EN] I'm curious about her adventures. She really should come here more often!
npc.norma.stdmod_28: [EN] He got lucky when Willie and him played a game of dice about who gets to farm on which side of the river. Ever since, Willie holds a grudge against him.
npc.norma.stdmod_29: [EN] Hehe, that guy doesn't pretend to be anyone that he isn't. He is what he is - rude, but honest.
npc.norma.stdmod_30: [EN] Oh shush! It's kinda disgusting when he walks in here with animal blood on his hands!
npc.norma.stdmod_31: [EN] What Seymour doesn't teach you is how much fun you can have here!
npc.norma.stdmod_32: [EN] I invited her to my bar, but she refused. Oh well, it was worth a try!
npc.norma.stdmod_33: [EN] I think that poor guy never gets a break from work. At least he never comes here.
npc.norma.stdmod_34: [EN] That guy seriously needs some partying and a girlfriend.
npc.norma.stdmod_35: [EN] The oracle is on the top floor of the academy. You should go there once you are level 8 to leave this island.
npc.norma.stdmod_36: [EN] I think it's rather strange that he lives here with his granddaughter. No one's ever seen the parents of {Dixi}.
npc.norma.stdmod_37: [EN] I hate that name, it sounds so boring. Almost like 'normal'. I think I should change my name to something more exciting. Like... Marylin! Oh, what a glamorous sound!
npc.norma.stdmod_38: [EN] She told me that she dreams of leaving this island to go on a big adventure.
npc.norma.stdmod_4: [EN] Sing and dance at my bar! Yeah!
npc.norma.stdmod_5: [EN] Best place in town! Come to my bar!
npc.norma.stdmod_7: [EN] I used to be a merchant, but being a barkeeper is so much more fun. It's been my dream since I was a little girl.
npc.norma.stdmod_8: [EN] It's about |TIME|. Time just flies, doesn't it?
npc.norma.stdmod_9: [EN] To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.norma.voice_1: [EN] Great drinks and snacks at fair prices!
npc.norma.voice_2: [EN] You know you want a party after all that tiring hunting!
npc.norma.voice_4: [EN] Sing and dance at my bar! Yeah!
npc.norma.voice_5: [EN] Best place in town! Come to my bar!
npc.norma.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Hey, where are you going? We've just started!
npc.nurik.greet_msg_1: [EN] It's .. It's YOU! At last!! So what's this special proposal you would like to make, my friend?
npc.nurik.multi_1: [EN] Excellent! Here is the painting you requested. It's quite precious to my father, but imagine his joy when I tell him about my clever deal! ...
npc.nurik.multi_2: [EN] Now leave me alone please. I have to prepare for my departure. Now my family will not call me a squandering fool anymore!
npc.nurik.multi_3: [EN] That's just incredible! I've dreamed about acquiring the dwarven bridge since I was a child! Now my dream will finally become true. ...
npc.nurik.multi_4: [EN] And you are sure you want to sell it? I mean really, really sure?
npc.nurik.say_1: [EN] Excuse me, but I'm waiting for someone important!
npc.nurik.say_2: [EN] Wait a minute! Do I get that right? You're the owner of the dwarven bridge and you are willing to sell it to me??
npc.nurik.say_3: [EN] How splendid! Do you have the necessary documents with you?
npc.nurik.say_4: [EN] Oh my, oh my. I'm so excited! So let's seal this deal as fast as possible so I can visit my very own dwarven bridge. Are you ready for the transaction?
npc.nydala.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?
npc.nydala.stdmod_1: [EN] Well, as you can see, I sell furniture. Ask me for a {trade} if you're interested to see my wares.
npc.nydala.stdmod_2: [EN] My name is Nydala. I run this store.
npc.nydala.stdmod_3: [EN] It is |TIME|. Do you need a clock for your house?
npc.obi.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Farewell, I hope you were satisfied with our service.
npc.obi.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! If you like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}!
npc.obi.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares.
npc.obi.stdmod_1: [EN] Only quality steel and wood used for my weapons!
npc.obi.stdmod_10: [EN] It's about |TIME|. Yes, |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches for sale.
npc.obi.stdmod_11: [EN] My name is Obi, just Obi, the honest merchant. If you like to {trade}, just ask.
npc.obi.stdmod_12: [EN] I'm a merchant and the local {weapon} smith. If you like to see my quality wares or sell weapons to me, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.obi.stdmod_13: [EN] As an adventurer you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.obi.stdmod_14: [EN] If I were you, I'd invest my money in quality steel rather than putting it in a so-called safe bank account!
npc.obi.stdmod_15: [EN] Well, the mainland also consists of several continents. You can go there once you are level 8 and have talked to the {oracle}.
npc.obi.stdmod_16: [EN] Ah, Rookgaard. Home sweet home, that's what it became for me, but I will always miss {Thais} and {Sam}.
npc.obi.stdmod_17: [EN] Oh, Thais, I'll be back. One day, I'll be back.
npc.obi.stdmod_18: [EN] My good old cousin Sam. Oh, how I miss him.
npc.obi.stdmod_19: [EN] I think good practice is better than reading a boring book. Of course, you will need proper {equipment} to be able to get practice!
npc.obi.stdmod_20: [EN]  told them to let me sell food, but no! Sorry, you have to ask {Willie} or {Billy} on the farms west of here.
npc.obi.stdmod_21: [EN] Good monsters to start with are rats. They live in the {sewers} under the village of {Rookgaard}.
npc.obi.stdmod_22: [EN] There are many sewer entrances throughout Rookgaard. One is right outside this shop and to the left. For more details about monsters and dungeons, best talk to one of the {guards}.
npc.obi.stdmod_23: [EN] The bridge guard {Dallheim} is north of here, just follow the street, you can't miss it.
npc.obi.stdmod_24: [EN] Sadly, not many merchants are as honest as I am.
npc.obi.stdmod_25: [EN] I wish I could help you with that, but no, I was told to stick to weapons. Go see {Lily}.
npc.obi.stdmod_26: [EN] There are many blueberry bushes in and around this village. Nature's for free.
npc.obi.stdmod_27: [EN] I'm fine. It's a little hot near the crucible, but I enjoy the sound of forging {weapons}.
npc.obi.stdmod_28: [EN] Just ask me for a {trade} to see which things I buy from you.
npc.obi.stdmod_29: [EN] Oh, just upstairs. My granddaughter {Dixi} is in charge of selling armors and shields.
npc.obi.stdmod_3: [EN] Selling and buying all sorts of weapons, come and have a look!
npc.obi.stdmod_30: [EN] Yes, I'm selling weapons. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers and the things I buy from you.
npc.obi.stdmod_31: [EN] Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
npc.obi.stdmod_32: [EN] I wish I could help you with that, but no, I was told to stick to weapons. Go see {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.obi.stdmod_33: [EN] I sell {weapons} of all kinds. Just ask me for a {trade} if you like to see my offers.
npc.obi.stdmod_34: [EN] I don't know how anyone could give up the flourishing business she led. She should have listened to me and find someone who continues that business for her.
npc.obi.stdmod_35: [EN] I told him there was no danger, but he wouldn't listen to me, no one listens to me.
npc.obi.stdmod_36: [EN] I suggested him opening a tourist guide company with me, Obi's and Santiago's, but he didn't approve. I really don't understand why.
npc.obi.stdmod_37: [EN] An old woman shouldn't be treated like that, no way, that's bad.
npc.obi.stdmod_38: [EN] Oh, this guy is so greedy, so greedy. Ripping off poor adventurers like you!
npc.obi.stdmod_39: [EN] She is beautiful, very, very beautiful. I hope I can impress her somehow.
npc.obi.stdmod_4: [EN] Give those monsters a good whipping with my weapons!
npc.obi.stdmod_41: [EN] This guy doesn't understand that he should entrust me with the food business, too. He really should do. Then he had time for his farm.
npc.obi.stdmod_42: [EN] He shouldn't heal people for free, no he shouldn't. That would be a great source of income for the village that could be invested in enhancing the smithy.
npc.obi.stdmod_43: [EN] Oh, what an endearing little girl, and she's working so hard to help me, even without receiving payment. Such a sweet little girl!
npc.obi.stdmod_44: [EN] I don't like him, actually I dislike him deeply. He is so greedy that he doesn't want to share his profit he gains from health potions.
npc.obi.stdmod_45: [EN] She ruins the market with her offers! This is bad for us honest merchants, really bad.
npc.obi.stdmod_46: [EN] I knew it! I knew she would try to get the monopoly on potions in this village! But no one has listened to me!
npc.obi.stdmod_47: [EN] The oracle, ah, such a weird being! It will lead you off this island once you are level 8, yes it will, mark my words.
npc.obi.stdmod_5: [EN] Well, how can I help you? Do you need some general {hints}? Or, if you're interested in a {trade}, just ask.
npc.obi.stdmod_6: [EN] What kind of information do you need? I could tell you about different topics such as {equipment}, {monsters} or {Rookgaard} in general.
npc.obi.stdmod_8: [EN] Be careful down there! Make sure you bought enough {torches} and a {rope} or you might get lost.
npc.obi.stdmod_9: [EN] The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was!
npc.obi.voice_1: [EN] Only quality steel and wood used for my weapons!
npc.obi.voice_3: [EN] Selling and buying all sorts of weapons, come and have a look!
npc.obi.voice_4: [EN] Give those monsters a good whipping with my weapons!
npc.oblivion.greet_msg_1: [EN] A shadow preceded you. You wish?
npc.oblivion.multi_1: [EN] Ah, the Lady of Darkstone. You have done well to remember her name. ...
npc.oblivion.multi_2: [EN] Now, the shadows say the thing you seek lies next to Akab, the Quarrelsome. ...
npc.oblivion.multi_3: [EN] No coal is burned in his honour. Find his resting place and dig near it. Now go.
npc.oblivion.multi_4: [EN] Then into the vampire crypts, deep down, you must go. ...
npc.oblivion.multi_5: [EN] There... three graves where the shadows swirl, unseen. The first one: name the colour of the silent gong. Then ...
npc.oblivion.multi_6: [EN] The second: the name that is silent now in the halls of Darkstone ...
npc.oblivion.multi_7: [EN] The third: the lost beauty of Dunesea. It must be remembered, the shadows command it. Go now.
npc.oblivion.say_1: [EN] Lost. Hidden. The keys are shadow names. Find them, they will talk to me and reveal what is hidden. Will you go on that quest?
npc.oblivion.say_2: [EN] Yes. Have you gone there and found what you sought?
npc.oblivion.say_3: [EN] Tell me. Begin with the colour.
npc.oblivion.say_4: [EN] Yes. The shadows say this is true. The beauty of House Dunesea, name it.
npc.oblivion.say_5: [EN] The floating gardens. Too beautiful to lie asleep in the memory of men. Yes. The name that is no more in Darkstone?
npc.ocelus.multi_1: [EN] Oh yes, I noticed that lovely mermaid. From afar of course. I would not dare to step into the eyes of such a lovely creature. ...
npc.ocelus.multi_2: [EN] ... I guess I am quite shy. Oh my, if I were not blue, I would turn red now. If there would be someone to arrange a {date} with her.
npc.ocelus.say_2: [EN] Oh my. Its not easy to impress a mermaid I guess. Please get me a {love poem}. I think elves are the greatest poets so their city seems like a good place to look for one.
npc.ocelus.say_3: [EN] Will you ask the mermaid Marina if she would date me?
npc.ocelus.say_4: [EN] Thank you. How ironic, a human granting a djinn a wish.
npc.ocelus.say_5: [EN] Excellent. Here, with this little spell I enable you to recite the poem like a true elven poet. Now go and ask her for a date again.
npc.ocelus.say_6: [EN] Did you get a love poem from Ab'Dendriel?
npc.old_adall.stdmod_1: [EN] Do you seek a passage to the {0} end for {1}?
npc.old_adall.stdmod_3: [EN] I can bring you either to the east end of Port Hope or to the west end of the town, where would you like to go?
npc.oldrak.goshnar: [EN] The greatest necromant who ever cursed our land with the steps of his feet. He was defeated by the nightmare knights.
npc.oldrak.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome |PLAYERNAME|! Only rarely I can welcome {visitors} these days.
npc.oldrak.job: [EN] I guard this humble temple as a monument for the order of the {nightmare knights}.
npc.oldrak.monster: [EN] These plains are not safe for ordinary travellers. It will take heroes to survive here.
npc.oldrak.multi_1: [EN] You chopped down the demon oak?!? Unbelievable!! Let's hope it doesn't come back. As long as evil is still existent in the soil of the plains, it won't be over. Still, the demons suffered a setback, that's for sure. ...
npc.oldrak.multi_2: [EN] For your brave action, I tell you a secret which has been kept for many many years. There is an old house south of the location where you found the demon oak. There should be a grave with the name 'Yesim Adeit' somewhere close by. ...
npc.oldrak.multi_3: [EN] It belongs to a Daramian nobleman named 'Teme Saiyid'. I knew him well and he told me -almost augured- that someone will come who is worthy to obtain his treasure. I'm sure this 'someone' is you. Good luck in finding it!
npc.oldrak.name: [EN] My name is Oldrak.
npc.oldrak.say_1: [EN] How do you know? Did you go into the infested area?
npc.oldrak.say_10: [EN] What a pity! Let me know when you managed to get in there. Maybe I can help you when we know what we are dealing with.
npc.oldrak.say_12: [EN] Ah, the curse of the Plains of Havoc, the hidden beast, the unbeatable foe. I've been living here for years and I'm sure this is only a myth.
npc.oldrak.say_13: [EN] There are many tales about the fearsome Hugo. It's said it's an abnormality, accidentally created by Yenny the Gentle. It's half demon, half something else and people say it's still alive after all these years.
npc.oldrak.say_14: [EN] Yenny, known as the Gentle, was one of the most powerful wielders of magic in ancient times. She was known throughout the world for her mercy and kindness.
npc.oldrak.say_15: [EN] Would you like to buy a The Holy Tible for 1000 gold?
npc.oldrak.say_16: [EN] You need to complete the quest for the book first before you can buy The Holy Tible.
npc.oldrak.say_17: [EN] Here is your The Holy Tible.
npc.oldrak.say_18: [EN] You do not have enough money.
npc.oldrak.say_2: [EN] You better don't return here until you've defeated the Demon Oak.
npc.oldrak.say_3: [EN] A demon oak?!? <mumbles some blessings> May the gods be on our side. You'll need a {hallowed axe} to harm that tree. Bring me a simple {axe} and I'll prepare it for you.
npc.oldrak.say_4: [EN] I don't believe a word of it! How rude to lie to a monk!
npc.oldrak.say_5: [EN] Ahh, you've got an axe. Very good. I can make a hallowed axe out of it. It will cost you... er... a donation of 1,000 gold. Alright?
npc.oldrak.say_6: [EN] You have to first talk about {demon oak} or the {mission} before we continue.
npc.oldrak.say_7: [EN] Let's see....<mumbles a prayer>....here we go. The blessing on this axe will be absorbed by all the demonic energy around here. I presume it will not last very long, so better hurry. Actually, I can refresh the blessing as often as you like.
npc.oldrak.say_8: [EN] There is no axe with you.
npc.oldrak.say_9: [EN] There is not enough of money with you.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_1: [EN] This ancient order was created by a circle of wise humans who were called 'The {Dreamers}'. The order became {extinct} a long time ago.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_10: [EN] That's where we are. The world of Tibia.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_11: [EN] They created Tibia and all life on it ... and unlife, too.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_14: [EN] A weapon of myth and legend. It was lost in ancient times ... perhaps lost forever.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_15: [EN] Yenny, known as the Gentle, was one of most powerfull magicwielders in ancient times and known throughout the world for her mercy and kindness.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_16: [EN] I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_17: [EN] I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_18: [EN] I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_19: [EN] I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_2: [EN] Many perished in their battles against evil, some went mad, not able to stand their nightmares any longer. Others were seduced by the darkness.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_20: [EN] I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_3: [EN] They learned the ancient art of {dreamwalking} from some elves they befriended.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_4: [EN] While the dreamwalkers of the elves experienenced the brightest dreams of pleasure, the humans strangely had dreams of {dark omen}.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_5: [EN] They dreamed of doom, destruction, talked to dead, tormented souls, and gained unwanted insight into the {schemes of darkness}.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_6: [EN] They figured out how to interpret their dark dreams and so could foresee the plans of the dark gods and their minions.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_7: [EN] Using this knowledge they formed an order to thwart these plans, and because they battled their nightmares as brave as knights, they named their order accordingly.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_8: [EN] It is rumoured to open the entrance to the pits of inferno, also called the nightmare pits. Even if I knew about this secret I wouldn't tell you.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_9: [EN] Before the battles raged across them, they were called the fair plains.
npc.oldrak.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Take care, it's dangerous out there.
npc.oliver.say_1: [EN] Nobody knows the trouble I've seen .. <tells a quite detailed report>.
npc.oliver.say_2: [EN] You can {pass} either to the {Factory Quarter} or {Sunken Quarter}. Which one will it be?
npc.olrik.farewell_msg_1: [EN] It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.olrik.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
npc.olrik.say_1: [EN] Ok, here we go ... {}! You lose! Try again.
npc.olrik.say_3: [FR] Ok, here we go ... {}! You lose! Try again.
npc.olrik.say_4: [FR] Ok, here we go ... {}! You have won! How lucky you are! So listen ...<tells you what you need to know>
npc.olrik.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the {receiver} in the first line.
npc.omrabas.greet_msg_1: [EN] At last, a visitor! Welcome to my... humble abode. {Scroll} or {mission}?
npc.omrabas.multi_1: [EN] I knew it! I knew I had made a copy! Oh, I am so clever! ...
npc.omrabas.multi_10: [EN] Beneath one of the chests is a secret stash, under a loose stone tile. The scroll piece should be inside. Off you go.
npc.omrabas.multi_100: [EN] We are close now. Only one important thing remains: the incantation itself. We need the {scroll} for that.
npc.omrabas.multi_101: [EN] Ah, finally. Exceptional! Don't you feel the earth awakening to our call? No? Oh. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_102: [EN] Anyway, you succeeded in hallowing the Fireglass Altar! Only one altar remains to be hallowed! Shall we {proceed}?
npc.omrabas.multi_103: [EN] Ah, it is invigorating to fell the dark flows, rushing through Drefia, once again! Capital. This has earned you a reward. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_105: [EN] Yes, I said blood. Important ingredient in necromantic rituals, usually. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_106: [EN] You need to spill some vials of blood tincture for this task. Probably means killing blood priests to get those vials. Ready to do this?
npc.omrabas.multi_107: [EN] Ah, welcome, welcome! I felt that one! The Dark Lord is pleased with the gift you brought, so now we can proceed with everything as planned. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_108: [EN] If it had gone wrong though, he would have had your guts for gart... er... well, here you are, so - ready to get some {blood} flowing?
npc.omrabas.multi_109: [EN] Are you still here? Come on, let's not laze about, go to the Gardens of Night - where? ...
npc.omrabas.multi_11: [EN] Hah, developed a taste for it, have you? I believe the next scroll piece was hidden somewhere, my old friend being of a somewhat distrustful nature. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_110: [EN] East of the Necromancer Halls, you can't miss it, just look for a lot of dark and white sand, dried trees, and priestesses! ...
npc.omrabas.multi_111: [EN] Or got a {problem} with finding bones? Hah!
npc.omrabas.multi_112: [EN] I expected no less. Next is the Bonemarrow Altar, where the Dark Lord feasts upon the hallowed bones of...err. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_113: [EN] Ahem. Just take a yellowed bone or big bone, and hallow it - you don't know how? ...
npc.omrabas.multi_114: [EN] Huh. To HALLOW a yellowed bone, use it with one of the hallowed bonepiles in the Gardens Of Night. There are always bones around there - or were, in my days. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_115: [EN] Then, place the hallowed bone on the firebasin of the Bonemarrow Altar so the Dark Lord can consume it and grants us his power. Return to me after that.
npc.omrabas.multi_116: [EN] Good. As you may have gathered, the body parts you brought need to be assembled to form a whole body. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_117: [EN] This will happen through a necromantic ritual that we - or rather, you - now have to prepare. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_118: [EN] In a first step, it will involve retrieving specific artefacts of dark magic and hallowing the altars of the dark powers with them. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_119: [EN] After that, you will have to speak an ancient incantation to animate the body and fuse my soul within. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_12: [EN] The scent may not be lost, though - ask a shadow pupil if he can help - but be careful. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_120: [EN] But first things first. Are you ready to {undertake} the hallowing of the five altars?
npc.omrabas.multi_121: [EN] Now that you have shown you've got the brains, I need you to show initiative. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_122: [EN] I will need something that can be adequately used as intestines. Something alive. Stuff it into this storage flask and return it to me!
npc.omrabas.multi_123: [EN] I will need brains - don't laugh! Ahem. I will need a stimulated brain, to be precise. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_124: [EN] Use two half-eaten brains with the Brain Heater Machine in the Necromancer halls and bring me the fused, stimulated brain. Now go!
npc.omrabas.multi_125: [EN] Yes? You have it? You what? Not in the amphoras? You picked it off someone else?!? ...
npc.omrabas.multi_126: [EN] Well, the important thing is that you have it. Let's see if it's still in good shape. {Give} it to me.
npc.omrabas.multi_127: [EN] I need my heart back. I know where they have hidden it. Too afraid to destroy my beating heart, hah! ...
npc.omrabas.multi_128: [EN] It is in a dusty amphora in a sealed mass grave in the downmost cellar of my ancient home. The ruins lie to the north at the beach. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_129: [EN] Crash the amphoras to find my heart, and bring it to me.
npc.omrabas.multi_13: [EN] Those shadow pupils are - strange. Try to find one who will answer and not kill you!
npc.omrabas.multi_14: [EN] Oh, praise the Dark Lord! It is my scroll piece! Give it here! You can have this instead. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_15: [EN] Ahh, that feels GOOD. Now, only two pieces left to hunt down! On to the {next} scroll piece, yes?
npc.omrabas.multi_16: [EN] Well, it is a rather long story. The short version: I had friends - no need to snigger. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_17: [EN] We were five highly brilliant dark summoners. We joined our forces to find the scroll of Youth and Life Eternal. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_18: [EN] But when we finally found it after years of toiling and danger, we quarreled over who could have it. The scroll tore. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_19: [EN] We each retained one piece of the scroll. Well, that was a long time ago. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_2: [EN] Now, watch this. <mumbles darkly> THERE. THE COMPLETE INCANTATION SCROLL. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_20: [EN] But I think I have a clue where we can find the first piece of the scroll. Would you go looking?
npc.omrabas.multi_21: [EN] <reverential> The final altar that remains to be hallowed... the Shadowthrone. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_22: [EN] Only a candle made of human tallow placed before each shadow statue in the right order, will awaken it. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_23: [EN] I say, are you sick? Human tallow candles are a perfectly good tool - don't look at me like that! Be professional about this, will you? ...
npc.omrabas.multi_24: [EN] I have some candles hidden deep down in the lich caves, east of here. Here's the key that opens the trapdoor to the cache. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_25: [EN] And take this parchment. Identify the right candles with it, take three with you and place one in front of the three shadowthrone statues, starting counterclockwise. Now go!
npc.omrabas.multi_26: [EN] Yes, I said blood. Important ingredient in necromantic rituals, usually. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_27: [EN] You need to spill some vials of blood tincture for this task. Probably means killing blood priests to get those vials. Ready to do this?
npc.omrabas.multi_28: [EN] I expected no less. Next is the Bonemarrow Altar, where the Dark Lord feasts upon the hallowed bones of...err. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_29: [EN] Ahem. Just take a yellowed bone or big bone, and hallow it - you don't know how? ...
npc.omrabas.multi_3: [EN] You have done well. Only one thing remains, and you shall be rich beyond your dreams. Ready for the really final task?
npc.omrabas.multi_30: [EN] Huh. To HALLOW a yellowed bone, use it with one of the hallowed bonepiles in the Gardens Of Night. There are always bones around there - or were, in my days. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_31: [EN] Then, place the hallowed bone on the firebasin of the Bonemarrow Altar so the Dark Lord can consume it and grants us his power. Return to me after that.
npc.omrabas.multi_32: [EN] Good! Let's not waste time. The first altar you must hallow is the Dragonsoul Altar, at the eastern side of the room. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_33: [EN] To hallow it, dig out three dragon tears and place them on the altar to appease the dark powers. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_34: [EN] What? Oh, you'll find some dragon tears near dragon skulls... where? ...
npc.omrabas.multi_35: [EN] In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
npc.omrabas.multi_36: [EN] Then let's go. Take my skull and the incantation scroll to the working station in the fiveserrated room ...
npc.omrabas.multi_37: [EN] Where the lava flows and the southern legs of the room meet. Place the Skull on the sacrificial stone and use the scroll ...
npc.omrabas.multi_38: [EN] AND I shall be made whole, and YOU shall be RICH!
npc.omrabas.multi_39: [EN] I am so excited! Finally, we - wait. What is this? That... is not the complete scroll piece. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_4: [EN] Hahah, eager for it, I like that! ...
npc.omrabas.multi_40: [EN] I don't care what you say! This is a disaster! We need a complete scr - wait. I have an idea. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_41: [EN] There must be a copy or something in my old library. something to use with the scroll, to find the missing words. ...
npc.omrabas.multi_42: [EN] There must be. Go look there. Next to the fiveserrated room, a small library. Go go go!

npc.omrabas.say_1: [EN] Hmm. You could be of assistance, I presume. I need several body parts. I will reward you adequately. Interested?
npc.omrabas.say_10: [EN] Hello - what? You have the {scroll} piece, you say?
npc.omrabas.say_11: [EN] Hello, young apprentice. Do you have that {scroll} piece from the priestess?
npc.omrabas.say_12: [EN] Don't keep me waiting. The last scroll piece - were you able to {restore} it?

npc.one_eyed_joe.greet_msg_1: [EN] Well done! But know this: The cursed crystal seems to regenerate over time. It could be necessary to come back and repeat whatever you have done down there.
npc.one_eyed_joe.greet_msg_2: [EN] Hello there. I'm sorry, I hardly noticed you. I'm a bit nervous. The spooky {sounds} down there, you know
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_1: [EN] But there are few volunteers. Often the crystal gatherers disappear and are never seen again. Other poor fellows then meet their former shipmates in the form of ghosts or skeletons. It's a {cursed} area, something evil is down there!
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_10: [EN] At first glance it seems to be a beautiful - and precious - surrounding. But in truth, deep down in these caverns exists an old evil. Want to hear more?
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_2: [EN] But there are few volunteers. Often the crystal gatherers disappear and are never seen again. Other poor fellows then meet their former shipmates in the form of ghosts or skeletons. It's a {cursed} area, something evil is down there!
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_3: [EN] As for myself I haven't been down there. But I heard some disturbing rumours. In these caves are wonderful crystal formations. Some more poetically inclined fellows call them the crystal gardens. ...
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_4: [EN] At first glance it seems to be a beautiful - and precious - surrounding. But in truth, deep down in these caverns exists an old evil. Want to hear more?
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_5: [EN] In my humble opinion a pirate should win a fortune by boarding ships not by crawling through caves and tunnels. But who am I to bring into question the captain's decision. All I know is that they sell the crystals at a high price. ...
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_6: [EN] A certain amount of the crystals is ground to crystal dust with a special kind of mill. Don't ask me why. Some kind of magical component perhaps that they sell to mages and sorcerers.
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_7: [EN] The evil I mentioned is a strange crystal, imbued with some kind of unholy energy. It is very hard to destroy, no weapon is able to shatter the thing. Maybe a jarring, very loud sound could destroy it. ...
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_8: [EN] I heard of creatures, that are able to utter ear-splitting sounds. Don't remember the name, though. Would you go down there and try to destroy the crystal?
npc.one_eyed_joe.multi_9: [EN] As for myself I haven't been down there. But I heard some disturbing rumours. In these caves are wonderful crystal formations. Some more poetically inclined fellows call them the crystal gardens. ...
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_1: [EN] Hmm. No, I don't think so. I still feel this strange prickling in my toes.
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_3: [EN] Protect your ears? Hmm ... Wasn't there some fabulous seafarer who used wax or something to plug his ears? There was a story about horrible bird-women or something ...? No, sounds like hogwash, doesn't it.
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_4: [EN] Great! Good luck and be careful down there!
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_5: [EN] I'm a pirate. Normally I'm sailing the seas, boarding other ships and gathering treasures. But at the moment my captain graciously assigned me to watch this {cursed} entrance.
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_6: [EN] I'm One-Eyed Joe. From Josephina, got that? And I regard this eye patch as a personal feature of beauty!
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_7: [EN] Good bye adventurer. It was nice to talk with you.
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_8: [EN] Ah, the brave adventurer who sought to destroy the evil crystal down there. Have you been successful?
npc.ongulf.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. You've come at a good time for our {project}.
npc.ongulf.multi_1: [EN] Oh, my! That sounds like a real mess. For now this dragon empire seems otherwise engaged, but we will be on guard thanks to you my friend. We will continue to fortify the base. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_10: [EN] If the orcs are right, they are somewhere in or behind those mountains in the north. I doubt you can reason with them in any way, but you'll have to try for the sake of Farmine.
npc.ongulf.multi_11: [EN] Our new friends, those primitive humans sent us a warning. According to them, the 'green men' of the plains plan an attack on the mountains. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_12: [EN] Considering their expected number, there is no chance for us to beat them off. We might be able to hold our ground for a while, but without access to the surface and under constant attacks, we might have to abandon the base. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_13: [EN] Now, I'm aware that you cannot stop an entire army by yourself, but desperate situations call for desperate measures. I ask you to find the leaders of the orcs and - well do something. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_14: [EN] Scare them, bribe them, give them another target or whatever. As futile as it may sound: Try to talk to their leaders in some way and make them stop their attack plans. This is our only hope.
npc.ongulf.multi_15: [EN] Things are getting more and more complicated. You need to convince our friends that some intervention for their part is needed. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_16: [EN] We've come a long way with our own resources, but now our resources are short and we need the others to step in. I want you to negotiate some more support from our partners. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_17: [EN] You'll need all your diplomacy and influence. If you blow the negotiations, look for a guy called Black Bert in Thais. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_18: [EN] He has access to all kind of odd items, and he might have just the right bribe to convince someone to continue negotiations. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_19: [EN] It will not be as easy as it might sound. So watch your words and your manners and keep in mind whom you are talking to. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_2: [EN] This leaves not much to do for you down here. I recommend you continue to explore this strange new land. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_20: [EN] Different strategies might be necessary for different people. You may try to FLATTER, THREATEN, IMPRESS, BLUFF, PLEA or to REASON with them. You probably need some luck as well. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_21: [EN] And now listen: We need more workers for the mines. The technomancers told us that a guy named Telas, who lives in Edron, copied the worker golem technology from Yalahar. Convince him to send us some of these golems. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_22: [EN] Further, we have more ore and end products than we can use right now. So we need someone to buy all the surplus. Convince Leeland Slim in Venore that the local traders step in as resellers. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_23: [EN] Another issue at hand is our lack of drilling worms. That should not be a big problem though. Just talk to the worm tamer in Kazordoon. If he does not get mad about you, there should be no problem to get his support. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_24: [EN] Also, now that our monetary resources are used up and not much cash is coming in, we need additional help to finance this venture. Thais has promised money in advance, but we haven't seen any of this support, yet. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_25: [EN] Convince the Thaian king to send us the promised money right now. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_26: [EN] Another problem we need to solve is the exploration of our surroundings. We need to know friends and enemies, and find out about the plants and beasts in the vicinity and learn what is edible and what is dangerous. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_27: [EN] This is all stuff the Explorer Society is interested in. It should be easy to convince their representative in Port Hope. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_28: [EN] At last, with the growing numbers of adventurers here, not only the security of the base is growing but also the demand for certain supplies. I'd like the Edron academy to open up a shop in the base. We need to keep you adventurers happy, don't we? ...
npc.ongulf.multi_29: [EN] Well, I hope you understand the importance of this mission and got what it takes to fulfil it. So hurry up and get us the needed support.
npc.ongulf.multi_3: [EN] I'm pretty sure there are several opportunities at hand for an adventurer like you. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_30: [EN] It seems things went from bad to worse! First we had some problems with the mine shafts we were building, and now that we found some precious veins in one of the new mines, and it happens to be the holiday resort of some hostile stone creatures! ...
npc.ongulf.multi_31: [EN] Nothing we dwarfs couldn't handle alone, but I rather thought this could be something interesting for an adventurer like you. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_32: [EN] So I reserved you the privilege to slay the leader! Use the mining lift to reach mine A07. The more stone creatures you kill, the better. Your mission, however, is to slay their leader, most likely some special stone beast.
npc.ongulf.multi_33: [EN] Primitive humans you say? These are most startling news, that's for sure. Well, I guess I'll send some victuals we can spare as a sign of our good will. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_34: [EN] However, our miners encountered another problem in the meantime. I'm afraid this will be your next {mission}
npc.ongulf.multi_35: [EN] Our guards reported some nightly visitors. They chased them through the mountains but lost them when the fugitives climbed up some vines. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_36: [EN] It could easily be some trap and I'm somewhat reluctant to send you there, but we can't allow some invisible aggressor to spy on us and maybe to prepare an attack. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_37: [EN] Find these vines in this mountain, climb up there and find out who is spying on us! If they mean harm, get rid of them if possible. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_38: [EN] If they are too powerful, just retreat and we will have to re-evaluate the situation. If they are harmless, all the better.
npc.ongulf.multi_39: [EN] Things are running fine so far. Actually so fine that we are short of supplies and men. I'd send a letter home but I guess sending you to get some assistance gives the whole affair a bit more urgency. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_4: [EN] Perhaps you can help the primitives you encountered. Who knows, maybe even those minotaurs give you a chance to fortify this fragile peace between us. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_40: [EN] So please travel back to Kazordoon. In the western mines outside of The Big Old One, you'll find Melfar of the imperial mining guild. Ask him to send some more miners and wood. When you return, I might have some more interesting missions for you.
npc.ongulf.multi_41: [EN] Listen, I can handle the organisation down here and my boys will handle the construction of the base fine enough. Actually, all you do down here is to stand in the workers' way. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_42: [EN] But there might be something for you to do outside the base. We need to learn more about the land up there. Take the lift and do some exploring. Find a passage leading out of the mountains. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_43: [EN] Do not explore any further though. You never know whom you might be messing with.
npc.ongulf.multi_44: [EN] <grumbles> Well, we have found this place here full of promising resources and plan to create a new mining outpost. Of course this takes a lot of effort and organisation. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_45: [EN] For some of the tasks at hand we need help, even from outsiders like you. So if you are interested in some missions, let me know.
npc.ongulf.multi_46: [EN] After centuries the resources beneath and around the Big Old One became alarmingly short. Some decades ago, the imperial mining guild financed a project to search and establish new mines far away from Kazordoon. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_47: [EN] After several tries with mixed success, the project of the technomancers proved the most successful. Their steamships studied and mapped the great underwater rivers deep beneath the earth. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_48: [EN] With the help of certain apparatuses, they tracked deposits of ore and compiled ship routes to reach them. These mining bases had some obvious advantages and disadvantages. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_49: [EN] The suitable spots had no connection to the surface. On the one hand, this meant that the new mines were safe from most kinds of beasts. On the other hand, it meant that all food and material had to be brought there by ship. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_5: [EN] Even some of the people here in the base might offer you some tasks sooner or later. If you prefer, you can also do some exploring, hunting and good ol' plundering on your own of course. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_50: [EN] Special, heavy ships were built to carry ore and supplies back and forth. The only limitation for such bases had been the range of the steamships. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_51: [EN] Recently, the technomancers with the help of the temples of fire and earth made some crucial discoveries that allowed the ships to extend their cruising range almost limitlessly. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_52: [EN] The survey ships of the technomancers were once again sent out to find new, promising resources. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_53: [EN] Sadly some of the ships never returned and others only found minor deposits of ore, not worth the effort. But one of the ships made some groundbreaking discovery - a cave that had a connection to the surface. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_54: [EN] As far as the explorers could tell, the area had been unknown to dwarfhood and mankind so far. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_55: [EN] What was more, the said cave system had an abundance of rare ores. The imperial mining guild agreed to fund a new project and to name it 'project far far away'. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_56: [EN] Don't look at me, I'm not the one who came up with that name! Those technomancers are such an imaginative bunch. But where have we been? Oh, yes, the new project! ...
npc.ongulf.multi_57: [EN] Well, some ships were sent to establish a first base. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_58: [EN] It became painfully obvious that the number of workers needed there could not easily be supplied by the ships alone. Also such a base would require an amount of money, expertise and manpower that the guild could not provide. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_59: [EN] We would need help and additional resources. That's were you come into play. If you are interested, let's talk about possible missions.
npc.ongulf.multi_6: [EN] This new land is yours to be taken, so to say. Go out and make your fortune! With Farmine you have always a safe haven to return to. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_60: [EN] Well, it's a long story but you really should listen to understand what is going on here. You can also hear a short version of the story, but then don't blame me if you mess something up due to your undwarfish impatience. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_61: [EN] So what would you like to hear, the {long} story or the {short} version?
npc.ongulf.multi_7: [EN] Oh and one last thing: We convinced a carpet pilot to join us here. You'll find him on top of our lift in the mountains. I think he can offer you fast access to some cities back home.
npc.ongulf.multi_8: [EN] Ooook. Now that we managed to keep those orcs and minotaurs at bay at least for a while, we learn that the real meanies over here are some lizardmen. Just great, isn't it?. ...
npc.ongulf.multi_9: [EN] So you might already guess your next mission: Find a way to hold those lizards off. Find them, contact them, talk to them, scare them, bribe them, whatever. Just keep that snakes away if anyhow possible. ...
npc.ongulf.say_1: [EN] Excellent. Although we have no idea what awaits us in this foreign land, it is always good to know something more about our surroundings.
