npc.ongulf.say_12: [FR] Special, heavy ships were built to carry ore and supplies back and forth. The only limitation for such bases had been the range of the steamships. ...
npc.ongulf.say_13: [FR] Recently, the technomancers with the help of the temples of fire and earth made some crucial discoveries that allowed the ships to extend their cruising range almost limitlessly. ...
npc.ongulf.say_14: [FR] The survey ships of the technomancers were once again sent out to find new, promising resources. ...
npc.ongulf.say_15: [FR] Sadly some of the ships never returned and others only found minor deposits of ore, not worth the effort. But one of the ships made some groundbreaking discovery - a cave that had a connection to the surface. ...
npc.ongulf.say_16: [FR] As far as the explorers could tell, the area had been unknown to dwarfhood and mankind so far. ...
npc.ongulf.say_17: [FR] What was more, the said cave system had an abundance of rare ores. The imperial mining guild agreed to fund a new project and to name it 'project far far away'. ...
npc.ongulf.say_18: [FR] Don't look at me, I'm not the one who came up with that name! Those technomancers are such an imaginative bunch. But where have we been? Oh, yes, the new project! ...
npc.ongulf.say_19: [FR] Well, some ships were sent to establish a first base. ...
npc.ongulf.say_2: [EN] That's good news for sure. It will give our operation a new impulse. However, only if there is not some unexpected trouble ahead. Well, we'll talk about that when we discuss your next {mission}.
npc.ongulf.say_20: [FR] It became painfully obvious that the number of workers needed there could not easily be supplied by the ships alone. Also such a base would require an amount of money, expertise and manpower that the guild could not provide. ...
npc.ongulf.say_21: [FR] We would need help and additional resources. That's were you come into play. If you are interested, let's talk about possible missions.
npc.ongulf.say_22: [FR] <grumbles> Well, we have found this place here full of promising resources and plan to create a new mining outpost. Of course this takes a lot of effort and organisation. ...
npc.ongulf.say_23: [FR] For some of the tasks at hand we need help, even from outsiders like you. So if you are interested in some missions, let me know.
npc.ongulf.say_24: [FR] Listen, I can handle the organisation down here and my boys will handle the construction of the base fine enough. Actually, all you do down here is to stand in the workers' way. ...
npc.ongulf.say_25: [FR] But there might be something for you to do outside the base. We need to learn more about the land up there. Take the lift and do some exploring. Find a passage leading out of the mountains. ...
npc.ongulf.say_26: [FR] Do not explore any further though. You never know whom you might be messing with.
npc.ongulf.say_27: [FR] Excellent. Although we have no idea what awaits us in this foreign land, it is always good to know something more about our surroundings.
npc.ongulf.say_28: [FR] Things are running fine so far. Actually so fine that we are short of supplies and men. I'd send a letter home but I guess sending you to get some assistance gives the whole affair a bit more urgency. ...
npc.ongulf.say_29: [FR] So please travel back to Kazordoon. In the western mines outside of The Big Old One, you'll find Melfar of the imperial mining guild. Ask him to send some more miners and wood. When you return, I might have some more interesting missions for you.
npc.ongulf.say_3: [EN] Shortly after you killed that creature, the others crumbled to dust and stone. I hope this incident does not foreshadow similar problems in our mines. However, for now I have other things to take care of and you have other {missions} to accomplish.
npc.ongulf.say_30: [FR] That's good news for sure. It will give our operation a new impulse. However, only if there is not some unexpected trouble ahead. Well, we'll talk about that when we discuss your next {mission}.
npc.ongulf.say_31: [FR] Our guards reported some nightly visitors. They chased them through the mountains but lost them when the fugitives climbed up some vines. ...
npc.ongulf.say_32: [FR] It could easily be some trap and I'm somewhat reluctant to send you there, but we can't allow some invisible aggressor to spy on us and maybe to prepare an attack. ...
npc.ongulf.say_33: [FR] Find these vines in this mountain, climb up there and find out who is spying on us! If they mean harm, get rid of them if possible. ...
npc.ongulf.say_34: [FR] If they are too powerful, just retreat and we will have to re-evaluate the situation. If they are harmless, all the better.
npc.ongulf.say_35: [FR] Primitive humans you say? These are most startling news, that's for sure. Well, I guess I'll send some victuals we can spare as a sign of our good will. ...
npc.ongulf.say_36: [FR] However, our miners encountered another problem in the meantime. I'm afraid this will be your next {mission}
npc.ongulf.say_37: [FR] It seems things went from bad to worse! First we had some problems with the mine shafts we were building, and now that we found some precious veins in one of the new mines, and it happens to be the holiday resort of some hostile stone creatures! ...
npc.ongulf.say_38: [FR] Nothing we dwarfs couldn't handle alone, but I rather thought this could be something interesting for an adventurer like you. ...
npc.ongulf.say_39: [FR] So I reserved you the privilege to slay the leader! Use the mining lift to reach mine A07. The more stone creatures you kill, the better. Your mission, however, is to slay their leader, most likely some special stone beast.
npc.ongulf.say_4: [EN] You did an excellent job! With all this help Farmine will grow and prosper. While we put all available resources into building this base, I have another urgent {mission} for you.
npc.ongulf.say_40: [FR] Shortly after you killed that creature, the others crumbled to dust and stone. I hope this incident does not foreshadow similar problems in our mines. However, for now I have other things to take care of and you have other {missions} to accomplish.
npc.ongulf.say_41: [FR] Things are getting more and more complicated. You need to convince our friends that some intervention for their part is needed. ...
npc.ongulf.say_42: [FR] We've come a long way with our own resources, but now our resources are short and we need the others to step in. I want you to negotiate some more support from our partners. ...
npc.ongulf.say_43: [FR] You'll need all your diplomacy and influence. If you blow the negotiations, look for a guy called Black Bert in Thais. ...
npc.ongulf.say_44: [FR] He has access to all kind of odd items, and he might have just the right bribe to convince someone to continue negotiations. ...
npc.ongulf.say_45: [FR] It will not be as easy as it might sound. So watch your words and your manners and keep in mind whom you are talking to. ...
npc.ongulf.say_46: [FR] Different strategies might be necessary for different people. You may try to FLATTER, THREATEN, IMPRESS, BLUFF, PLEA or to REASON with them. You probably need some luck as well. ...
npc.ongulf.say_47: [FR] And now listen: We need more workers for the mines. The technomancers told us that a guy named Telas, who lives in Edron, copied the worker golem technology from Yalahar. Convince him to send us some of these golems. ...
npc.ongulf.say_48: [FR] Further, we have more ore and end products than we can use right now. So we need someone to buy all the surplus. Convince Leeland Slim in Venore that the local traders step in as resellers. ...
npc.ongulf.say_49: [FR] Another issue at hand is our lack of drilling worms. That should not be a big problem though. Just talk to the worm tamer in Kazordoon. If he does not get mad about you, there should be no problem to get his support. ...
npc.ongulf.say_5: [EN] Oh my. What a mess you have gotten yourself into. Well, at least you made it out alive. Whatever the value of a minotaur's promise might be, I guess that is the best we can get. ...
npc.ongulf.say_50: [FR] Also, now that our monetary resources are used up and not much cash is coming in, we need additional help to finance this venture. Thais has promised money in advance, but we haven't seen any of this support, yet. ...
npc.ongulf.say_51: [FR] Convince the Thaian king to send us the promised money right now. ...
npc.ongulf.say_52: [FR] Another problem we need to solve is the exploration of our surroundings. We need to know friends and enemies, and find out about the plants and beasts in the vicinity and learn what is edible and what is dangerous. ...
npc.ongulf.say_53: [FR] This is all stuff the Explorer Society is interested in. It should be easy to convince their representative in Port Hope. ...
npc.ongulf.say_54: [FR] At last, with the growing numbers of adventurers here, not only the security of the base is growing but also the demand for certain supplies. I'd like the Edron academy to open up a shop in the base. We need to keep you adventurers happy, don't we? ...
npc.ongulf.say_55: [FR] Well, I hope you understand the importance of this mission and got what it takes to fulfil it. So hurry up and get us the needed support.
npc.ongulf.say_56: [FR] You did an excellent job! With all this help Farmine will grow and prosper. While we put all available resources into building this base, I have another urgent {mission} for you.
npc.ongulf.say_57: [FR] Our new friends, those primitive humans sent us a warning. According to them, the 'green men' of the plains plan an attack on the mountains. ...
npc.ongulf.say_58: [FR] Considering their expected number, there is no chance for us to beat them off. We might be able to hold our ground for a while, but without access to the surface and under constant attacks, we might have to abandon the base. ...
npc.ongulf.say_59: [FR] Now, I'm aware that you cannot stop an entire army by yourself, but desperate situations call for desperate measures. I ask you to find the leaders of the orcs and - well do something. ...
npc.ongulf.say_6: [FR] Well, it's a long story but you really should listen to understand what is going on here. You can also hear a short version of the story, but then don't blame me if you mess something up due to your undwarfish impatience. ...
npc.ongulf.say_60: [FR] Scare them, bribe them, give them another target or whatever. As futile as it may sound: Try to talk to their leaders in some way and make them stop their attack plans. This is our only hope.
npc.ongulf.say_61: [FR] Oh my. What a mess you have gotten yourself into. Well, at least you made it out alive. Whatever the value of a minotaur's promise might be, I guess that is the best we can get. ...
npc.ongulf.say_62: [FR] Of course all those revelations lead to new problems and a new mission for you.
npc.ongulf.say_63: [FR] Ooook. Now that we managed to keep those orcs and minotaurs at bay at least for a while, we learn that the real meanies over here are some lizardmen. Just great, isn't it?. ...
npc.ongulf.say_64: [FR] So you might already guess your next mission: Find a way to hold those lizards off. Find them, contact them, talk to them, scare them, bribe them, whatever. Just keep that snakes away if anyhow possible. ...
npc.ongulf.say_65: [FR] If the orcs are right, they are somewhere in or behind those mountains in the north. I doubt you can reason with them in any way, but you'll have to try for the sake of Farmine.
npc.ongulf.say_66: [FR] Oh, my! That sounds like a real mess. For now this dragon empire seems otherwise engaged, but we will be on guard thanks to you my friend. We will continue to fortify the base. ...
npc.ongulf.say_67: [FR] This leaves not much to do for you down here. I recommend you continue to explore this strange new land. ...
npc.ongulf.say_68: [FR] I'm pretty sure there are several opportunities at hand for an adventurer like you. ...
npc.ongulf.say_69: [FR] Perhaps you can help the primitives you encountered. Who knows, maybe even those minotaurs give you a chance to fortify this fragile peace between us. ...
npc.ongulf.say_7: [FR] So what would you like to hear, the {long} story or the {short} version?
npc.ongulf.say_70: [FR] Even some of the people here in the base might offer you some tasks sooner or later. If you prefer, you can also do some exploring, hunting and good ol' plundering on your own of course. ...
npc.ongulf.say_71: [FR] This new land is yours to be taken, so to say. Go out and make your fortune! With Farmine you have always a safe haven to return to. ...
npc.ongulf.say_72: [FR] Oh and one last thing: We convinced a carpet pilot to join us here. You'll find him on top of our lift in the mountains. I think he can offer you fast access to some cities back home.
npc.ongulf.say_8: [FR] After centuries the resources beneath and around the Big Old One became alarmingly short. Some decades ago, the imperial mining guild financed a project to search and establish new mines far away from Kazordoon. ...
npc.ongulf.say_9: [FR] After several tries with mixed success, the project of the technomancers proved the most successful. Their steamships studied and mapped the great underwater rivers deep beneath the earth. ...
npc.ongulf.voice_1: [EN] Great, another supply ship is due. How is a dwarf supposed to work under these conditions?
npc.ongulf.voice_2: [EN] Ah, there's nothing like the sound of hammers in the morning.
npc.oressa.choose_prompt_1: [EN] I'll help you decide. Tell me: Do you like to keep your {distance}, or do you like {close} combat?
npc.oressa.decided_prompt: [FR] So tell me, which {vocation} do you want to choose: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}?
npc.oressa.distance_prompt: [FR] Tell me: Do you prefer to fight with {bow} and {spear}, or do you want to cast {magic}?
npc.oressa.druid_confirm_1: [EN] So tell me: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A SAGACIOUS DRUID? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.druid_info_1: [EN] Druids are healers and powerful masters of ice and earth magic. They can also do a little energy, fire or death damage as well. ...
npc.oressa.druid_info_2: [EN] Druids cannot take much damage or carry many items, but they deal more damage than paladins or knights, and can target several enemies. ...
npc.oressa.druid_info_3: [EN] If you wish to be a healer and wielder of powerful natural magic, you should consider choosing the druid vocation.
npc.oressa.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, young adventurer. Tell me if you need help in \z {choosing} your {vocation}, or if you have {decided} on the {vocation} you want to choose.
npc.oressa.greet_msg_2: [EN] Welcome to the temple of Dawnport, child. \z If you need {healing}, I can help you. Ask me about a {vocation} if you need counsel.
npc.oressa.healing_healed: [FR] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.oressa.healing_not_needed: [FR] You do not need any healing right now.
npc.oressa.knight_confirm_1: [EN] DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A VALIANT KNIGHT? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.knight_info_1: [EN] Knights are stalwart melee fighters, the toughest of all vocations. They can take more damage and carry more items than the other vocations, but they will deal less damage than paladins, druids or sorcerers. ...
npc.oressa.knight_info_2: [EN] Knights can wield one- or two-handed swords, axes and clubs, and they can cast a few spells to draw a monster's attention to them. ...
npc.oressa.knight_info_3: [EN] If you want to be a tough melee fighter who can resist much longer than anyone else, you should consider choosing the knight vocation.
npc.oressa.magic_prompt_1: [EN] Tell me: Do you prefer to {heal} and cast the power of nature and ice, or do you want to rain fire and {death} on your foes?
npc.oressa.paladin_confirm_1: [EN] So tell me: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A DARING PALADIN? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.paladin_info_1: [EN] Paladins are sturdy distance fighters. They are tougher than druids or sorcerers and can carry more items, but they are less tough than a knight. ...
npc.oressa.paladin_info_2: [EN] Paladins have the longest attack range, and can deal the most damage on a single target. ...
npc.oressa.paladin_info_3: [EN] They can also use holy magic to slay the unholy and undead in particular. ...
npc.oressa.paladin_info_4: [EN] If you like to keep a distance to your enemy, shooting while you outdistance him, you should consider choosing the paladin vocation.
npc.oressa.say_1: [EN] Then you should choose the {vocation} of a knight and become a valiant fighter with sword and shield. ...
npc.oressa.say_10: [EN] Then you should learn the ways of the druids, healers and powerful masters of natural magic. ...
npc.oressa.say_11: [EN] Druids can heal their friends and allies, but they can also cast powerful ice and earth magic to kill their enemies. They can do a little energy, fire or death damage as well. ...
npc.oressa.say_12: [EN] Druids cannot take much damage or carry many items, but they deal much more damage than paladins or knights. ...
npc.oressa.say_13: [EN] So tell me: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A SAGACIOUS DRUID? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.say_14: [EN] Then you should become a sorcerer, a mighty wielder of deathly energies and arcane fire. ...
npc.oressa.say_15: [EN] Sorcerers are powerful casters of magic. They use fire, energy and death magic to lay low their enemies. They can do a little ice or earth damage as well. ...
npc.oressa.say_16: [EN] Sorcerers cannot take much damage or carry many items, but they deal much more damage than paladins or knights. ...
npc.oressa.say_17: [EN] So tell me: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A POWERFUL SORCERER? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.say_18: [EN] SO BE IT. CAST OFF YOUR TRAINING GEAR AND RISE, NOBLE

npc.oressa.say_20: [EN] Go through the second door from the right. Open the chest and take the equipment inside before you leave to the north. ...
npc.oressa.say_21: [EN] Take the ship to reach the Mainland. Farewell, friend and good luck in all you undertake!

npc.oressa.say_5: [EN] Then you should join the ranks of the paladins, noble hunters and rangers of the wild, who rely on the swiftness of movement and ranged attacks. ...
npc.oressa.say_6: [EN] Paladins are jacks of all trades. They are tougher than the magically gifted and can carry more items than druids or sorcerers, but they can take not as much damage as a knight can. ...
npc.oressa.say_7: [EN] Paladins deal more damage than knights but less than druids or sorcerers, and have the longest range in their distance attacks. ...
npc.oressa.say_8: [EN] They can also use holy magic to slay the unholy and undead in particular. ...
npc.oressa.say_9: [EN] DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A DARING PALADIN? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.sorcerer_confirm_1: [EN] So tell me: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A POWERFUL SORCERER? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.sorcerer_info_1: [EN] Sorcerers are powerful casters of death, energy and fire magic. They can do a little ice or earth damage as well. ...
npc.oressa.sorcerer_info_2: [EN] Sorcerers cannot take much damage or carry many items, but they deal more damage than paladins or knights, and can target several enemies. ...
npc.oressa.sorcerer_info_3: [EN] If you wish to be a caster of fire and energy, hurling death magic at your foes, you should consider choosing the sorcerer vocation.
npc.oressa.stdmod_10: [EN] I can {heal} you if you are hurt. I can also help you choose your {vocation}.
npc.oressa.stdmod_11:
[EN] Behind each of those doors, the equipment and skills of one vocation lies - \z
		sorcerer, paladin, knight or druid. ...
npc.oressa.stdmod_12:
[EN] He has seen much, and likes to help the younger ones. If you have questions about what to do, \z
			or whom to ask for anything, go to Inigo.
npc.oressa.stdmod_13: [EN] Found a new way of living and took to it like a fish to water.
npc.oressa.stdmod_14: [EN] Ah. Some wounds never heal. <sighs> Shipwrecked in body and mind. Nowhere to go, so he doesn't leave.
npc.oressa.stdmod_15: [EN] He broods over problems he won't share. But maybe you can help him with a little quest or two.
npc.oressa.stdmod_16: [EN] He lives only for his experiments and potions
npc.oressa.stdmod_17: [EN] I have heard of it, yes.
npc.oressa.stdmod_18: [EN] This is a strange place. Many beings are called to it. I dreamed of it long before I came here. ... Something spoke to me, telling me I had to be its voice; a voice of the Oracle here for the sake of the adventurers that would come to defend {World} against evil and need to {choose} their destiny.
npc.oressa.stdmod_9: [EN] If you are hurt my child, I will {heal} your wounds.
npc.oressa.vocation_default_1: [EN] A vocation is your profession and destiny, determining your skills and way of fighting. There are four vocations in Tibia: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}. Each one has its unique special abilities. ...
npc.oressa.vocation_default_2: [EN] When you leave the outpost through one of the four gates upstairs, you will be equipped with training gear of a specific vocation in order to defend yourself against the monsters outside. ...
npc.oressa.vocation_default_3: [EN] You can try them out as often as you wish to. When you have gained enough experience to reach level 8, you are ready to choose the definite vocation that is to become your destiny. ...
npc.oressa.vocation_default_4: [EN] Think carefully, as you can't change your vocation later on! You will have to choose your vocation in order to leave Dawnport for the main continent through one of these {doors} behind me. ...
npc.oressa.vocation_default_5: [EN] Talk to me again when you are ready to choose your vocation, and I will set you on your way.
npc.oressa.voice_1:
[EN] You can't take it all with you - sell your Dawnport things before \z
		you receive the gear of your definite vocation!
npc.oressa.voice_2: [EN] Leave all Dawnport things behind you and choose your destiny!
npc.oressa.voice_3: [EN] Come to me if you need healing!
npc.oressa.voice_4: [EN] Choose your vocation and explore the mainland!
npc.oressa.voice_5: [EN] Talk to me to choose your definite vocation! Become a knight, paladin, druid or sorcerer!
npc.oressa.voice_6: [EN] World needs brave adventurers like you. Choose your vocation and sail to the mainland!
npc.oressa.voice_7: [EN] Poisoned? Bleeding? Wounded? I can help!
npc.ormuhn.stdmod_1: [EN] In this category I have '{Bruise Bane}', '{Cure Bleeding}', '{Wound Cleansing}', '{Cure Poison}', '{Intense Wound Cleansing}', '{Recovery}' and '{Intense Recovery}'.
npc.ormuhn.stdmod_2: [EN] In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}', '{Magic Rope}', '{Levitate}', '{Haste}', '{Charge}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.ormuhn.stdmod_3: [EN] I can teach you {healing spells}, {attack spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.ormuhn.stdmod_4: [EN] In this category I have '{Whirlwind Throw}', '{Groundshaker}', '{Berserk}' and '{Fierce Berserk}' as well as ... '{Brutal Strike}', '{Front Sweep}', '{Inflict Wound}' and '{Annihilation}'.
npc.orockle.say_1: [EN] You can help in the fight against the hive. There are several missions available to destabilise the hive. Just ask for them if you want to learn more. After completing many missions you might be worthy to get a reward.
npc.orockle.say_2: [EN] You could try to blind the hive, you might disrupt its digestion, you could gather acid or you can disable the swarm pores. ...
npc.orockle.say_3: [EN] So be it. Now you are a member of the inquisition. You might ask me for a mission to raise in my esteem.
npc.ortheus.greet_msg_1: [EN] What's your business here with the {magicians}, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.ortheus.say_1: [EN] A cookie? Well... I have to admit I haven't had one for ages. Can I have it?
npc.ortheus.say_2: [EN] It'd be better for you to leave now.
npc.ortheus.say_3: [EN] Well thanks, it looks tasty, I'll just take a bi - COUGH! Are you trying to poison me?? Get out of here before I forget myself!
npc.ortheus.say_4: [EN] Wow. These polite young adventurers nowadays. Thank you.
npc.ortheus.say_5: [EN] Hmmm, you don't have tea with you.
npc.ortheus.say_6: [EN] Have you actually brought me a mug of tea??
npc.ortheus.stdmod_1: [EN] I can't imagine a better place to live.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_10: [EN] He used to visit me for a chat, but ever since that new tavern opened I haven't seen him much anymore.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_11: [EN] He sometimes delivers fruit and vegetables to this quarter.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_12: [EN] Though the city has seen better days, the quality of life is still much better than in most other cities.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_13: [EN] I can't imagine a better place to live
npc.ortheus.stdmod_15: [EN] I don't have anything that I could give you as a reward. Guess you aren't so selfless after all, huh?
npc.ortheus.stdmod_16: [EN] They try to protect the city and do a decent job. Well - no, a poor job, I mean a poor job.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_17: [EN] You can bring me a mug of tea if you want to.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_2: [EN] Though the city has seen better days, the quality of life is still much better than in most other cities.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_3: [EN] Hm, good question. Maybe old, wise man?
npc.ortheus.stdmod_4: [EN] I'm used to being called old man. Simple as that.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_5: [EN] I don't know what you're talking about.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_6: [EN] Yes, it's a bit messy down there. Sorry.
npc.oswald.say_33: [EN] What? So why in the world should I give you an invitation? It's not as if you were someone important, are you?
npc.oswald.say_34: [EN] Well, rich and generous people are always welcome in the palace.If you donate 1000 gold to a fund I oversee, I'll give you an invitation, ok?
npc.oswald.say_37: [EN] Not that I am bribeable but I doubt that you own 1000 gold pieces. Or do you?
npc.oswald.stdmod_1: [EN] I think the gods are too busy to care about us mortals, hmm... that makes me feel godlike, too.
npc.oswald.stdmod_10: [EN] It is nearly tea time, so please hurry!
npc.oswald.stdmod_11: It's rumoured that Sam does not forge all weapons himself, but buys them from his cousin, who is married to a cyclops.
npc.oswald.stdmod_12: [EN]  If you want to see dungeons just don't pay your taxes.
npc.oswald.stdmod_13: [EN] It's beyond all doubt that certain sinister elements in our city have certain knowledge about this myth.

npc.oswald.stdmod_24: [EN] You know a rumour? TELL ME! TELL ME! TELL ME!

npc.oswald.stdmod_3: [EN] I am honored to be the assistant of the great, the illustrious, the magnificent {Durin}!

npc.palimuth.multi_1: [EN] You'll find our seven guards at the gates of each quarter. Just ask them for their report and they will tell you all you need to know.
npc.palimuth.multi_10: [EN] I'm afraid we have not seen the last chapter of Yalahar's drama. But anyhow, I wish to thank you for putting your life at stake for our cause. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_11: [EN] I allow you to enter the Yalaharian treasure room. I'm sure that you can put what you find inside to better use than them. Choose one chest, but think before takingone! ...
npc.palimuth.multi_12: [EN] Also, take this Yalaharian outfit. Depending on which side you chose previously, you can also acquire one specific addon. Thank you again for your help.
npc.palimuth.multi_13: [EN] I cannot tell you how we acquired this information, but we have heard that a circle of Yalahari is planning some kind of ritual. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_14: [EN] They plan to create a portal for some powerful demons and to unleash them in the city to 'purge' it once and for all. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_15: [EN] I doubt those poor fools will be able to control such entities. I can't figure out how they came up with such an insane idea, but they have to be stopped. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_16: [EN] The entrance to their inner sanctum has been opened for you. Please hurry and stop them before it's too late. Be prepared for a HARD battle! Better gather some friends to assist you.
npc.palimuth.multi_17: [EN] Listen, I know you have worked for Azerus and his friends, but it is not too late to change your mind! I beg you to rethink your loyalties. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_18: [EN] The fate of the whole city might depend on your decision! Think about your options carefully.
npc.palimuth.multi_19: [EN] The constant unrest in the city is to a great extent caused by the lack of food. Weapons will only serve to suppress the poor. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_2: [EN] I must warn you, the quarters are in a horrible state. I strongly advise you to stay on the main roads whenever possible while you get those reports. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_20: [EN] The factory you were sent to was once used for the production of food. Somewhere in the factory you might find an old pattern crystal for the production of food. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_21: [EN] If you use it on the controls instead of the weapon pattern, you will ensure that our people are supplied with the desperately needed food. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_22: [EN] The quara are indeed a threat. Yet, they are numerous and reproduce quickly. Slaying some of them will only enrage them even more. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_23: [EN] The quara have been there for many generations. They have never threatened anyone who stayed out of their watery realm. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_24: [EN] It would be much more useful to find out what the quara are so upset about. Better avoid slaying their leaders as this will only further the animosities.
npc.palimuth.multi_25: [EN] I thank you also in the name of these poor lost souls. I will send the charm to a priest who is able to release them. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_26: [EN] Tell the Yalahari that the charm was destroyed by the energy it contained.
npc.palimuth.multi_27: [EN] What a sick idea to misuse tortured souls to power some device! Though, this charm might be useful to free these poor souls. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_28: [EN] Please capture the souls as you have been instructed and then bring the charm to me. I will see to it that the souls are freed to go to the afterlife in peace.
npc.palimuth.multi_29: [EN] Warbeasts? Is this true? People are already starving. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_3: [EN] I'm pleased to hear that. Rarely we meet outsiders that care about our problems. Most people come here looking for wealth and luxury. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_30: [EN] How can we afford to feed an army of hungry beasts? They will not only strengthen the power of the Yalahari over the citizens, they also mean starvation and deathfor the poor. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_31: [EN] Instead of breeding warbeasts, this druid should breed cattle to feed our people. Please I beg you, convince him to do that!
npc.palimuth.multi_32: [EN] You did quite well in gaining a new friend who will work together with us. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_33: [EN] I'm sure he'll still try to gain some profit but that's still better than his former one-man rule during which he dictated his own laws.
npc.palimuth.multi_34: [EN] Mr. West is a little paranoid. That's the reason for his immense private army of bodyguards. He could surely be helpful, especially as he rules over the former trade quarter. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_35: [EN] If you were able to reach him without killing his henchmen, you could probably convince him that you mean no harm to him. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_36: [EN] That would certainly cement our relationship without any needless bloodshed. Perhaps you could use the way through the sewers to avoid his men. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_37: [EN] Mr. West is not a bad man. We should be able to work out some plans to reconstruct the city's safety as soon as he overcomes his paranoia towards us.
npc.palimuth.multi_38: [EN] This quarter has been sealed off years ago. To send someone there poses a high risk to spread the plague. I assume these research notes you've mentioned must be very important. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_39: [EN] After all those years it is more than strange that someone shows interest in these notes now. Considering what has happened to the alchemists, it is rather unlikely that they contain harmless information. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_4: [EN] However, I have to tell you that our ranking system is quite rigid. So, I'm not allowed to entrust you with important missions as long as you haven't proven yourself as reliable. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_40: [EN] I fear these notes will be used to turn the plague into some kind of weapon. Someone with this plague at his disposal could subdue the whole city by blackmailing. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_41: [EN] I beg you to destroy these notes. Just put them into some burning oven to get rid of them and report that you did not find the notes.
npc.palimuth.multi_42: [EN] Now you know as much as we do about the things happening in Yalahar. It's up to you what you do with this information. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_43: [EN] Now leave and talk to my superior Azerus in the city centre to get your next mission. I urge you, though, to talk to me whenever he sends you on a new mission. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_44: [EN] I think it is important that you hear my opinion about them. Now hurry. I suppose Azerus is already waiting.
npc.palimuth.multi_45: [EN] I did my best to impress my superiors with your accomplishments and it seems that it worked quite well. They want you for their own missions now. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_46: [EN] Missions that are more important than the ones you've fulfilled for me. However, before you leave, there are still some things I need to tell you. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_47: [EN] Listen, I can't explain you everything in detail right now and here. You never know who might be eavesdropping. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_48: [EN] I left some notes in the small room there. Get them and read them. Talk to me again when you've read the notes.
npc.palimuth.multi_49: [EN] We are still present at each quarter's city wall, even though we can do little to stop the chaos from spreading. Still, our garrisons are necessary to maintain some sort of order in the city. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_5: [EN] If you are willing to work for the city of Yalahar, you can ask me for a {mission} any time, be it night or day.
npc.palimuth.multi_50: [EN] My superiors ask for a first hand report about the current situation in the single city quarters. I need someone to travel to our garrisons to get the reports from the guards. Are you willing to do that?
npc.palimuth.multi_51: [EN] I hope your first mission will not scare you off. Even though, we cut off our sewer system from other parts of the city to prevent the worst, it still has deteriorated in the last decades. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_52: [EN] Certain parts of the controls are rusty and the drains are stuffed with garbage. Get yourself a crowbar, loosen the controls and clean the pipes from the garbage. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_53: [EN] We were able to locate the 4 worst spots in the sewers. I will mark them for you on your map so you have no trouble finding them. Report to me when you have finished your {mission}. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_54: [EN] You probably heard that we have numerous problems in different quarters of our city. Our forces are limited, so we really could need some help from outsiders. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_55: [EN] Would you like to assist us in re-establishing order in our city?
npc.palimuth.multi_6: [EN] So the Yalahari that opposed us are dead or fled from the city. This should bring us more stability and perhaps a true chance to rebuild the city. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_7: [EN] Still, I wonder from where they gained some of the Yalahari secrets. Did they find some source of knowledge? ...
npc.palimuth.multi_8: [EN] And if so, is this source still around so that we can use it for the benefit of our city? What really troubles me is that none of those false Yalahari had the personality of agreat leader. ...
npc.palimuth.multi_9: [EN] Quite the opposite, they were opportunistic and not exactly bold. Perhaps they were led by some greater power which stayed behind the scenes. ...
npc.palimuth.say_1: [EN] I'm an Augur of the city of Yalahar. My special duty consists of coordinating the efforts to keep the city and its services running.
npc.palimuth.say_10: [EN] Thank you very much. You have no idea how hard it was to find someone volunteering for that job. If you feel ready for further {missions}, just tell me.
npc.palimuth.say_11: [EN] Excellent! My superiors will be pleased to get these reports. I will for sure emphasise your efforts in this mission. Please come back soon to see if there are any more {missions} available for you.
npc.palimuth.say_13: [EN] You have no idea how much I hoped to hear that, my friend! But I have an urgent mission for you!
npc.palimuth.say_14: [EN] Great! Here, take this yalaharian addon in a return.
npc.palimuth.say_2: [EN] Did you bring me the vampiric crest?
npc.palimuth.say_3: [EN] So are you done with your work?
npc.palimuth.say_4: [EN] Did you get all the reports my superiors asked for?
npc.palimuth.say_5: [EN] These are great news indeed. The people of Yalahar will be grateful. The Yalahari probably not, so take care of yourself.
npc.palimuth.say_6: [EN] Rumours travel fast in Yalahar. So the Yalahari will soon have some new toys at their disposal. I strongly doubt this has any positive effect.
npc.palimuth.say_7: [EN] Oh no! So that's the reason for the quara attacks! I will do my best to close these sewage pipes. We will have to use other drains.
npc.palimuth.say_8: [EN] You can be proud of your decision, my friend.
npc.palimuth.say_9: [EN] So do you want to side with me?

npc.peter.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello. Unless you have official business here or want to pass the gate, please move on.

npc.peter.say_3: [EN] Listen, I don't get paid enough to chat with citizens. Move on.
npc.peter.say_4: [EN] Be on your guard. Some people are nice, some... aren't.

npc.peter.stdmod_12: [EN] The leader of their pack is the biggest criminal among them all.
npc.peter.stdmod_2: [EN] You don't look as if you would last one second there.
npc.peter.stdmod_3: [EN] One day I will walk into the office of my superior and announce my resignment. Probably not long from now.
npc.peter.stdmod_4: [EN] Good idea. Go for a walk there. Preferably six feet down.
npc.peter.stdmod_6: [EN] Go there if you wanna get beaten up.

npc.peter.stdmod_8: [EN] I can't stand those arrogant fools.

npc.phillip.stdmod_11: [EN] An interesting place you should consider to visit.

npc.prezil.stdmod_16: [EN] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.prezil.stdmod_17: [EN] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.prezil.stdmod_18: [EN] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.prezil.stdmod_19: [EN] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.

npc.pydar.stdmod_20: [EN] He and his wife are running the Jolly Axeman tavern.
npc.pydar.stdmod_21: [EN] He is a smith. If you are looking for exquisite weapons and armour just talk to him.
npc.pydar.stdmod_22: [EN] She and her husband are running the Jolly Axeman tavern.
npc.pydar.stdmod_23: [EN] Uzgod is a weaponsmith just like those in the old legends.
npc.pydar.stdmod_24: [EN] Though we are through with the so-called gods, Durin, the first dwarf to aquire divine powers of his own, is considered a protector of our race.
npc.pydar.stdmod_25: [EN] Unlike the gods, the elements don't use mortals as toys, A skilled mind can understand and even control them to some extent.
npc.pydar.stdmod_26: [EN] The ways of the gods are imprehensible to mortals. On the other hand, the elements are raw forces and can be understood and tamed.
npc.pydar.stdmod_27: [EN] You can receive the Spiritual Shielding in the Whiteflower Temple south of Thais.
npc.pydar.stdmod_28: [EN] Ask for the Fire of the Suns in the Suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.pydar.stdmod_29: [EN] The druids north of Carlin can provide you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.pydar.stdmod_30: [EN] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.pydar.stdmod_31: [EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes.
npc.pydar.stdmod_32: [EN] I'm the head pyromancer of Kazordoon. I guess you are here for healing or looking for a blessing.
npc.pydar.stdmod_33: [EN] There are five different blessings available in five sacred places. These blessings are: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}.
npc.pydar.stdmod_4: [EN] The ways of the gods are imprehensible to mortals. On the other hand, the elements are raw forces and can be understood and tamed.
npc.pydar.stdmod_5: [EN] I am the head pyromancer of Kazordoon.
npc.pydar.stdmod_6: [EN] My name is Pydar Firefist, Son of Fire, from the Savage Axes.
npc.pydar.stdmod_7: [EN] Ask around. There's a lot to do, jawoll.
npc.pydar.stdmod_9: [EN] It's the fourth age of the yellow flame.
npc.pydar.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] May the fire in your heart never die.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.farewell_msg_1: [EN] COME BACK ANYTIME AND BRING ME TREASURES.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_1: [EN] LIKE MY TREASURE? WANNA PICK SOMETHING OUT OF IT?
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_10: [EN] YOU LITTLE MAGGOT. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU CAN HANDLE A FIGHT AGAINST MY KIND.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_11: [EN] I HAVE A MISSION FOR YOU BUT YOU NEED TO DIE FIRST AND RETURN AS AN {UNDEAD} CREATURE. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU ACHIEVED THIS GOAL.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_12: [EN] EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_13: [EN] I HAVE A MISSION FOR YOU BUT YOU NEED TO DIE FIRST AND RETURN AS AN {UNDEAD} CREATURE. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU ACHIEVED THIS GOAL.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_14: [EN] BOON AND BANE. I HAVE CHOSEN THIS LIFE VOLUNTARILLY AND I NEVER REGRET IT. MY {TREASURE} IS GROWING BIGGER EACH DAY.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_2: [EN] ALRIGHT. BUT FIRST OF ALL I WANT YOU TO BRING ME SOMETHING IN EXCHANGE. SURPRISE ME....AND IF I LIKE IT, YOU MAY GET WHAT YOU DESERVE.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_3: [EN] HAVE YOU SEEN THESE LEGENDARY ITEMS BACK THERE? WHO COULD REFUSE THE CHANCE OF OBTAINING ONE?!? SO WHAT IS YOUR ANSWER?
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_4: [EN] I GRANT YOU ACCESS TO THE DUNGEON IN THE NORTH. YOU'LL FIND SOME OF MY LIVING BROTHERS THERE....BUT.....EVERY TIME YOU WANT TO ENTER YOU HAVE TO GIVE ME SOMETHING PRECIOUS. ALRIGHT?
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_5: [EN] AS YOU WISH. WHAT DO YOU HAVE TO OFFER?
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_6: [EN] I LIKE THAT AND GRANT YOU ACCESS TO THE DUNGEON IN THE NORTH FOR THE NEXT FEW MINUTES. COME BACK ANYTIME AND BRING ME MORE TREASURES.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_7: [EN] THIS IS NOT WORTH BEING PART OF MY TREASURE! BRING ME SOMETHING ELSE.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_8: [EN] THIS IS NOT WORTH BEING PART OF MY TREASURE! BRING ME SOMETHING ELSE
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_9: [EN] TELL ME IF YOU CHANGE YOUR MIND. MY TREASURE THIRSTS FOR GOLD.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] COME BACK ANYTIME AND BRING ME TREASURES.
npc.quandons_ghost.greet_msg_2: [EN] He murdered me. I shouldn't have trusted him! The money! All that money blinded me! To the east I brought his stuff. In night and darkness, covered by some kind of magic of his. The minotaurs did not bother us, like he promised. ...
npc.quandons_ghost.greet_msg_3: [EN] His ... his true name is Shargon and he is a priest of some kind. He belongs to a powerful secret society and is looking for something on their behalves. ...
npc.quandons_ghost.greet_msg_4: [EN] We brought his stuff to a hideout, I'll mark it on your map! The things that I've seen there! Horrible, horrible things! I fled, but he found me, killed me. He murdered me!
npc.queen_eloise.multi_1: [EN] Excellent! Now, let me explain. If you donate 1.000.000.000 gold pieces, you will be entitled to wear a unique outfit. ...
npc.queen_eloise.say_1: [EN] In exchange for a truly generous donation, I will offer a special outfit. Do you want to make a donation?
npc.queen_eloise.say_10: [EN] You need to donate {armor} outfit first.
npc.queen_eloise.say_11: [EN] Take this boots as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend.
npc.queen_eloise.say_12: [EN] You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
npc.queen_eloise.say_14: [EN] You need to donate {helmet} addon first.
npc.queen_eloise.say_15: [EN] So you wold like to donate 500.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear a unique armor?
npc.queen_eloise.say_16: [EN] So you would like to donate 250.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear unique helmet?
npc.queen_eloise.say_17: [EN] So you would like to donate 250.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear a unique boots?
npc.queen_eloise.say_2: [EN] In that case, return to me once you made up your mind.
npc.queen_eloise.say_3: [EN] Take this armor as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend!
npc.queen_eloise.say_4: [EN] Please make sure you have free slots in your store inbox.
npc.queen_eloise.say_5: [EN] You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
npc.queen_eloise.say_7: [EN] Take this helmet as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend.
npc.queen_eloise.say_8: [EN] You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_1: [EN] I can promote you for 20000 gold coins. Do you want me to promote you?
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_10: [EN] I am Queen Eloise. For you it's 'My Queen' or 'Your Majesty', of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_11: [EN] I don't care about gossip like a simpleminded male would do.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_12: [EN] Soon the whole land will be ruled by women at last!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_15: [EN] Sell? Your question shows that you are a typical member of your gender!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_16: [EN] We honor the gods of good in our fair city, especially Crunor, of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_17: [EN] All citizens of Carlin are my subjects. I see them more as my childs, though, epecially the male population.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_18: [EN] This beast scared my cat away on my last diplomatic mission in this filthy town.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_19: [EN] He is the scourge of the whole continent!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_20: [EN] The royal treasure is hidden beyond the grasps of any thieves by magical means.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_21: [EN] Go and hunt them! For queen and country!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_22: [EN] Visit the church or the townguards for help.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_23: [EN] I will call for heroes as soon as the need arises again.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_24: [EN] Our city is rich and prospering.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_25: [EN] I don't want to talk about 'sewers'.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_26: [EN] Dungeons are places where males crawl around and look for trouble.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_27: [EN] Feel free to visit our town's magnificent shops.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_28: [EN] Don't worry about time in the presence of your Queen.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_29: [EN] We need the assistance of heroes now and then. Even males prove useful now and then.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_3: [EN] Alright then, come back when you are ready.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_30: [EN] The taxes in Carlin are not high, more a symbol than a sacrifice.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_31: [EN] I am the Queen, the only rightful ruler on the continent!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_32: [EN] Ask one of the soldiers about that.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_33: [EN] Our enemies are numerous. We have to fight vile monsters and have to watch this silly king in the south carefully.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_34: [EN] They dare to reject my reign over them!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_35: [EN] Isn't our city marvellous? Have you noticed the lovely gardens on the roofs?
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_36: [EN] My subjects maintain many fine shops. Go and have a look at their wares.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_38: [EN] The four major guilds are the Knights, the Paladins, the Druids, and the Sorcerers.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_39: [EN] They haven't troubled our city lately. I guess, they fear the wrath of our druids.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_4: [EN] I remember about those uniforms, they had a camouflage inlay so they could be worn the inside out too. I will send some color samples via mail to Mr. Postner.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_41: [EN] It's a shame that the High Paladin does not reside in Carlin.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_42: [EN] The knights of Carlin are the bravest.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_43: [EN] The sorcerers have a small isle for their guild. So if they blow something up it does not burn the whole city to ruins.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_44: [EN] The druids of Carlin are our protectors and advisors. Their powers provide us with wealth and food.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_45: [EN] Carlin is a center of the forces of good, of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_46: [EN] The forces of evil have a firm grip on this puny city to the south.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_47: [EN] The order, Crunor gives the world, is essential for survival.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_48: [EN] Chaos is common in the southern regions, where they allow a man to reign over a realm.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_49: [EN] A mans tale ... that means 'nonsense', of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_7: [EN] The uniforms of our guards and soldiers are of unparraleled quality of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_8: [EN] I am {Queen} Eloise. It is my duty to reign over this marvellous {city} and the {lands} of the north.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_9: [EN] We women try to bring justice and wisdom to all, even to males.
npc.quentin.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free or you want the {adventurer stone}?
npc.quentin.keyword_1: [EN] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.quentin.stdmod_1: [EN] Alright, I guess you need a stake first. Maybe Gamon can help you, the leg of a chair or something could just do. Try asking him for a stake, and if you have one, bring it back to me.
npc.quentin.stdmod_11: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.quentin.stdmod_14: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.quentin.stdmod_16: [EN] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.quentin.stdmod_18: [EN] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.quentin.stdmod_19: [EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.quentin.stdmod_2: [EN] I guess you couldn't convince Gamon to give you a stake, eh?
npc.quentin.stdmod_20: [EN] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.quentin.stdmod_21: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.quentin.stdmod_22: [EN] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.quentin.stdmod_23: [EN] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.quentin.stdmod_24: [EN] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.quentin.stdmod_25: [EN] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.quentin.stdmod_26: [EN] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.quentin.stdmod_27: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.quentin.stdmod_28: [EN] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.quentin.stdmod_29: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.quentin.stdmod_3: [EN] Ah, I see you brought a stake with you. Are you ready to receive my line of the prayer then?
npc.quentin.stdmod_30: [EN] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.quentin.stdmod_32:
[EN] A blessed stake to defeat evil spirits? I do know an old prayer which is said to grant sacred power and to be able to bind this power to someone, or something. ... \z
	However, this prayer needs the combined energy of ten priests. Each of them has to say one line of the prayer. ... \z
	I could start with the prayer, but since the next priest has to be in a different location, you probably will have to travel a lot. ... \z
	Is this stake really important enough to you so that you are willing to take this burden?
npc.quentin.stdmod_33:
[EN] This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.quentin.stdmod_4: [EN] So receive my prayer: 'Light shall be near - and darkness afar'. Now, bring your stake to Tibra in the Carlin church for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
npc.quentin.stdmod_6: [EN] You should visit Tibra in the Carlin church now.
npc.quentin.stdmod_7: [EN] You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.quentin.stdmod_8: [EN] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.quentin.stdmod_9: [EN] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.quentin.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.rabaz.greet_msg_1: [EN] Ah, a customer! Please feel free to browse my wares, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.rabaz.multi_1: [EN] Ah, thank you. Now look at that texture and fine colour, simply marvellous. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_10: [EN] If you lose it I will have to write a new one and put it in there again - which will undoubtedly take me a while. So keep an eye on it on your travels. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_11: [EN] Once you find what I need, best use a knife to carefully cut and gather a leaf or a scrap of their integument and press it directly under their appropriate entry into my botanical almanach. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_12: [EN] Simply return to me after you have done that and we will discuss your reward. What do you say, are you in?
npc.rabaz.multi_2: [EN] I hope the sun in the steppe did not exhaust you too much? Shellshock. A dangerous foe in the world of field science and exploration. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_3: [EN] Here, I always wore this comfortable hat when travelling, take it. It may be of use for you on further reconnaissances in Zao. Again you have my thanks, friend.
npc.rabaz.multi_4: [EN] Why yes, there is indeed some minor issue I could need your help with. I was always a friend of nature and it was not recently I discovered the joys of plants, growths, of all the flora around us. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_5: [EN] Botany my friend. The study of plants is of great importance for our future. Many of the potions we often depend on are made of plants you know. Plants can help us tending our wounds, cure us from illness or injury. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_6: [EN] I am currently writing an excessive compilation of all the knowledge I have gathered during my time here in Farmine and soon hope to publish it as 'Rabaz' Unabridged Almanach Of Botany'. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_7: [EN] However, to actually complete my botanical epitome concerning Zao, I would need someone to enter these dangerous lands. Someone able to get closer to the specimens than I can. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_8: [EN] And this is where you come in. There are two extremely rare species I need samples from. Typically not easy to come by but it should not be necessary to venture too far into Zao to find them. ...
npc.rabaz.multi_9: [EN] Explore the anterior outskirts of Zao, use my almanach and find the two specimens with missing samples on their pages. The almanach can be found in a chest in my storage, next to my shop. It's the door over there. ...
npc.rabaz.say_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.rabaz.say_2: [EN] Yes? Yes! That's the enthusiasm I need! Remember to bring a sharp knife to gather the samples, plants - even mutated deformed plants - are very sensitive you know. Off you go and be careful out there, Zao is no place for the feint hearted mind you.
npc.rabaz.say_3: [EN] Oh, you don't have my book.
npc.rabaz.say_4: [FR] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.rachel.say_1: [EN] So you ask me for a {{}} to begin your adventure?
npc.rachel.say_2: [EN] What? I have already gave you one {{}}!
npc.rachel.say_3: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.rachel.say_4: [FR] Sorry, you aren't a druid either a sorcerer.
npc.rachel.say_5: [FR] Here you are young adept, take care yourself.
npc.rachel.say_6: [FR] Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.rachel.stdmod_1: [EN] Okay, then just browse through all of my wares.
npc.raffael.greet_msg_1: [EN] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.raffael.voice_1: [EN] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_1: [EN] Are you here to get a task or to report you finished task?
npc.rafzan.stdmod_10: [EN] They are mean and cruel. Humble goblin rarely trades with them. They would rather kill poor me if not too greedy for stuff only me can get them. Still, they rob me of it for a few spare coins and there is noooo profit for poor goblin.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_11: [EN] Me job merchant is. Me trade with all kinds of things. Me not good trader though, so you get everything incredibly cheap! You might think me mad, but please don't rip off poor goblin too much. Me has four or five wives and dozens of kids to feed!
npc.rafzan.stdmod_12: [EN] Humans so clever. Much, much smarter than poor, stupid goblin. They have big rich town. Goblin lives here poor and hungry. Me so impressed by you strong and smart humans. So much to learn from you. Poor goblin only sees pretty city from afar. Poor goblin too afraid to go there.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_13: [EN] Me have seen a gold coin once or twice. So bright and shiny it hurt me poor eyes. You surely are incredibly rich human who has even three or four coins at once! Perhaps you want to exchange them for some things me offer? Just don't rob me too much, me little stupid goblin, have no idea what stuff is worth... you look honest, you surely pay fair price like I ask and tell if it's too cheap.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_14: [EN] Furry guys are strange fellows. Always collecting things and stuff. Not easy to make them share, oh there is noooo profit for little, poor me to be made. They build underground dens that can stretch quite far. Rumour has it the corym have strange tunnels that connect their different networks all over the world.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_2: [EN] Me humble name is Rafzan. Good old goblin name meaning honest, generous and nice person, I swear!
npc.rafzan.stdmod_3: [EN] Most goblins so afraid of everything, that they fight everything. Me different. Me just want trade.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_4: [EN] You humans are so big, strong, clever and beautiful. Me really feel little and green beside you. Must be sooo fun to be human. You surely always make profit!
npc.rafzan.stdmod_5: [EN] To be honest to me human friend, me only heard about it, never seen one. I imagine it's something cute and cuddly.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_6: [EN] Swamp is horrible. Slowly eating away at health of poor little goblin. No profit here at all. Me will die poor and desperate, probably eaten by giant mosquitoes.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_7: [EN] Beardmen are nasty. Always want to kill little goblin. No trade at all. Not good, not good.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_8: [EN] So much to do, so little help. Me poor goblin desperately needs help. Me have a few tasks me need to be done. I can offer you all money I made if you only help me a little with stuff which is easy to strong smart human but impossible for poor, little me.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_9: [EN] Me heard Thais is big city with king! Must be strong and clever, to become chief of all humans. Me cannot imagine how many people you have to beat up to become king of all humans. Surely he makes lot of profit in his pretty city.
npc.rahkem.keyword_1: [EN] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_1: [EN] Please, not so loud, not so loud. Some of us are trying to rest in peace here.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_10: [EN] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_12: [EN] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_13: [EN] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_14: [EN] I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, pilgrim.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_15: [EN] Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.rahkem.stdmod_16: [EN] So receive my prayer: 'Let there be power and compassion'. Now, bring your stake to Brewster in Port Hope for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_18: [EN] You should visit Brewster in Port Hope now.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_19: [EN] You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_2: [EN] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_20: [EN] A blessed stake? That is a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_21: [EN] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

npc.rahkem.stdmod_23: [EN] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_24: [EN] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_25: [EN] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_26: [EN] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_27: [EN] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_28: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_29: [EN] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_3: [EN] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_30: [EN] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_33:
[EN] This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.rahkem.stdmod_5: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.rahkem.stdmod_8: [EN] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.rahkem.voice_1: [EN] Please, not so loud, not so loud. Some of us are trying to rest in peace here.
npc.rapanaio.stdmod_1: [EN] Now that we have arrived you should waste no time and fight your way to the lair of evil and destroy its master before its too late!
npc.rapanaio.stdmod_2: [EN] Me humble name is Rapanaio. Good old goblin name meaning honest, generous and nice person, I swear!
npc.rapanaio_boat.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
npc.rapanaio_boat.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. I can travel you to {evil isle}.
npc.rapanaio_boat.stdmod_2: [EN] Do you seek a passage to {0} for {1}?
npc.rapanaio_boat.stdmod_3: [EN] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.rapanaio_boat.stdmod_4: [EN] My name is Rapanaio from the Royal Tibia Line.
npc.rapanaio_isle_of_evil.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
npc.rapanaio_isle_of_evil.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. I can travel you to {kazordoon}.
npc.rapanaio_isle_of_evil.stdmod_2: [EN] Do you seek a passage to {0} for {1}?
npc.rapanaio_isle_of_evil.stdmod_3: [EN] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.rapanaio_isle_of_evil.stdmod_4: [EN] My name is Rapanaio from the Royal Tibia Line.
npc.rashid.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, may the winds guide your way.
npc.rashid.multi_1: [EN] My friend, it seems you have already learnt a lot about the art of trading. I think you are more than worthy to become a recognised trader. ...
npc.rashid.multi_10: [EN] Well, that's good to hear. From you as my trader and deliveryman, I expect more than bringing stinky cheese. ...
npc.rashid.multi_11: [EN] I wonder if you are able to deliver goods so fragile they almost break when looked at. ...
npc.rashid.multi_12: [EN] I have ordered a special elven vase from Briasol in Ab'Dendriel. Get it from him and don't even touch it, just bring it to me while I'm in Ankrahmun. Everything clear and understood?
npc.rashid.multi_13: [EN] Well, that's good to hear. From you as my trader and deliveryman, I expect more than carrying heavy packages. ...
npc.rashid.multi_14: [EN] You also need to be fast and deliver wares in time. I have ordered a very special cheese wheel made from Darashian milk. ...
npc.rashid.multi_15: [EN] Unfortunately, the high temperature in the desert makes it rot really fast, so it must not stay in the sun for too long. ...
npc.rashid.multi_16: [EN] I'm also afraid that you might not be able to use ships because of the smell of the cheese. ...
npc.rashid.multi_17: [EN] Please get the cheese from Miraia and bring it to me while I'm in Port Hope. Everything clear and understood?
npc.rashid.multi_18: [EN] Alright, that's good to hear. From you as my trader and deliveryman, I expect more than finding rare items. ...
npc.rashid.multi_19: [EN] You also need to be able to transport heavy wares, weaklings won't get far here. I have ordered a special package from Edron. ...
npc.rashid.multi_2: [EN] There is just one little favour that I would ask from you... something personal, actually, forgive my boldness. ...
npc.rashid.multi_20: [EN] Pick it up from Willard and bring it back to me while I'm in Liberty Bay. Everything clear and understood?
npc.rashid.multi_21: [EN] Very good! I need talented people who are able to handle my wares with care, find good offers and the like, so I'm going to test you. ...
npc.rashid.multi_22: [EN] First, I'd like to see if you can dig up rare wares. Something like a ... mastermind shield! ...
npc.rashid.multi_23: [EN] Haha, just kidding, fooled you there, didn't I? Always control your nerves, that's quite important during bargaining. ...
npc.rashid.multi_24: [EN] Okay, all I want from you is one of these rare deer trophies. I have a customer here in Svargrond who ordered one, so I'd like you to deliver it tome while I'm in Svargrond. ...
npc.rashid.multi_3: [EN] I have always dreamed to have a small pet, one that I could take with me and which wouldn't cause problems. ...
npc.rashid.multi_4: [EN] Could you - just maybe - bring me a small goldfish in a bowl? I know that you would be able to get one, wouldn't you?
npc.rashid.multi_5: [EN] Fine! There's one more skill that I need to test and which is cruicial for a successful trader. ...
npc.rashid.multi_6: [EN] Of course you must be able to haggle, else you won't survive long in this business. To make things as hard as possible for you, I have the perfect trade partner for you. ...
npc.rashid.multi_7: [EN] Of course, it has to be cheap. Don't come back with anything more expensive than 400 gold. ...
npc.rashid.multi_8: [EN] And the quality must not suffer, of course! Everything clear and understood?
npc.rashid.multi_9: [EN] And the quality must not suffer, of course! Everything clear and understood?
npc.rashid.say_1: [EN] Well, you could attempt the mission to become a recognised trader, but it requires a lot of travelling. Are you willing to try?
npc.rashid.say_10: [EN] Have you brought a cheap but good crimson sword?
npc.rashid.say_11: [EN] So, my friend, are you willing to proceed to the next mission to become a recognised trader?
npc.rashid.say_12: [EN] Have you brought me a gold fish??
npc.rashid.say_13: [EN] Ah, right. <ahem> I hereby declare you - one of my recognised traders! Feel free to offer me your wares, just ask me for a {trade}!
npc.rashid.say_14: [EN] Fine. Then get a hold of that deer trophy and bring it to me while I'm in Svargrond. Just ask me about your mission.
npc.rashid.say_15: [EN] Well done! I'll take that from you. <snags it> Come see me another day, I'll be busy for a while now.
npc.rashid.say_16: [EN] Fine. Then off you go, just ask Willard about the 'package for Rashid'.
npc.rashid.say_17: [EN] Great. Just place it over there - yes, thanks, that's it. Come see me another day, I'll be busy for a while now.
npc.rashid.say_18: [EN] Okay, then please find Miraia in Darashia and ask her about the {'scarab cheese'}.
npc.rashid.say_19: [EN] Mmmhh, the lovely odeur of scarab cheese! I really can't understand why most people can't stand it. Thanks, well done!
npc.rashid.say_2: [EN] Have you managed to obtain a rare deer trophy for my customer?
npc.rashid.say_20: [EN] Okay, then please find {Briasol} in {Ab'Dendriel} and ask for a {'fine vase'}.
npc.rashid.say_21: I'm surprised that you managed to bring this vase without a single crack. That was what I needed to know, thank you.
npc.rashid.say_22: [EN] Okay, I'm curious how you will do with {Uzgod}. Good luck!
npc.rashid.say_23: [EN] Ha! You are clever indeed, well done! I'll take this from you. Come see me tomorrow, I think we two might get into business after all.
npc.rashid.say_24: [EN] Thanks so much! I'll be waiting eagerly for your return then.
npc.rashid.say_25: [EN] Thank you!! Ah, this makes my day! I'll take the rest of the day off to get to know this little guy. Come see me tomorrow, if you like.
npc.rashid.say_3: [EN] So, my friend, are you willing to proceed to the next mission to become a recognised trader?
npc.rashid.say_4: [EN] Did you bring me the package?
npc.rashid.say_48: [EN] Sorry, but you do not belong to my exclusive customers. I have to make sure that I can trust in the quality of your wares.
npc.rashid.say_5: [EN] So, my friend, are you willing to proceed to the next mission to become a recognised trader?
npc.rashid.say_7: [EN] So, my friend, are you willing to proceed to the next mission to become a recognised trader?
npc.rashid.say_9: [EN] So, my friend, are you willing to proceed to the next mission to become a recognised trader?
npc.rashid.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Take all the time you need to decide what you want!
npc.rashid.stdmod_1: [EN] I am a travelling trader. I don't buy everything, though. And not from everyone, for that matter.
npc.rashid.stdmod_10: [EN] Too few customers there, it's not worth the trip.
npc.rashid.stdmod_12: [EN] I don't like being underground much. I also tend to get lost in these labyrinthine dwarven tunnels, so I rather avoid them.
npc.rashid.stdmod_13: [EN] When you avoid the slums, it's a really pretty city. Almost as pretty as the governor's daughter.
npc.rashid.stdmod_15: [EN] I like the settlement itself, but I don't set my foot into the jungle. Have you seen the size of these centipedes??
npc.rashid.stdmod_17: [EN] I wish it was a little bit warmer there, but with a good mug of barbarian mead in your tummy everything gets a lot cosier.
npc.rashid.stdmod_18: [EN] I feel uncomfortable and rather unsafe in Thais, so I don't really travel there.
npc.rashid.stdmod_2: [EN] I am Rashid, son of the desert.
npc.rashid.stdmod_20: [EN] Although it's the flourishing trade centre of Tibia, I don't like going there. Too much competition for my taste.
npc.rashid.stdmod_21: [EN] It's almost time to journey on.
npc.rashid.stdmod_22: [EN] Kings, queens, emperors and kaliphs... everyone claims to be different and unique, but actually it's the same thing everywhere.
npc.rashid.stdmod_3: [EN] Of course, old friend. You can also browse only armor, legs, shields, helmets, boots, weapons, enchanted weapons, jewelry or miscellaneous stuff.
npc.rashid.stdmod_4: [EN] Elves... I don't really trust them. All this talk about nature and flowers and treehugging... I'm sure there's some wicked scheme behind all this.
npc.rashid.stdmod_5: [EN] My beloved hometown! Ah, the sweet scent of the desert sands, the perfect shape of the pyramids... stunningly beautiful.
npc.rashid.stdmod_6: [EN] I have to go to Carlin once in a while, since the queen wishes to see my exclusive wares in regular intervals.
npc.rashid.stdmod_7: [EN] Cormaya? Not a good place to make business, it's way too far and small.
npc.rashid.stdmod_8: [EN] It's not the real thing, but almost as good. The merchants there claim ridiculous prices, which is fine for my own business.
npc.rashid.stdmod_9: [EN] Ah yes, Edron! Such a lovely and quiet island! I usually make some nice business there.
